title: Weak-coupling selection and finite-torus entropy in the triangular Ising antiferromagnet
abstract: An antiferromagnetic second-neighbor interaction favors stripe order in the triangular-lattice Ising antiferromagnet, but uniform stripes cannot satisfy odd periodic boundaries. At each fixed odd size $L\geq5$, we minimize this interaction over the ground states of the zero-field nearest-neighbor model on an $L\times L$ torus. We prove a minimum total interface length of $4L$ and classify all $L^2(L^2-1)/2$ selected states. Under the uniform measure on these states, the area fractions of the three stripe orientations approach a uniform distribution over all nonnegative triples summing to one. Thus selection reduces an exponential degeneracy to polynomial growth, while the whole-sample orientation fractions remain broadly distributed. We also derive explicit two-sided entropy-density bounds for periodic spin ground states and honeycomb dimer coverings on $M\times N$ tori, where $M,N$ are the periods along the two primitive lattice directions. For all $M,N\geq3$, the errors relative to the bulk residual entropy are bounded by explicit constants times $\min(M,N)^{-2}$, without an aspect-ratio restriction. These bounds give finite-size accuracy guarantees and control the exponentially small fraction of unperturbed ground states that survive the selection.
summary:
反铁磁第二邻域相互作用有利于三角晶格伊辛反铁磁体中的条纹顺序，但均匀条纹不能满足奇数周期边界。在每个固定的奇数尺寸 $L\geq5$ 处，我们最小化 $L\times L$ 环面上零场最近邻模型的基态上的相互作用。我们证明了最小总界面长度为 $4L$，并对所有 $L^2(L^2-1)/2$ 选定状态进行分类。在这些状态的均匀测量下，三个条纹方向的面积分数在所有非负三元组上接近均匀分布，总和为一。因此，选择减少了多项式增长的指数简并性，而整个样本的取向分数仍然广泛分布。我们还推导出周期性自旋基态和蜂窝二聚体覆盖在 $M\times N$ tori 上的显式两侧熵密度界，其中 $M,N$ 是沿两个原始晶格方向的周期。对于所有 $M,N\geq3$，相对于总体剩余熵的误差受到显式常数乘以 $\min(M,N)^{-2}$ 的限制，没有长宽比限制。

这些界限提供了有限尺寸的精度保证，并控制了在选择中幸存下来的指数级小部分未受扰动的基态。

title: On-the-fly $Δ$-machine learned force fields for warm dense matter using a Yukawa reference model: Application to magnesium
abstract: We develop a framework for on-the-fly $\Delta$-machine learned force field ($\Delta$-MLFF) molecular dynamics (MD) simulations of warm dense matter (WDM). In particular, we employ a Yukawa reference model that captures the dominant screened-Coulomb interactions between the ions, with its parameters fit on the fly to Kohn--Sham density functional theory (DFT) data, and an MLFF scheme based on the kernel method and Bayesian linear regression that learns the differences in the energies, atomic forces, and stresses between the Yukawa model and Kohn--Sham DFT. We verify the accuracy and performance of the formalism by comparing the predicted properties of warm dense carbon with Kohn--Sham DFT results in the literature. In so doing, we demonstrate that $\Delta$-MLFF has significantly lower errors in the energies, atomic forces, and stresses than the standard MLFF scheme at a comparable cost, while accelerating ab initio MD simulations by up to three orders of magnitude. We apply this framework to calculate the equation of state, structure, and transport properties of magnesium at densities of 5.22 to 10.44 g/cm$^3$ and temperatures of 600 kK to 1.5 MK. We find that the pressure, self-diffusion coefficient, and shear viscosity obey power laws in temperature and density, that the dynamic structure factor exhibits a well-defined ion-acoustic mode whose negative dispersion is characteristic of strongly coupled liquids, and that the Stokes--Einstein relation holds to within 10% over the conditions considered.
summary:
我们开发了一个用于热致密物质 (WDM) 动态 $\Delta$-机器学习力场 ($\Delta$-MLFF) 分子动力学 (MD) 模拟的框架。特别是，我们采用了 Yukawa 参考模型，该模型捕获了离子之间的主要屏蔽库仑相互作用，其参数即时适合 Kohn-Sham 密度泛函理论 (DFT) 数据，并采用了基于核方法和贝叶斯线性回归的 MLFF 方案，可了解 Yukawa 模型和 Kohn-Sham DFT 之间的能量、原子力和应力差异。我们通过将暖致密碳的预测特性与文献中的 Kohn-Sham DFT 结果进行比较，验证了形式主义的准确性和性能。在此过程中，我们证明，在同等成本下，$\Delta$-MLFF 在能量、原子力和应力方面的误差明显低于标准 MLFF 方案，同时将从头开始 MD 模拟速度提高了三个数量级。我们应用这个框架来计算镁在密度为 5.22 至 10.44 g/cm$^3$ 和温度为 600 kK 至 1.5 MK 时的状态方程、结构和输运特性。

我们发现压力、自扩散系数和剪切粘度服从温度和密度的幂律，动态结构因子表现出明确定义的离子声学模式，其负色散是强耦合液体的特征，并且斯托克斯-爱因斯坦关系在所考虑的条件下保持在 10% 以内。

title: Fabry-Pérot Cavity formed by Magnonic waveguide using holes and notches
abstract: In this paper, we have investigated a spin-wave-based Fabry-Pérot (FP) cavity using two air holes and notches embedded in a magnonic waveguide. Through micromagnetic simulations, we have demonstrated the spin-wave profile, as well as the transmission and reflection spectra of the FP type magnonic waveguide, by varying the distance between the center of holes and notches. We have introduced an analysis of the reflection spectra in an FP type magnonic waveguide, which is essential and considerable for the performance of magnonic integrated circuits. We have also presented a theoretical model to describe the transmission and reflection characteristics of the FP-type magnonic waveguide. Furthermore, active tuning of the resonance peak of the FP type magnonic wavguide by varying the external magnetic field has been demonstrated. Our proposed structure and its study may contribute to the development of magnonic integrated circuits for low-power computing and data processing in next-generation spintronic technologies.
summary: 在本文中，我们使用嵌入磁波导中的两个气孔和凹口研究了基于自旋波的法布里-珀罗（FP）腔。通过微磁模拟，我们通过改变孔和凹口中心之间的距离，展示了 FP 型磁波导的自旋波轮廓以及透射和反射光谱。我们介绍了 FP 型磁波导中反射光谱的分析，这对于磁波集成电路的性能至关重要且重要。我们还提出了一个理论模型来描述 FP 型磁波导的传输和反射特性。此外，通过改变外部磁场来主动调谐 FP 型磁波导的谐振峰值已被证明。我们提出的结构及其研究可能有助于下一代自旋电子技术中用于低功耗计算和数据处理的磁集成电路的开发。

title: The Halperin (111) state as a paired composite-fermion wave function: Two exact finite-size identities on the sphere
abstract: Two wavefunctions have previously been proposed to describe the $\nu=1/2+1/2$ quantum Hall bilayer: $p$-wave pairing of composite fermions and $s$-wave pairing of composite fermions with anti-composite fermions. We show analytically in the spherical geometry and within the Jain-Kamilla lowest Landau level projection scheme that both of these paired composite fermion wavefunctions exactly reproduce the Halperin (111) state for a specific form of the pairing that we derive. We also find a second wavefunction that is common between both classes of wavefunctions. However, we provide evidence the two variational families generate overlapping but not identical sets of electronic states, ruling out a universal reparametrization that identifies their wavefunctions.
summary: 先前已提出两个波函数来描述 $\nu=1/2+1/2$ 量子霍尔双层：复合费米子的 $p$ 波配对和复合费米子与反复合费米子的 $s$ 波配对。我们在球面几何和 Jain-Kamilla 最低朗道能级投影方案中分析表明，这两个配对的复合费米子波函数准确地再现了我们导出的配对的特定形式的 Halperin (111) 态。我们还发现了两类波函数之间共有的第二个波函数。然而，我们提供了证据，这两个变分族产生了重叠但不相同的电子态集，排除了识别其波函数的通用重参数化。

title: In the age of big data and AI: do we still need chemical bonds?
abstract: Chemical bonding is the language through which chemistry rationalizes materials structure, stability, properties, and reactivity. Meanwhile, modern deep-learning models achieve remarkable predictive performance using representations based largely on compositional and structural information, raising the question of whether explicit bonding concepts remain necessary. In this work, we argue that artificial intelligence does not render chemical bonding obsolete but provides a new framework for evaluating and refining bonding concepts. We show that, through linear probing, Allegro and MACE embeddings recover bonding descriptors with (R^2 > 0.95), indicating that bonding emerges naturally from Allegro's and MACE's latent spaces. We also show that bonding descriptors provide information beyond bond distance in our electronic-structure-featurized MEGNet (ESF-MEGNet) model, reducing prediction error for properties including bulk and shear moduli by 15%. We discuss implications for interpretable machine learning, synthesizability prediction, and generative materials design, and suggest joint-embedding approaches for learning more general bonding representations. More broadly, we propose that chemical bonding can be understood as a learnable representation of electronic structure. From this perspective, different bonding models represent alternative compressions of the underlying electronic information and can be evaluated through their predictive power, dimensionality, and complexity. The age of machine learning shifts the focus from whether a bonding model is physically motivated to whether it captures the information required to explain and predict materials behavior. If a materials genome exists, it should be encodable through a representation of chemical bonding. If no bonding representation can capture this information, our understanding of the chemical bond may require revision.
summary:
化学键是化学使材料结构、稳定性、性能和反应性合理化的语言。与此同时，现代深度学习模型使用主要基于成分和结构信息的表示实现了显着的预测性能，这就提出了是否仍然有必要明确的粘合概念的问题。在这项工作中，我们认为人工智能不会使化学键合变得过时，而是为评估和完善键合概念提供了一个新的框架。我们表明，通过线性探测，Allegro 和 MACE 嵌入恢复了 (R^2 > 0.95) 的键合描述符，这表明键合自然地从 Allegro 和 MACE 的潜在空间中出现。我们还表明，键合描述符在我们的电子结构特征化 MEGNet (ESF-MEGNet) 模型中提供了键合距离之外的信息，将体积模量和剪切模量等属性的预测误差降低了 15%。我们讨论了对可解释机器学习、可合成性预测和生成材料设计的影响，并提出了用于学习更一般的键合表示的联合嵌入方法。

更广泛地说，我们认为化学键可以理解为电子结构的可学习表示。从这个角度来看，不同的粘合模型代表了基础电子信息的替代压缩，并且可以通过它们的预测能力、维度和复杂性进行评估。机器学习时代将焦点从粘合模型是否具有物理动机转移到它是否捕获解释和预测材料行为所需的信息。如果材料基因组存在，它应该可以通过化学键的表示进行编码。如果没有键合表示可以捕获此信息，我们对化学键的理解可能需要修改。

title: Quantum Dipolar Magnon Drag in Conducting Magnetic Bilayers
abstract: We predict electrical drag between two electrically isolated metallic ferromagnets mediated by quantum dipolar magnon coupling. A charge current in one layer generates a nonequilibrium magnon current whose momentum is transferred across an insulating spacer through interlayer dipolar interactions. The resulting magnon current in the passive layer produces a measurable voltage through electron-magnon scattering. We show the combination of resonant quantum momentum transfer and magnetic tunability through the control of magnetization configurations distinguish quantum dipolar drag from conventional drag mechanism.
summary: 我们预测了由量子偶极磁振子耦合介导的两个电隔离金属铁磁体之间的电阻力。一层中的充电电流产生非平衡磁振子电流，其动量通过层间偶极相互作用跨过绝缘间隔物转移。无源层中产生的磁振子电流通过电子磁振子散射产生可测量的电压。我们展示了通过控制磁化配置将共振量子动量转移和磁可调性相结合，将量子偶极阻力与传统阻力机制区分开来。

title: A Julia implementation of Floquet-Bloch theory for high-harmonic generation in periodic systems
abstract: We present a flexible Julia codebase implementing Floquet-Bloch theory for high-harmonic generation (HHG) in periodic tight-binding systems. Using the frequency-domain Fourier-Sambe formalism, the package maps the time-dependent Schroedinger equation onto a static eigenvalue problem. This allows direct computation of Floquet states, quasienergy bands, and harmonic currents for 1D, 2D, or 3D lattices under arbitrary light polarizations. The implementation supports both analytical Fourier-Bessel expansions (via Peierls substitution) and numerical Fast Fourier Transforms (FFT). We validate the code against a canonical 1D two-band model and showcase its capabilities on 2D honeycomb systems: gapped graphene mapping HHG cutoff scaling with hopping parameters and the Kane-Mele model, exploring field-induced quasienergy gaps and topological transitions under linear and circular driving fields. In addition to the theoretical presentation, we provide a flexible and efficient open-source Julia implementation of the Floquet formalism: this https URL .
summary: 我们提出了一个灵活的 Julia 代码库，它实现了周期性紧束缚系统中高谐波生成 (HHG) 的 Floquet-Bloch 理论。该软件包使用频域 Fourier-Sambe 形式将时变薛定谔方程映射到静态特征值问题上。这允许直接计算任意光偏振下 1D、2D 或 3D 晶格的 Floquet 态、准能带和谐波电流。该实现支持解析傅里叶-贝塞尔展开（通过 Peierls 替换）和数值快速傅里叶变换 (FFT)。我们针对规范的一维两带模型验证了代码，并展示了其在二维蜂窝系统上的功能：带隙石墨烯映射 HHG 截止缩放与跳跃参数和 Kane-Mele 模型，探索线性和圆形驱动场下场引起的准能隙和拓扑转变。除了理论介绍之外，我们还提供了 Floquet 形式的灵活高效的开源 Julia 实现：此 https URL 。

title: Kinetics of pollutant adsorption onto polymers: the Langevin dynamics study
abstract: We study adsorption kinetics of low-molecular-weight adsorbate particles on a polymer via the Langevin dynamics. The impact of the polymer molecular weight and of the strength of the polymer-particle attraction are examined. We consider mixtures of $n_p$ chains of the length $N$ with adsorbate, where $n_pN=600$ holds. Analysis includes examination of visualizations and evaluation of adsorption capacity, binding energy, average gyration radius, and asphericity of the polymer-adsorbate complexes. Both adsorption capacity and total binding energy show monotonic, logistic-like behavior; the former reaches a plateau sooner than the latter does, indicating further optimization of the maximum-capacity complex. Binding energy per particle and asphericity of complexes both demonstrate non-trivial behaviors, with distinct extrema at the intermediate stages of adsorption. The analysis reveals three stages of adsorption: (i) formation of small polymer-particle complexes, (ii) gradual merge of these into a single complex, (iii) stationary state. The stage (i) completes faster for short chains, as in this case fewer conformational rearrangements are required. The stage (ii) completes faster for long chains because of the necklace-like arrangement of small complexes along a long chain, which promotes their merge vs. diffusion-driven merge of the complexes of short chains. Our results indicate that for the rapid removal of pollutants in the high interaction regime, it is more effective to use the set of short polymer chains. On the other hand, long linear chains are optimal for adsorbing pollutants in a weak interaction regime.
summary:
我们通过朗之万动力学研究低分子量吸附颗粒在聚合物上的吸附动力学。研究了聚合物分子量和聚合物-颗粒吸引力强度的影响。我们考虑长度为 $N$ 的 $n_p$ 链与吸附物的混合物，其中 $n_pN=600$ 成立。分析包括可视化检查以及聚合物-吸附物复合物的吸附能力、结合能、平均回转半径和非球面度的评估。吸附容量和总结合能都表现出单调、类似逻辑的行为；前者比后者更早达到稳定水平，表明最大容量综合体的进一步优化。每个粒子的结合能和复合物的非球面性都表现出不平凡的行为，在吸附的中间阶段具有明显的极值。分析揭示了吸附的三个阶段：(i) 形成小的聚合物-颗粒复合物，(ii) 这些逐渐合并成单个复合物，(iii) 静止状态。对于短链，阶段 (i) 完成得更快，因为在这种情况下需要更少的构象重排。

对于长链，阶段（ii）完成得更快，因为小复合体沿着长链呈项链状排列，这促进了它们的合并，而不是短链复合体的扩散驱动合并。我们的结果表明，为了在高相互作用状态下快速去除污染物，使用短聚合物链组更有效。另一方面，长线性链最适合在弱相互作用状态下吸附污染物。

title: Non-Equilibrium Statistical Mechanics of Glass-Forming Liquids under Continuous Cooling: Microscopic Inner Clocks, Fictive Temperatures, and Kauzmann Diagrams
abstract: The description of macroscopic properties in out-of-equilibrium amorphous solids such as gels and glasses, typically processed under finite cooling rates, remains a fundamental challenge for modern statistical physics. In this work, we employ the Non-Equilibrium Self-Consistent Generalized Langevin Equation (NESCGLE) theory to construct a microscopic description of the structural and calorimetric glass transition under continuous cooling. Building upon the microscopic Onsager-Machlup interpretation of Narayanaswamy's material time (the inner clock $u(t)$) [ this http URL . 156, 244506 (2022)], we recover Tool's fictive temperature $T_f$ directly from the evolving spatial pair correlations and show that wavenumber dispersion naturally generalizes the classical scalar $T_f$ into a continuous mode spectrum governed by de Gennes narrowing at the primary cage peak. Across wide variations in cooling rate down to the quasi-static limit, the theory yields first-principles non-equilibrium Kauzmann diagrams for the two-body excess entropy that dynamically avert the Kauzmann crisis above the ideal dynamic arrest temperature $T_c$, while predicting sigmoidal relaxational heat-capacity steps consistent with computer simulations and calorimetry. Finally, we extract the cooling-rate-dependent glass transition temperature $T_g(q)$ from both equal-area integrals and differential heat-capacity landmarks, demonstrating that its asymptotic approach toward $T_c$ obeys a critical power-law scaling governed directly by the equilibrium dynamic arrest exponent.
summary:
通常在有限冷却速率下处理的非平衡无定形固体（例如凝胶和玻璃）的宏观特性的描述仍然是现代统计物理学的基本挑战。在这项工作中，我们采用非平衡自洽广义朗之万方程（NESCGLE）理论来构建连续冷却下结构和量热玻璃化转变的微观描述。建立在对 Narayanaswamy 的物质时间（内部时钟 $u(t)$）的微观 Onsager-Machlup 解释的基础上 [此 http URL 。 156, 244506 (2022)]，我们直接从不断发展的空间对相关性中恢复工具的虚构温度 $T_f$ ，并表明波数色散自然地将经典标量 $T_f$ 推广到由 de Gennes 在主笼峰处变窄控制的连续模式谱。

在冷却速率下降到准静态极限的大范围变化中，该理论产生了二体过剩熵的第一原理非平衡考兹曼图，动态地避免考兹曼危机高于理想的动态停止温度$T_c$，同时预测与计算机模拟和量热法一致的S形松弛热容步骤。最后，我们从等面积积分和微分热容地标中提取与冷却速率相关的玻璃化转变温度 $T_g(q)$，证明其趋向 $T_c$ 的渐近方法遵循由平衡动态停滞指数直接控制的临界幂律缩放。

title: Helical Magnetic Nature of $β$-Mn Structured CoZn Thin-Films Determined by a Bayesian Approach to Modeling Polarized Neutron Reflectivity Data
abstract: Chiral magnetic materials can host skyrmions and hence are of interest for numerous spintronic applications including low-power storage. To reach this goal, room temperature operation and a thin film form are needed. We have studied the chiral magnetism in a $\beta$-Mn structured CoZn sputtered film, with a Curie temperature of $\approx 130$ °C, by means of polarized neutron reflectometry (PNR) in order to reveal its magnetic field-temperature phase diagram. In bulk this material has a helimagnetic ground state. Here we use PNR data to show that the helimagnetism survives in a CoZn film only 100 nm thick, roughly half a helical period. Given the subtlety of differentiating the helical state from a uniform state with reduced interfacial magnetism, we have developed and employed a Bayesian approach that uses model selection to analyze our PNR data and to map out the field-temperature phase diagram of our thin film.
summary: 手性磁性材料可以容纳斯格明子，因此对包括低功耗存储在内的众多自旋电子应用很感兴趣。为了实现这一目标，需要室温操作和薄膜形式。我们通过偏振中子反射计（PNR）研究了居里温度约为130°C的$\beta$-Mn结构CoZn溅射薄膜的手性磁性，以揭示其磁场-温度相图。这种材料大体上具有螺旋磁基态。在这里，我们使用 PNR 数据表明，螺旋磁性在厚度仅为 100 nm（大约半个螺旋周期）的 CoZn 薄膜中仍然存在。鉴于区分螺旋态与界面磁性降低的均匀态的微妙之处，我们开发并采用了贝叶斯方法，该方法使用模型选择来分析我们的 PNR 数据并绘制薄膜的场温度相图。

title: Fast Neural Noise Stabilizes Associative Memory against Slow Synaptic Noise
abstract: Neural systems operate under multi-timescale stochastic dynamics, yet reliably maintain stable functions. We investigate how fast neural fluctuations and slow synaptic variability asymmetrically influence the structural robustness of associative memories. While synaptic noise degrades memory formation, neural noise stabilizes the network against structural perturbations. For sequential learning of multiple memories, the average recall performance is maximized at an intermediate neural-noise amplitude, whereas increasing synaptic noise rapidly degrades memory performance. Using an adiabatic mean-field framework, we derive an analytical stationary distribution of stability factors. Our theory reveals that fast neural fluctuations push the system away from marginal stability, serving as an indispensable prerequisite for systemic stability.
summary: 神经系统在多时间尺度随机动力学下运行，但可靠地保持稳定的功能。我们研究快速的神经波动和缓慢的突触变异如何不对称地影响联想记忆的结构鲁棒性。虽然突触噪声会降低记忆的形成，但神经噪声可以稳定网络以抵抗结构扰动。对于多个记忆的顺序学习，平均回忆性能在中间神经噪声幅度下最大化，而增加突触噪声会迅速降低记忆性能。使用绝热平均场框架，我们推导出稳定因子的分析平稳分布。我们的理论表明，快速的神经波动使系统远离边际稳定，这是系统稳定不可或缺的先决条件。

title: Physics-informed X-ray tomography of magnetization and material parameters
abstract: Three-dimensional spin textures are stabilized by microscopic interactions within their host materials. X-ray vector tomography can image these nanoscale structures, but weak magnetic contrast and a limited range of viewing angles often leave parts of the magnetization poorly determined. Here we show that a reconstruction constrained by the micromagnetic energy recovers the three-dimensional magnetization from such data and gains sensitivity to the underlying material interactions. Applied to the chiral magnet Co$_8$Zn$_9$Mn$_3$, the method resolves the three-dimensional helical texture even from a small fraction of the dual-axis projections typically required for a successful tomographic reconstruction, or from a single tilt axis alone. By testing which ratio of exchange to Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction in the reconstruction best reproduces the measured projections, we obtain a value for the sample that differs by about 10 % from the literature value derived from the helical winding period. Taken together, our findings suggest a way to reduce the time needed for vector tomography and to extend it to determining fundamental magnetic interactions in a material.
summary: 三维自旋纹理通过其主体材料内的微观相互作用来稳定。 X 射线矢量断层扫描可以对这些纳米级结构进行成像，但弱磁对比度和有限的视角范围常常导致部分磁化强度难以确定。在这里，我们展示了受微磁能约束的重建从这些数据中恢复了三维磁化强度，并获得了对潜在材料相互作用的敏感性。应用于手性磁体 Co$_8$Zn$_9$Mn$_3$ 时，该方法甚至可以从成功断层扫描重建通常所需的双轴投影的一小部分或仅从单个倾斜轴解析三维螺旋纹理。通过测试重建中哪种交换与 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用的比率能够最好地再现测量的预测，我们获得了一个与螺旋缠绕周期得出的文献值相差约 10% 的样本值。总而言之，我们的研究结果提出了一种减少矢量断层扫描所需时间并将其扩展到确定材料中基本磁相互作用的方法。

title: Kinetics of Self-Organization in One Component Active Matter Systems
abstract: We study an inherently nonequilibrium system consisting of self-propelled particles using molecular dynamics simulation in $d=2$. The system self-organizes through quorum-sensing interactions characterized by an interaction range $\lambda$ and a parameter $c_{\mathrm{th}}$. When the local concentration sensed by a particle, represented by an auxiliary variable $c_i(t)$ exceeds $c_{\mathrm{th}}$, its self-propulsion velocity abruptly drops to zero, leading to the emergence of particle rich domains. For small $\lambda$, we observe a droplet-like morphology of clusters, which crosses over to a bicontinuous structure as $\lambda$ increases. We confirm this transition by computing the eccentricity of the domains. Next, we characterize the evolving domain morphologies using equal-time correlation function $C(r,t)$ and structure factor $S(k,t)$ of the density field. For a fixed $\lambda$, the scaled $C(r,t)$'s at different times are indistinguishable from each other, indicating dynamical scaling. However, at a fixed time $t$, the scaling functions differ for different values of $\lambda$, confirming a $\lambda$-dependent morphological transition. In the large-wavevector limit ($k\rightarrow\infty$), the tail of $S(k,t)$ consistently follows the Porod's law: $S(k,t)\sim k^{-3}$. Furthermore, the average domain size $L(t)$ exhibits a power-law growth, $L(t)\sim t^{1/3}$, independent of $\lambda$.
summary:
我们使用 $d=2$ 中的分子动力学模拟研究了由自驱动粒子组成的固有非平衡系统。该系统通过群体感知交互进行自组织，其特征是交互范围 $\lambda$ 和参数 $c_{\mathrm{th}}$。当粒子感知到的局部浓度（由辅助变量 $c_i(t)$ 表示）超过 $c_{\mathrm{th}}$ 时，其自推进速度突然降至零，导致出现粒子丰富域。对于小的 $\lambda$，我们观察到簇的液滴状形态，随着 $\lambda$ 的增加，它会转变为双连续结构。我们通过计算域的偏心率来确认这种转变。接下来，我们使用密度场的等时间相关函数 $C(r,t)$ 和结构因子 $S(k,t)$ 来表征演化域形态。对于固定的$\lambda$，不同时间缩放后的$C(r,t)$彼此无法区分，表明是动态缩放。然而，在固定时间$t$，缩放函数对于不同的$\lambda$值是不同的，证实了$\lambda$依赖的形态转变。

在大波矢极限 ($k\rightarrow\infty$) 下，$S(k,t)$ 的尾部始终遵循波罗德定律：$S(k,t)\sim k^{-3}$。此外，平均域大小 $L(t)$ 呈现幂律增长 $L(t)\sim t^{1/3}$，与 $\lambda$ 无关。

title: Confinement Geometry Regulates Fluctuations, Densities, and Collective Escape in Interacting Active Matter
abstract: Active matter exhibits non-equilibrium signatures such as the violation of the fluctuation-dissipation theorem, giant number fluctuations, and non-Gaussian velocity distributions. We investigate how confinement geometry and particle number influence the steady-state behavior of sterically interacting Active Ornstein-Uhlenbeck Particles (AOUPs) in a double-well potential. Unlike bulk active systems, increasing particle number suppresses non-equilibrium fluctuations through crowding, making the steady-state density profiles increasingly resemble those of passive systems. Nevertheless, instantaneous active density profiles exhibit both unimodal and bimodal distributions, even at large particle numbers, whereas passive profiles remain bimodal. The local velocity and position distributions are unimodal in the concave regions of the potential but become bimodal in non-concave regions. Confinement suppresses long-range correlations while producing spatially localized fluctuations governed by potential geometry. Velocity fluctuations are suppressed in the densely populated wells but enhanced near the barrier, where non-equilibrium effects are strongest. At large persistence times, correlated barrier crossings and strong velocity-alignment correlations emerge, which are absent in passive systems. These results demonstrate how confinement geometry, crowding, and persistence jointly control density fluctuations, velocity correlations, and collective escape in interacting active matter.
summary:
活性物质表现出非平衡特征，例如违反涨落耗散定理、巨数涨落和非高斯速度分布。我们研究了约束几何结构和粒子数如何影响双阱势中空间相互作用的活性奥恩斯坦-乌伦贝克粒子（AOUP）的稳态行为。与本体主动系统不同，增加粒子数量通过拥挤抑制非平衡波动，使得稳态密度分布越来越类似于被动系统。然而，即使在大颗粒数量下，瞬时活性密度分布也表现出单峰和双峰分布，而被动密度分布仍然是双峰的。局部速度和位置分布在势的凹区域中是单峰的，但在非凹区域中变成双峰的。限制抑制了长程相关性，同时产生由潜在几何形状控制的空间局部波动。速度波动在人口稠密的井中受到抑制，但在势垒附近增强，其中非平衡效应最强。

在较长的持续时间内，会出现相关的障碍穿越和强的速度对准相关性，而这在无源系统中是不存在的。这些结果证明了约束几何、拥挤和持久性如何共同控制相互作用的活性物质中的密度涨落、速度相关性和集体逃逸。

title: Curvature-Driven Density and Fluctuations in Interacting AOUPs under Confinement
abstract: We investigate interacting active Ornstein-Uhlenbeck particles (AOUPs) confined in harmonic and double-well potentials, combining mean-field theory, analytical approximations, and numerical simulations. We derive the stationary density, position and velocity correlations, correlation length, dynamical structure factor, and leading-order entropy production. Unlike established harmonic normal-mode descriptions, our framework incorporates steric interactions, persistent forcing, and spatially varying confinement curvature through the eigenvalues and eigenvectors of the many-body Hessian. Within a locally homogeneous approximation, the correlation length is controlled by persistence and local curvature, increasing as the effective restoring stiffness decreases and formally diverging at the instability of the linearized description. Entropy production, at leading nontrivial order in persistence, is governed by gradients of the effective curvature. Harmonic confinement provides a constant-curvature reference, whereas double-well confinement creates equilibrium-like regions near the minima and strongly nonequilibrium regions near the barrier. The barrier exhibits enhanced velocity and density fluctuations, soft collective modes, long-lived correlations, and increased entropy production. Persistence amplifies these effects, while steric crowding suppresses collective fluctuations. The dynamical structure factor reveals enhanced low-frequency contributions from soft modes. Our results establish how confinement geometry, active persistence, and interactions jointly regulate collective fluctuations and irreversibility in active matter.
summary:
我们结合平均场理论、解析近似和数值模拟，研究了限制在谐波和双阱势中的相互作用的活性奥恩斯坦-乌伦贝克粒子（AOUP）。我们推导出平稳密度、位置和速度相关性、相关长度、动态结构因子和前序熵产生。与已建立的谐波简正模描述不同，我们的框架通过多体 Hessian 的特征值和特征向量结合了空间相互作用、持续强迫和空间变化的约束曲率。在局部齐次近似内，相关长度由持久性和局部曲率控制，随着有效恢复刚度的减小而增加，并在线性化描述的不稳定处正式发散。熵的产生，在持久性中处于领先的非平凡秩序，由有效曲率的梯度控制。谐波限制提供了恒定曲率参考，而双阱限制则在最小值附近创建了类平衡区域，在势垒附近创建了强非平衡区域。

该势垒表现出增强的速度和密度波动、软集体模式、长期相关性和增加的熵产生。持久性会放大这些效应，而空间拥挤会抑制集体波动。动态结构因子揭示了软模式增强的低频贡献。我们的结果确定了限制几何、主动持久性和相互作用如何共同调节活性物质的集体波动和不可逆性。

title: Quantized valley source in bilayer graphene via adiabatic quantum pumping
abstract: We propose a quantized valley source based on adiabatic quantum pumping in bilayer graphene in the presence of both quantum spin Hall and quantum valley Hall effects. By periodically modulating the gate voltages of two quantum dots coupled to a bilayer graphene nanoribbon, the helical edge states enable the generation of a pure valley current. Depending on the geometry of quantum dots, the number of emitted valley pairs either forms quantized plateaus or varies continuously with the pumping amplitude. The quantized plateau structure can be tuned by the static gate voltage and by the coupling between the quantum dots and the ribbon. Quantized valley pairs are robust against Anderson disorder applied in the quantum dots and persist for both zigzag and armchair quantum-dot boundaries. These results demonstrate that adiabatic quantum pumping provides a route toward electrically controllable quantized valley sources.
summary: 我们提出了一种基于双层石墨烯绝热量子泵浦的量子谷源，同时存在量子自旋霍尔效应和量子谷霍尔效应。通过周期性地调制与双层石墨烯纳米带耦合的两个量子点的栅极电压，螺旋边缘态能够产生纯谷电流。根据量子点的几何形状，发射的谷对的数量要么形成量子化平台，要么随着泵浦幅度连续变化。量子化平台结构可以通过静态栅极电压以及量子点和带之间的耦合来调节。量子谷对对于量子点中应用的安德森无序具有很强的鲁棒性，并且对于锯齿形和扶手椅量子点边界都持续存在。这些结果表明绝热量子泵浦为电控量子谷源提供了一条途径。

title: Informative Fisher Modes in Neural Networks as a Result of Explicit Symmetry Breaking
abstract: Learning in a neural network takes place on a high dimensional, non-convex loss landscape, the Hessian curvature of which dictates the learning dynamics. Despite its high dimensionality, the large number of architectural symmetries explains some of the geometric of this landscape, in particular flat directions, i.e. near-zero modes of the Hessian. These architectural symmetries have therefore been suggested as an organizing principle of deep learning. It remains an open question, though, wether there are additional organizing principles in the remaining degrees of freedom in the learning dynamic. Here we identify task-dependent contingent symmetries as such an additional organizing principle. We show that non-flat learning directions emerge due to explicit breaking of these contingent symmetries. We isolate this symmetry in an analytically solvable minimal model. Furthermore, we show that, by tuning an L2 penalty, signatures of the symmetry breaking become measurable. As a consequence of the same mechanism, adding noise to the data drives the model through a sequence of broken symmetry recoveries in the form of Baik-Ben-Arous-Péché (BBP) transitions. We demonstrate analytically for linear and numerically for deep linear networks that the contingent symmetry group remains explicit, and that the symmetry-breaking mechanism identifies which Hessian modes carry task-specific information. These signatures are measurable without a symmetry-group description and, hence, offer a route to study symmetry breaking as a more general principle in nonlinear networks and other learning systems.
summary:
神经网络中的学习发生在高维、非凸损失环境中，其 Hessian 曲率决定了学习动态。尽管其维度很高，但大量的建筑对称性解释了这种景观的一些几何形状，特别是平面方向，即黑森矩阵的近零模式。因此，这些架构对称性被建议作为深度学习的组织原则。然而，在学习动态的剩余自由度中是否存在额外的组织原则仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。在这里，我们将依赖于任务的偶然对称性视为这样一种附加的组织原则。我们表明，由于这些偶然对称性的明确破坏，出现了非平坦学习方向。我们将这种对称性隔离在一个可分析求解的最小模型中。此外，我们表明，通过调整 L2 惩罚，对称性破缺的特征变得可测量。由于相同的机制，向数据添加噪声会通过 Baik-Ben-Arous-Péché (BBP) 跃迁形式的一系列对称性破缺恢复来驱动模型。

我们对线性网络和深度线性网络的数值分析证明，偶然对称群仍然是显式的，并且对称破缺机制可以识别哪些 Hessian 模式携带特定于任务的信息。这些特征无需对称群描述即可测量，因此提供了一种研究对称破缺作为非线性网络和其他学习系统中更通用原理的途径。

title: IRIS: an agentic eye on symmetry-derived paths and energy landscapes of structural phase transitions
abstract: Structural phase transitions underpin ferroelectric and multiferroic functionality, but constructing interpretable energy landscapes remains dependent on specialist expertise. Predicting this behaviour rests on Landau free energies expanded in symmetry-adapted order parameters: their coefficients classify a transition, expose the couplings between distortions, set switching paths and barriers, and parametrize phase-field and effective-Hamiltonian models at larger scales. Obtaining these coefficients from first principles means sampling the Born--Oppenheimer energy surface along symmetry-derived structural paths, which requires crystallographic analysis, reliable structure generation and extensive computation, especially for coupled multidimensional order parameters. Here we introduce IRIS, an agentic workflow that converts plain-language requests and crystal structures into symmetry-adapted energy landscapes and fitted Landau energy models. Deterministic gates govern acceptance of structures, calculations and fits, while language models interpret requests and select constrained recovery actions. Applications across six compounds include a six-dimensional BiFeO$_3$ landscape that separates competition between polar and tilt amplitudes from directional locking and ranks homogeneous switching pathways. Controlled replays detected all 53 injected faults; disabling gates allowed 14 silent errors. Four prospective BaTiO$_3$ runs produced fitted landscapes from 96 density-functional calculations in 34 minutes total without intervening human decisions. IRIS makes physical model construction a reusable computational capability and provides a framework for scientific automation grounded in explicit verification.
summary:
结构相变支撑着铁电和多铁功能，但构建可解释的能源景观仍然依赖于专业知识。预测这种行为取决于以对称适应序参数扩展的朗道自由能：它们的系数对转变进行分类，揭示畸变之间的耦合，设置切换路径和障碍，并在更大尺度上参数化相场和有效哈密尔顿模型。从第一原理获得这些系数意味着沿着对称导出的结构路径对玻恩-奥本海默能量表面进行采样，这需要晶体学分析、可靠的结构生成和广泛的计算，特别是对于耦合的多维有序参数。在这里，我们介绍 IRIS，这是一种代理工作流程，可将简单语言请求和晶体结构转换为对称适应的能量景观和拟合的朗道能量模型。确定性门控制结构、计算和拟合的接受，而语言模型解释请求并选择受约束的恢复操作。

六种化合物的应用包括六维 BiFeO$_3$ 景观，它将极性和倾斜幅度之间的竞争与方向锁定分开，并对同质开关路径进行排序。受控重放检测到所有 53 个注入故障；禁用门会导致 14 个无提示错误。四次预期的 BaTiO$_3$ 运行总共在 34 分钟内通过 96 次密度泛函计算生成了合适的景观，而无需干预人类决策。 IRIS 使物理模型构建成为一种可重用的计算能力，并提供了一个基于显式验证的科学自动化框架。

title: Diffusion-Based Generative Screening of ABX$_3$ Perovskite Compositions for Bandgap-Targeted Materials Discovery
abstract: Crystal-generation models can explore compositions and atomic arrangements beyond a fixed set of crystal prototypes, but their usefulness for a specific materials family depends on whether the generated structures retain the defining topology and whether their predicted properties remain reliable across the sampled chemistry. Here, a pretrained diffusion model is used to generate candidate ABX$_3$ perovskites and to examine their structural, chemical and electronic-property distributions. A connectivity-based filter distinguishes three-dimensional corner-sharing perovskites from structures that share the same nominal ABX$_3$ stoichiometry. The accepted set contains substantial B-site multiplicity, including ordered double-perovskite configurations that are inaccessible to the two-prototype substitution reference used here. The generated set is enriched in chloride-, bromide- and iodide-containing compositions relative to the Materials Project, while all generated B-site elements are already represented in that database. On the downstream MP-trained ALIGNN scale, the predicted bandgap distribution is shifted towards 1.4 eV, but the target-window fraction (8.2\%) is close to the MP reference fraction (7.3\%); the separate MatterGen and ALIGNN label sources prevent this comparison from establishing target-condition enrichment. An ALIGNN model performs well on a formula-grouped random test split but does not outperform a constant baseline on a deliberately severe B-site-disjoint test. First-principles calculations on six generated structures show that relaxation can alter structural classification and that predicted and calculated gaps can differ appreciably. These results identify both the chemical-space coverage offered by crystal diffusion and the structural and predictive checks needed before its outputs can be treated as materials candidates.
summary:
晶体生成模型可以探索一组固定晶体原型之外的成分和原子排列，但它们对特定材料族的有用性取决于生成的结构是否保留定义的拓扑结构以及它们的预测特性在整个采样化学过程中是否保持可靠。在这里，使用预训练的扩散模型来生成候选 ABX$_3$ 钙钛矿并检查其结构、化学和电子特性分布。基于连通性的滤波器将三维角共享钙钛矿与共享相同标称 ABX$_3$ 化学计量的结构区分开来。可接受的集合包含大量 B 位点多重性，包括此处使用的双原型替代参考无法访问的有序双钙钛矿配置。相对于材料项目，生成的集合富含氯化物、溴化物和碘化物成分，而所有生成的 B 位元素已在该数据库中表示。

在下游 MP 训练的 ALIGNN 尺度上，预测的带隙分布向 1.4 eV 移动，但目标窗口分数 (8.2\%) 接近 MP 参考分数 (7.3\%)；单独的 MatterGen 和 ALIGNN 标签源阻止这种比较建立目标条件富集。 ALIGNN 模型在公式分组的随机测试分割上表现良好，但在故意严格的 B 站点不相交测试上，其表现并不优于恒定基线。对六个生成结构的第一原理计算表明，松弛可以改变结构分类，并且预测和计算的间隙可能存在明显差异。这些结果确定了晶体扩散提供的化学空间覆盖范围，以及在其输出被视为候选材料之前所需的结构和预测检查。

title: Charge-Order pattern in $κ$-BEDT-TTF salts: A model independent, selection rule approach
abstract: A well known vibrational selection rule is invoked to determine the charge order (CO) pattern displayed by the most interesting members of the widely studied class of $\kappa$-BEDT-TTF salts and their molecular analogues. The selection rule indicates that an easily identifiable Raman band should be present if intra-dimer charge disproportionation occurs, constituting a sort of model independent ``litmus test''. The absence of such a band in the available Raman spectra of $\kappa$-BEDT-TTF salts exhibiting static of fluctuating CO, strongly suggests that the CO pattern involves inter-dimer CO, in contrast with the universally accepted intra-dimer disprortionation. This paper therefore poses a challenge for the theoretical modeling of the concerned salts: either the lack of the Raman band sensitive to intra-dimer CO pattern is explained, or the modeling of the multivariate, unique physical properties of these $\kappa$-phase salts (spin frustration, electronic ferroelectricity etc.) has to start from the perspective of a different ground state.
summary: 调用众所周知的振动选择规则来确定广泛研究的 $\kappa$-BEDT-TTF 盐类及其分子类似物中最有趣的成员所显示的电荷顺序 (CO) 模式。选择规则表明，如果发生二聚体内电荷歧化，则应出现易于识别的拉曼带，构成一种独立于模型的“石蕊测试”。在显示 CO 波动静态的 $\kappa$-BEDT-TTF 盐的可用拉曼光谱中不存在这样的带，强烈表明 CO 模式涉及二聚体间 CO，与普遍接受的二聚体内歧化相反。因此，本文对相关盐的理论建模提出了挑战：要么解释对二聚体内CO模式敏感的拉曼带的缺乏，要么对这些$\kappa$相盐的多元、独特的物理性质（自旋挫败、电子铁电性等）进行建模必须从不同基态的角度开始。

title: High-order concentric hopfions in a helimagnet
abstract: Magnetic hopfions are three-dimensional topological solitons: ``knots'' in the vector field of magnetization of magnetically ordered materials, which are a key element of the three-dimensional spintronics emerging today. In this work, a simple analytical model for a new type of magnetic hopfions --- ``concentric'' ones --- is constructed and solved. Their size and equilibrium energy are estimated, their stability region on the magnetic phase diagram of a helimagnet is mapped out, and the requirements for materials admitting equilibrium concentric hopfions with high Hopf index on a uniformly magnetized background are determined.
summary: 磁跳跃子是三维拓扑孤子：磁有序材料磁化矢量场中的“结”，是当今新兴的三维自旋电子学的关键元素。在这项工作中，构建并解决了一种新型磁跳子（“同心”跳子）的简单分析模型。估计了它们的尺寸和平衡能量，绘制了它们在螺旋磁体磁相图上的稳定区域，并确定了在均匀磁化背景下允许具有高Hopf指数的平衡同心hopfion的材料的要求。

title: Melting noncoplanar order on the square-kagome lattice: Chiral, flat-band, and staggered spin liquids from projective symmetry
abstract: Noncoplanar magnetic orders carry a scalar spin chirality, and their melting by quantum fluctuations has been proposed as a route to chiral spin liquids. We ask what this route can produce on the square-kagome lattice, where couplings across the octagons stabilize noncoplanar cuboc and conical orders. We classify the fermionic spin liquids of this lattice by their projective symmetry groups, identify the symmetry class into which each noncoplanar order would melt, and compare candidate states with Gutzwiller-projected wave functions. A magnetic selection rule constrains the route: the chirality of every cuboc and conical order alternates in space, so a liquid that keeps the symmetry of its parent order has zero Chern number and no spontaneous thermal Hall response. A Chern state can descend only from uniformly chiral orders, and the regular ones we find need ferromagnetic bow-tie couplings. The energetics do not favor a chiral liquid either: among the projected wave functions we compare, a cuboc1-ordered state is lowest for strong cross-octagon couplings, and nonchiral states, a valence-bond crystal or a time-reversal-symmetric liquid, for weaker ones. The two inequivalent site orbits shape the spinons: a relative time-reversal sign between them pins flat bands to the Fermi level, and because the translations of $p4mm$ are not commutators, staggered chiral liquids exist, which are absent on sixfold-symmetric lattices.
summary:
非共面磁序具有标量自旋手性，并且它们通过量子涨落的熔化已被提议作为获得手性自旋液体的途径。我们询问这条路线可以在方形戈薇晶格上产生什么，其中八边形上的耦合稳定了非共面的立方体和圆锥体顺序。我们根据射影对称群对该晶格的费米子自旋液体进行分类，识别每个非共面级将熔化的对称类别，并将候选状态与古茨威勒投影波函数进行比较。磁选择规则限制了路线：每个立方和圆锥有序的手性在空间中交替，因此保持其母有序对称性的液体具有零陈数并且没有自发的热霍尔响应。陈省只能从一致的手性级下降，而我们发现的常规状态需要铁磁领结耦合。能量学也不支持手性液体：在我们比较的投影波函数中，对于强的交叉八边形耦合，立方有序态最低，而对于较弱的非手性态、价键晶体或时间反转对称液体，则最低。

两个不等价位点轨道形成了自旋子：它们之间的相对时间反转符号将平带固定在费米能级上，并且由于 $p4mm$ 的平移不是交换子，因此存在交错的手性液体，而这在六重对称晶格中是不存在的。

title: Active Jarzynski and Crooks Relations for Driven Jump-Diffusions
abstract: Non-conservative active driving breaks detailed balance in non-Gaussian jump-diffusions, obscuring the connection between external protocol work, housekeeping dissipation, and free-energy differences. Here, we establish exact finite-time fluctuation relations for driven Markov jump-diffusions---encompassing infinite-activity Lévy processes---by comparing path probabilities under the forward and current-reversed dual dynamics relative to the instantaneous steady state (ISS). We derive a trajectory-level decomposition of total entropy production that cleanly separates transient state relaxation, housekeeping heat, and external protocol driving. When the ISS takes a Gibbsian form, gauge-tilting the dual path measure yields an Active Jarzynski equality, $\langle\exp[-(W+\Delta s_{\mathrm{act}})]\rangle_{\pi_0}=e^{-\Delta F}$, which incorporates active housekeeping entropy $\Delta s_{\mathrm{act}}$ alongside mechanical work $W$ and coexists with the conventional Jarzynski equality. Under protocol reversal, this dual framework further reveals an Active Crooks relation, where the asymmetry between forward and reverse work distributions is governed by the conditional exponential average of active dissipation. Our results provide a framework for recovering free-energy differences in driven jump-diffusions with Gibbsian instantaneous steady states and for characterizing active irreversibility through trajectory statistics.
summary:
非保守主动驱动打破了非高斯跳跃扩散的细节平衡，模糊了外部协议工作、内务耗散和自由能差异之间的联系。在这里，我们通过比较相对于瞬时稳态 (ISS) 的正向和电流反向双动力学下的路径概率，为驱动马尔可夫跳跃扩散建立了精确的有限时间涨落关系（包括无限活动 Lévy 过程）。我们推导了总熵产生的轨迹级分解，将瞬态弛豫、内务热和外部协议驱动完全分开。当国际空间站采用吉布斯形式时，规范倾斜双路径测量产生主动 Jarzynski 等式 $\langle\exp[-(W+\Delta s_{\mathrm{act}})]\rangle_{\pi_0}=e^{-\Delta F}$，它结合了主动内务熵 $\Delta s_{\mathrm{act}}$ 与机械功 $W$ 并与传统的熵共存贾辛斯基平等。

在协议逆转下，这种双重框架进一步揭示了主动克鲁克斯关系，其中正向和反向功分布之间的不对称性由主动耗散的条件指数平均值控制。我们的结果提供了一个框架，用于恢复吉布斯瞬时稳态驱动跳跃扩散中的自由能差异，并通过轨迹统计来表征主动不可逆性。

title: Anomalous response, re-emerging localization-transition and robust corner sates in self-similar peano fractal
abstract: Anomalous spectral response from the non-interacting electrons on a peano fractal is recorded within tight-binding framework. It is observed that a minimal off-diagonal anisotropy can modulate the transport characteristics of the lattice. Drastic modification in the nature of the eigenstates has been validated through the workout of level spacing statistics. Further, a two-dimensional quasiperiodic Aubry-André and Harper variation in the overlap integral can invite re-entrant localization-delocalization transition for the self-similar model. This is associated with the possible existence of single-particle mobility edge in the energy landscape. Our results are corroborated by the evaluation of inverse participation ratio, fractal dimension and quantum dynamical response. The spectrum is shown to formulate a quantum butterfly pattern with the frequency of the modulation. Chiral symmetry protected edge states are found to be insensitive with respect to moderate diagonal disorder.
summary: 皮亚诺分形上非相互作用电子的反常光谱响应被记录在紧束缚框架内。据观察，最小的非对角各向异性可以调节晶格的传输特性。通过能级间距统计的研究，已经验证了本征态性质的巨大改变。此外，重叠积分中的二维准周期 Aubry-André 和 Harper 变体可以引发自相似模型的重入定位-离域转变。这与能量景观中可能存在的单粒子迁移边缘有关。我们的结果通过逆参与比、分形维数和量子动力学响应的评估得到了证实。该频谱显示出与调制频率一起形成的量子蝴蝶图案。发现手性对称保护的边缘态对于中等对角线无序不敏感。

title: Phase-Tunable Liouvillian Topology: Dual Winding Structures and Skin Effects
abstract: Liouvillian skin effects are usually associated with dissipation whose rates favor unidirectional flow. In this work, we show that directional edge localization can emerge even when population exchange between sites is exactly balanced, with a single tunable phase parameter $\alpha$ deciding their direction and a dual winding structure deciding their nature. Although this number-conserving bath is known for eigenstate selection, we demonstrate here that its phase controls a steady current, which Hamiltonian hopping converts to directional edge localization. Further, we study the spectral winding structure by independently twisting the left (ket) and right (bra) vector indices of the density matrix, revealing two distinct windings whose relationship is dictated by an antiunitary mirror symmetry. Nearest-neighbor jump operators break this symmetry: both windings coincide, giving rise to a common spectral winding $W_0(\alpha)=\pm1$, producing a unipolar skin effect in which the density accumulates at a specific edge. However, next nearest neighbor jump preserve it. The two windings are forced to be opposite, and the ket and bra are pushed to opposite edges, giving a bipolar skin effect of coherences present in eigenmodes, without edge localization of the density in the steady state. Remarkably, in a dimerized chain the phase-controlled density skin effect gives the steady-state zero modes a size-independent weight at the skin edge, accompanied by a kink at the topological transition. In addition, the relaxation time grows linearly with the system size, however at specific phases $\alpha$ where the jump operators are rendered Hermitian, edge-localized eigenmodes with skin character coexist with diffusive relaxation.
summary:
刘维尔集肤效应通常与耗散相关，其速率有利于单向流动。在这项工作中，我们表明，即使站点之间的种群交换完全平衡，方向边缘定位也可能出现，单个可调相位参数 $\alpha$ 决定它们的方向，双缠绕结构决定它们的性质。尽管这种数守恒浴因本征态选择而闻名，但我们在此证明其相位控制稳定电流，哈密顿跳跃将其转换为定向边缘定位。此外，我们通过独立扭转密度矩阵的左（ket）和右（bra）矢量索引来研究谱绕组结构，揭示了两个不同的绕组，其关系由反酉镜像对称性决定。最近邻跳跃算子打破了这种对称性：两个绕组重合，产生共同的谱绕组 $W_0(\alpha)=\pm1$，产生单极趋肤效应，其中密度在特定边缘处累积。然而，下一个最近邻跳跃会保留它。

两个绕组被迫相反，并且 ket 和 bra 被推向相对的边缘，从而产生本征模中存在的相干性双极集肤效应，而在稳定状态下没有密度的边缘定位。值得注意的是，在二聚链中，相控密度趋肤效应使稳态零模式在趋肤边缘处具有与尺寸无关的权重，并伴随着拓扑转变处的扭结。此外，弛豫时间随着系统尺寸线性增长，但是在特定阶段$\alpha$，其中跳跃算子呈现埃尔米特式，具有皮肤特征的边缘局部本征模与扩散弛豫共存。

title: Nonlinear Physics and Self-Organized Criticality in Astrophysics
abstract: The definition of self-organized criticality (SOC) is ambiguous and controversial. Here we discuss the nonlinear physics of six basic SOC definitions, such as: phase transitions, fractal structures, power laws, SOC contingency, exponential growth, and diffusive decay. Statistics of SOC events or avalanche processes can be inferred from their size distributions, or from their spatio-temporal evolution.
summary: 自组织临界性（SOC）的定义是模糊且有争议的。在这里，我们讨论六个基本 SOC 定义的非线性物理，例如：相变、分形结构、幂律、SOC 偶然性、指数增长和扩散衰减。 SOC 事件或雪崩过程的统计数据可以根据其大小分布或时空演化来推断。

title: Rapid microscopic decorrelation precedes sustained collective ordering in quenched two-dimensional colloids
abstract: Independent Brownian noise can rapidly separate trajectories launched from the same microscopic configuration, but configuration-space distance need not reveal their later assembly outcomes. We studied this distinction in 480 two-dimensional Brownian-dynamics trajectories generated as three independent-noise replicas of 40 parent configurations under four finite-duration quenches. Ninety-two of 160 replica sets sharing one parent and one protocol reached both ordered and non-ordered terminal outcomes. A relative-diffusion calculation relates the free-particle mean-squared replica separation to the time-integrated diffusivity. The measured mean-squared separation remained about one-sixth of the free-particle reference, while its scaling was indistinguishable for replica pairs with the same and different outcomes. In contrast, outcome-resolved global sixfold order, ordered-particle population and coherence, and reciprocal-space translational order separated progressively after quench completion. With quench durations weighted equally, global order, the state score combining global and population order, coherence, and translational order remained informative 0.50 reduced time units before terminal assessment. This result persisted after either changing the terminal window or reducing the integration timestep. Transient threshold crossings were common, and 94.5\% of non-ordered crossings subsequently lost the required ordered-particle population. An independent $N=128$ ensemble showed state-score discrimination at temperatures for which both terminal classes occurred. The assembly dynamics therefore separate generic microscopic decorrelation from the later emergence and finite-window persistence of collective order associated with terminal structure.
summary:
独立的布朗噪声可以快速分离从相同微观配置发射的轨迹，但配置空间距离不需要揭示它们后来的组装结果。我们在 480 个二维布朗动力学轨迹中研究了这种区别，这些轨迹是在四个有限持续时间猝灭下作为 40 个父配置的三个独立噪声复制品生成的。共享一个父级和一个协议的 160 个副本集中有 92 个达到了有序和非有序的最终结果。相对扩散计算将自由粒子均方复制品间隔与时间积分扩散率联系起来。测量的均方分离仍然是自由粒子参考的六分之一左右，而对于具有相同和不同结果的复制品对来说，其缩放比例是无法区分的。相比之下，结果解析的全局六重顺序、有序粒子群体和相干性以及互易空间平移顺序在淬灭完成后逐渐分离。

在猝灭持续时间加权相同的情况下，全局秩序、结合全局秩序和总体秩序、一致性和翻译秩序的状态得分在最终评估之前仍保持信息量减少了 0.50 个时间单位。在更改终端窗口或减少积分时间步长后，此结果仍然存在。瞬态阈值交叉很常见，94.5% 的非有序交叉随后失去了所需的有序粒子群。一个独立的 $N=128$ 系综在两个终端类别发生的温度下显示出状态分数歧视。因此，装配动力学将一般微观去相关与后来出现的和与终端结构相关的集体秩序的有限窗口持久性分开。

title: Compliance-Shifting Elastogranular Shells
abstract: Shells and grains separately exhibit complex nonlinear behavior when confined - shells buckle and snap, while grains transition from fluid-like to solid-like. When coupled, elastogranular structures have the ability to display a remarkable variety of mechanical behaviors. Gere we created an elastogranular shell where spherical grains are sandwiched between two thin, elastic shells. By evacuating the air enclosed by the two layers, we can tune the stiffness of the elastogranular shell and alter its critical buckling load. Introducing controlled vacancy defects in the arrangement of the grains allows us to more finely tune critical buckling parameters, as the shell must balance the combined effects of defect size and resultant granular packing density. Defects in the jammed granular layer have a counterintuitive effect on the shell's buckling load, as they can stiffen the shell away from the defect. With an empirically determined scaling model, we established how the shell and grains distribute load and create a compliance-shifting structure with a tunable buckling load.
summary: 当受到限制时，壳和颗粒分别表现出复杂的非线性行为——壳弯曲和折断，而颗粒从流体状转变为固体状。当耦合时，弹粒结构能够表现出多种显着的机械行为。 Gere 我们创建了一个弹粒壳，其中球形颗粒夹在两个薄的弹性壳之间。通过排空两层所包围的空气，我们可以调整弹粒壳的刚度并改变其临界屈曲载荷。在晶粒排列中引入受控空位缺陷使我们能够更精细地调整关键屈曲参数，因为壳必须平衡缺陷尺寸和所得颗粒堆积密度的综合影响。堵塞颗粒层中的缺陷对壳体的屈曲载荷具有违反直觉的影响，因为它们可以使壳体远离缺陷而变硬。通过根据经验确定的缩放模型，我们确定了壳和颗粒如何分配载荷并创建具有可调屈曲载荷的柔量变化结构。

title: From First Bond to Stable Adhesion: Multivalent Bond Stabilization in Receptor-Mediated Endocytosis
abstract: After a particle forms its first receptor--ligand bond near a cell membrane, stable attachment often requires a threshold number of additional bonds. This paper develops a biophysical kinetic theory of this post-capture stage. The bond-number dynamics are modeled as a finite birth--death chain on $n=0,1,\dots,m$, where $0$ is loss of the initial bond and $m$ is the stabilization threshold. The mesoscopic rates $\lambda_n$ and $\mu_n$ encode the local energy landscape, accessible receptor--ligand pairs, steric and orientational constraints, and cooperative interactions within the growing cluster. The probability of reaching the threshold before losing the first bond is derived in closed form for general rates and, in the constant-ratio case, reduces to a geometric series controlled by the free-energy bias $\rho_n=\mu_n/\lambda_n$. The mean time to failure or stabilization follows from a tridiagonal backward equation. Conditioning on successful attachment is treated as a trajectory-selection effect: the conditioned chain is a Doob $h$-transform whose dissociation rate at $n=1$ vanishes, because successful trajectories cannot lose the first bond early. A minimal interface between the spatial first-capture probability and the bond-number chain is formulated, together with the conditions under which the stable capture probability factorizes into their product. The analysis shows that hitting probabilities constrain only the rate ratios, whereas the absolute rate scale requires time-resolved or dwell-time data. The threshold $m$ is a model-defined stabilization criterion, not a directly measured ligand count. The rates and threshold are effective parameters specified independently or inferred from kinetic data. The theory provides a quantitative framework for interpreting attachment probabilities, lifetimes, and the transition from first bond formation to stable multivalent adhesion.
summary:
当颗粒在细胞膜附近形成其第一个受体-配体键后，稳定的附着通常需要阈值数量的额外键。本文发展了捕获后阶段的生物物理动力学理论。键数动态被建模为 $n=0,1,\dots,m$ 上的有限出生-死亡链，其中 $0$ 是初始键的损失，$m$ 是稳定阈值。介观速率 $\lambda_n$ 和 $\mu_n$ 编码局部能量景观、可接近的受体-配体对、空间和方向约束以及不断增长的簇内的合作相互作用。在失去第一个键之前达到阈值的概率以一般速率的封闭形式导出，并且在恒定比率的情况下，简化为由自由能偏差 $\rho_n=\mu_n/\lambda_n$ 控制的几何级数。失效或稳定的平均时间由三对角倒向方程得出。成功附着的条件被视为轨迹选择效应：条件链是 Doob $h$ 变换，其解离率在 $n=1$ 时消失，因为成功的轨迹不能过早失去第一个键。

制定了空间首次捕获概率和键数链之间的最小界面，以及稳定捕获概率分解为它们的乘积的条件。分析表明，命中概率仅限制速率比，而绝对速率尺度需要时间分辨或停留时间数据。阈值 $m$ 是模型定义的稳定标准，而不是直接测量的配体计数。速率和阈值是独立指定或从动力学数据推断的有效参数。该理论提供了一个定量框架，用于解释附着概率、寿命以及从首次键形成到稳定多价附着的转变。

title: Before the First Bond: Depletion-Assisted Stochastic Capture at the Onset of Endocytosis
abstract: In a crowded extracellular environment, viruses and nanoparticles must reach the cell membrane within a few nanometers before the first ligand-receptor bond can form. Crowders generate an entropic depletion attraction, yet continuum models usually assume contact is already established or treat the approach deterministically. We formulate a thermodynamically consistent stochastic theory for this pre-contact stage. The sphere-plane depletion geometry uses the exact Asakur-Oosawa spherical-cap overlap, rather than a fitted cap, with either ideal van 't Hoff or pressure-only Carnahan-Starling osmotic pressure. A spatially varying near-wall mobility introduces a noise-induced drift that is essential for thermodynamic consistency and is often omitted. The first specific reaction is modeled by a Robin radiation boundary; the outer boundary is reflecting or absorbing. Three first-passage problems are solved analytically by quadrature: the mean reaction time, the reaction-before-escape probability, and the conditional success time, the last encoded by a Doob transform that exposes the selection bias of conditioning on capture. The theory separates thermodynamic inputs from conditional parameters and reveals a reaction-limited to diffusion-limited crossover controlled by the local Damköhler number. For typical virus and nanoparticle parameters, the depletion well reaches $2$-$6\,k_{\rm B}T$, capture times are $0.1$-$1\,{\rm ms}$, and the conditional success time is measurably shorter than the unconditional mean. Finite-volume and Chebyshev schemes reproduce the analytic results within their discretization errors and satisfy the radiation-boundary mass balance. This provides a quantitative theoretical framework for crowding-assisted capture prior to membrane wrapping and a reference for comparing crowding, near-wall mobility, and surface reactivity in endocytosis.
summary:
在拥挤的细胞外环境中，病毒和纳米颗粒必须在第一个配体-受体键形成之前到达细胞膜几纳米内。人群会产生熵耗尽吸引力，但连续模型通常假设接触已经建立或确定性地对待接近。我们为这个预接触阶段制定了热力学一致的随机理论。球面耗尽几何结构使用精确的 Asakur-Oosawa 球盖重叠，而不是装配盖，具有理想的 van 't Hoff 或仅压力 Carnahan-Starling 渗透压。空间变化的近壁迁移率会引入噪声引起的漂移，这对于热力学一致性至关重要，但经常被忽略。第一个特定反应由 Robin 辐射边界建模；外边界是反射或吸收的。通过求积法分析解决了三个首次通过问题：平均反应时间、逃逸前反应概率和条件成功时间，最后一个由 Doob 变换编码，暴露了捕获条件的选择偏差。

该理论将热力学输入与条件参数分开，并揭示了由局部 Damköhler 数控制的反应限制与扩散限制的交叉。对于典型的病毒和纳米粒子参数，耗尽井达到 $2$-$6\,k_{\rm B}T$，捕获时间为 $0.1$-$1\,{\rm ms}$，并且条件成功时间明显短于无条件平均值。有限体积和切比雪夫格式在其离散误差范围内再现了解析结果并满足辐射边界质量平衡。这为膜包裹之前的拥挤辅助捕获提供了定量的理论框架，并为比较内吞作用中的拥挤、近壁迁移率和表面反应性提供了参考。

title: Beyond-RTA magnetoconductivity of multifold semimetals under generic orientations of electromagnetic fields
abstract: We present an exact solution of the linearised semiclassical Boltzmann equation (SBE) beyond the relaxation-time approximation for multifold semimetals under arbitrarily oriented electric and magnetic fields. The framework treats the Berry curvature, orbital magnetic moment, Lorentz-force operator, and scattering terms on equal footing. Momentum-independent scattering-amplitudes couple the Fermi-surface sheets through intranode, interband, and internode processes. The scattering kernel has a finite rank and the SBE reduces to a linear system for a few moments, which is closed by the electron-number constraint. We apply this approach to four systems involving quadratic-corrected triple-point, Weyl, and Rarita-Schwinger-Weyl nodes, including tilted triple-point nodes. We obtain analytical results at zero field and to leading orders in the magnetic field, alongside numerical solutions for the full field dependence. Our results elucidate the roles of the topological properties, Lorentz-force operator, tilt, and intra- and internode scatterings in shaping the magnetoelectric conductivity. It cures severe shortcomings of previous treatments like incomplete ansätze and incomplete treatment of the Lorentz-force operator.
summary:
我们提出了线性半经典玻尔兹曼方程（SBE）的精确解，超出了任意方向电场和磁场下多重半金属的弛豫时间近似。该框架平等对待贝里曲率、轨道磁矩、洛伦兹力算子和散射项。与动量无关的散射振幅通过节内、带间和节间过程耦合费米面片。散射核具有有限秩，并且 SBE 在一段时间内简化为线性系统，该系统由电子数约束封闭。我们将此方法应用于涉及二次校正三点、Weyl 和 Rarita-Schwinger-Weyl 节点（包括倾斜三点节点）的四个系统。我们获得了零场和磁场主阶的分析结果，以及全场依赖性的数值解。我们的结果阐明了拓扑特性、洛伦兹力算子、倾斜以及节内和节间散射在形成磁电导率中的作用。

它解决了以前治疗方法的严重缺陷，例如不完整的 ansätze 和洛伦兹力算子的不完整治疗。

title: Plasmon modes in three-dimensional multifold semimetals. II. Rarita-Schwinger-Weyl and Kramers-Weyl nodes
abstract: We investigate collective charge excitations in three-dimensional multifold semimetals in which multiple bands cross the Fermi level at a positive chemical potential, focusing on pseudospin-3/2 Rarita-Schwinger-Weyl semimetals and on Kramers-Weyl semimetals. Both systems host multiple concentric Fermi surfaces at positive chemical potential. Within the random-phase approximation, we analyse the density response, Drude weights, dielectric function, plasmon modes and their Landau damping, and Friedel oscillations, considering both small and arbitrary momentum transfers. In our companion work, arXiv:2610.18629 , we investigated pseudospin-1 triple-point semimetals, with and without a quadratic correction to their dispersion, as well as Hopf and Weyl semimetals. Comparing these systems allows us to elucidate the distinct roles of band dispersions and eigenstates in shaping collective charge dynamics. Our results demonstrate that collective charge excitations can distinguish multifold nodes with multiple Fermi surfaces and reveal information encoded in their eigenstates beyond that contained in the single-particle dispersion.
summary: 我们研究了三维多重半金属中的集体电荷激发，其中多个能带以正化学势穿过费米能级，重点关注赝自旋 3/2 Rarita-Schwinger-Weyl 半金属和 Kramers-Weyl 半金属。两个系统都拥有多个具有正化学势的同心费米表面。在随机相位近似中，我们分析了密度响应、德鲁德权重、介电函数、等离激元模式及其朗道阻尼和弗里德尔振荡，同时考虑了小动量传递和任意动量传递。在我们的配套工作 arXiv:2610.18629 中，我们研究了拟自旋 1 三点半金属（对其色散进行或不进行二次校正）以及 Hopf 和 Weyl 半金属。比较这些系统使我们能够阐明能带色散和本征态在塑造集体电荷动力学中的独特作用。我们的结果表明，集体电荷激发可以区分具有多个费米面的多重节点，并揭示其本征态编码的信息，超出单粒子色散中包含的信息。

title: Polarization instability of unpolarized excited states in trapped two-component Bose--Einstein condensates
abstract: A binary Bose--Einstein condensate in an elongated trap supports unpolarized excited states, in which both components share the same spatial profile. Within mean-field theory we show that the interspecies repulsion at which these states demix rises with the excitation level. Since each component keeps its atom number, the components separate by moving in opposite directions in the trap, and demixing sets in when the interaction energy released by the separation balances its cost in kinetic and trap energy. We show that the threshold also marks the onset of an exponential, non-oscillating growth of the separation, which divides the cloud into domains of opposite polarization, with walls at the density nodes and further walls interlaced with them. In the Thomas--Fermi regime of a quasi-one-dimensional condensate the rise of the threshold follows power laws in the ratio of the trap oscillator energy to the chemical potential. The trap raises the ground-state threshold, in units of the intraspecies repulsion, by 1.82 times the square of this ratio. Each density node of an excited state near the trap center raises the threshold further by 1.24 times the cube of this ratio. Because the steps between successive levels scale as the cube of this ratio, they fall as the inverse square of the atom number, and the dependence on the excitation level is a mesoscopic effect, appreciable only when the chemical potential is no more than a few times the oscillator energy. In a hyperfine mixture of $^{87}$Rb a Feshbach resonance tunes the interspecies repulsion across the thresholds of the lowest states.
summary:
细长陷阱中的二元玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体支持非偏振激发态，其中两个分量共享相同的空间轮廓。在平均场理论中，我们表明这些状态分层时的种间排斥随着激发水平的增加而增加。由于每个组分都保持其原子序数，因此组分通过在陷阱中沿相反方向移动而分离，并且当分离释放的相互作用能平衡其动能和陷阱能的成本时，就会发生分层。我们表明，阈值还标志着分离的指数、非振荡增长的开始，它将云划分为相反极化的域，在密度节点处有壁，并且更远的壁与它们交错。在准一维凝聚体的托马斯-费米体系中，阈值的上升遵循陷阱振荡器能量与化学势之比的幂律。该陷阱将基态阈值（以种内排斥力为单位）提高了该比率平方的 1.82 倍。陷阱中心附近激发态的每个密度节点将阈值进一步提高该比率的立方的 1.24 倍。

由于连续能级之间的步长按该比率的立方缩放，因此它们以原子数的平方反比下降，并且对激发能级的依赖性是介观效应，仅当化学势不超过振荡器能量的几倍时才可察觉。在 $^{87}$Rb 的超精细混合物中，费什巴赫共振可调节最低态阈值上的种间排斥力。

title: Theoretical Prediction of Superconducting 2D Hydrogenated Janus V2CSH and Nb2CSH MXenes
abstract: Two dimensional hydrogenated Janus MXenes represent a new frontier in superconducting materials, where asymmetric surface terminations enable tunable electronic and vibrational properties. In this work, we present the first comparative study of hydrogen or sulfur terminated V2CSH and Nb2CSH monolayers using density functional theory and density functional perturbation theory. Both compounds are structurally and thermally stable, exhibiting isotropic in plane elasticity and nonmagnetic multiband metallic states dominated by transition metal d orbitals. The asymmetric S or H terminations generate nonequivalent surface potentials and intrinsic out of plane dipoles. Electron phonon coupling constants of 0.39 (V2CSH) and 0.53 (Nb2CSH) yield superconducting transition temperatures of 2.36 K and 5.27 K, respectively, within the Allen Dynes framework. Low energy lattice vibrations, primarily involving metal and sulfur atoms, account for 77% of the coupling in both MXenes. These findings establish metal substitution as a design principle for tuning superconductivity in Janus MXenes and highlight Nb2CSH as a promising candidate for low temperature superconducting applications.
summary: 二维氢化 Janus MXene 代表了超导材料的新前沿，其中不对称表面终端可实现可调谐的电子和振动特性。在这项工作中，我们首次使用密度泛函理论和密度泛函微扰理论对氢或硫封端的 V2CSH 和 Nb2CSH 单层进行比较研究。这两种化合物都具有结构和热稳定性，表现出平面弹性各向同性和以过渡金属 d 轨道为主的非磁性多带金属态。不对称的 S 或 H 终端产生不等价的表面电势和固有的面外偶极子。在 Allen Dynes 框架内，电子声子耦合常数 0.39 (V2CSH) 和 0.53 (Nb2CSH) 分别产生 2.36 K 和 5.27 K 的超导转变温度。低能晶格振动（主要涉及金属和硫原子）占两种 MXene 中耦合的 77%。这些发现确立了金属替代作为调整 Janus MXene 超导性的设计原则，并强调 Nb2CSH 作为低温超导应用的有前途的候选者。

title: Covariance-dependent participation scaling of Comtet disorder on open hyperbolic lattices
abstract: Negative curvature makes the electrostatic Green function decay exponentially, producing a finite disorder-variance budget even as radial volume grows exponentially. We investigate whether this near-field concentration also determines wave-function participation on open hyperbolic lattices. A Gaussian control preserves the full one-site distribution of Comtet disorder at every vertex while removing its off-diagonal covariance. Complete-window participation ratios on $\{7,3\}$ graphs with $N=847,2240,5887$ yield an effective-exponent difference of $-0.028$ at $W/t=0.5$ and $+0.116$ at $W/t=3$; both signs persist upon extending to $N=15435$. Size-resolved squared-kernel radii lie near $2.45\ell$ on the larger graphs of this sequence, below the cutoff-matched continuum value $3.12\ell$. Distance-shell weights resolve the finite discrete measure associated with this shift, while higher participation moments and spacing ratios characterize the accompanying wave-function and spectral structure. A marginal-matched exponential-kernel family gives positive exponent contrasts at all five sampled kernel lengths at $W/t=0.5,3$, separating the Comtet response from a description based on the decay length alone. These results distinguish a concentrated variance budget from the covariance-dependent participation response of finite open hyperbolic systems.
summary:
负曲率使静电格林函数呈指数衰减，即使径向体积呈指数增长，也会产生有限的无序方差预算。我们研究这种近场集中是否也决定了开放双曲晶格上的波函数参与。高斯控制保留了 Comtet 无序在每个顶点的完整单点分布，同时消除了其非对角协方差。 $\{7,3\}$ 图上 $N=847,2240,5887$ 的完整窗口参与率在 $W/t=0.5$ 处产生 $-0.028$ 的有效指数差，在 $W/t=3$ 处产生 $+0.116$ 的有效指数差；这两个迹象在延伸到 $N=15435$ 时仍然存在。在此序列的较大图上，尺寸解析的平方核半径位于 $2.45\ell$ 附近，低于截止匹配连续值 $3.12\ell$。距离壳权重解决了与这种转变相关的有限离散测量，而较高的参与矩和间距比则表征了伴随的波函数和谱结构。

边际匹配指数核系列在 $W/t=0.5,3$ 处的所有五个采样核长度处给出正指数对比，将 Comtet 响应与仅基于衰减长度的描述分开。这些结果将集中方差预算与有限开放双曲系统的协方差相关参与响应区分开来。

title: Fredholm approximations to the Bethe-Salpeter equation with spherical-Bessel kernels for Wannier-Mott excitons
abstract: We develop a deterministic radial approximation to the static Bethe-Salpeter equation (BSE), designed for rapid preliminary screening of Wannier-Mott exciton binding across direct-gap bulk materials. The approximation replaces the electron-hole transition problem by small radial eigenvalue problems that require no stochastic sampling. Starting from the four-point BSE and its matrix representation in a Bloch electron-hole basis, we retain one valence and one conduction band in the effective-mass limit within the Tamm-Dancoff approximation. We introduce a central projection of the screened direct interaction and omit bare electron-hole exchange. The resulting model applies to spatially extended excitons whose envelopes vary slowly on the scale of the unit cell, provided that the effective-mass description and central screened interaction adequately represent the exciton of interest. A partial-wave decomposition separates the angular-momentum channels and expresses their interaction kernels as spherical-Bessel transforms of the real-space screened Coulomb interaction. Nyström discretization produces real symmetric radial matrices suitable for standard eigensolvers. Their dimension is set by the radial grid independently of the Brillouin-zone sampling used to calculate screening. We implement the formulation in the all-electron, full-potential code $\texttt{exciting}$. For bulk GaAs, the compact radial problem reproduces the corresponding conventional matrix-BSE binding energy within $(1~\mathrm{meV})$ at matched sampling. Further refinement achieves finite-mesh stability within the same tolerance on denser screening meshes without increasing the radial matrix size.
summary:
我们开发了静态 Bethe-Salpeter 方程 (BSE) 的确定性径向近似，旨在快速初步筛选跨直接带隙块体材料的 Wannier-Mott 激子结合。该近似用不需要随机采样的小径向特征值问题代替了电子-空穴跃迁问题。从四点 BSE 及其在布洛赫电子空穴基础中的矩阵表示开始，我们在 Tamm-Dancoff 近似内的有效质量极限中保留一个价态和一个导带。我们引入了屏蔽直接相互作用的中心投影，并省略了裸露的电子-空穴交换。所得到的模型适用于空间延伸的激子，其包络线在晶胞尺度上缓慢变化，前提是有效质量描述和中心屏蔽相互作用充分代表感兴趣的激子。部分波分解分离角动量通道，并将它们的相互作用核表示为实空间屏蔽库仑相互作用的球贝塞尔变换。 Nyström 离散化产生适用于标准特征求解器的实对称径向矩阵。

它们的尺寸由径向网格设置，独立于用于计算筛选的布里渊区采样。我们在全电子、全潜力代码 $\texttt{exciting}$ 中实现了该公式。对于块状 GaAs，紧凑径向问题在匹配采样时再现了 $(1~\mathrm{meV})$ 内相应的传统矩阵 BSE 结合能。进一步细化可在更密集的筛网上实现相同公差内的有限网格稳定性，而无需增加径向矩阵尺寸。

title: Exact solution of the dynamic pseudogap model: Fock-space formalism for Gaussian fluctuations
abstract: We present an exact solution of the dynamic finite-$Q$ pseudogap model, in which electrons scatter between two nested Fermi-surface patches off a classical Gaussian order-parameter field with characteristic frequency $\omega_0$ and damping $\gamma$. The disorder-averaged Green's function is shown to be a single matrix element of the resolvent of a sparse non-Hermitian matrix acting on a Fock space of two (commensurate fluctuations) or four (incommensurate fluctuations) bosonic modes with complex energies. The non-commutativity of the pseudospin vertices at different times, which prevented an exact treatment so far, is retained in full. We derive the representation, its symmetries, and the exact limits it contains: the static continued fractions, the closed-form commensurate solution at the Fermi surface, and the second-order self-energy. A numerically exact implementation gives spectral functions and densities of states for all values of the fluctuation frequency, damping and electron energy. We find that the sideband comb of the spectral function stays close to multiples of $\omega_0$ and that quasiparticle damping is governed by an energy-dependent decoherence rate. At resonance of a quasiparticle energy with $\omega_0/2$, we obtain the static fuctuating-gap in a rotating frame, which leads to resonant splitting of the quasiparticle peak.
summary:
我们提出了动态有限$Q$赝能隙模型的精确解，其中电子在经典高斯阶参数场的两个嵌套费米面片之间散射，特征频率为$\omega_0$，阻尼为$\gamma$。无序平均格林函数被证明是作用于具有复能量的两个（相称涨落）或四个（不相称涨落）玻色子模式的福克空间上的稀疏非厄米矩阵的解的单个矩阵元素。赝自旋顶点在不同时间的不可交换性（迄今为止阻止了精确处理）被完全保留。我们推导出其表示形式、它的对称性以及它所包含的精确极限：静态连续分数、费米表面处的闭合形式等价解以及二阶自能。数值精确的实现给出了波动频率、阻尼和电子能量的所有值的谱函数和状态密度。我们发现谱函数的边带梳保持接近 $\omega_0$ 的倍数，并且准粒子阻尼由能量相关的退相干率控制。

在准粒子能量与 $\omega_0/2$ 共振时，我们获得旋转坐标系中的静态脉动间隙，这导致准粒子峰的共振分裂。

title: A Clifford-index approach connecting boundary Dirac fermions to sigma-model topological terms in the periodic table of topological insulators and superconductors
abstract: The periodic table of topological insulators and superconductors emerges from two distinct approaches: boundary Anderson localization and momentum-space K-theory. Connecting these approaches physically requires deriving the boundary sigma-model topological terms from the underlying fermion theories. We develop an index-theoretic framework for minimal massless boundary Dirac models in the eight real Altland--Zirnbauer classes. Its central ingredients are an elliptic cylinder operator interpolating between two sigma-field textures, a quotient index defined by the cylinder's graded Clifford symmetry algebra, and an index theorem identifying its protected zero-mode index with the relative homotopy class of the endpoint textures. To establish this correspondence, we deform the cylinder texture while preserving the kernel's index class and localize the obstruction to a Clifford defect. An exact oscillator-kernel calculation fixes the generator normalization. A field-independent congruence and a common regularization provide a real antisymmetric Pfaffian representative whose sign transport is related to the cylinder mod-two index by Witten's spectral-flow argument. This yields the nontrivial $\mathbb{Z}_2$ theta weight for one minimal physical module. Combining complex-parent anomalies with physical Clifford multiplicities and real-target periods also gives the real-class Wess--Zumino terms with unit spherical level. The framework thus provides an operator-level connection between boundary Dirac theories and the sigma-model topological terms associated with the periodic table.
summary:
拓扑绝缘体和超导体的周期表来自两种不同的方法：边界安德森局域化和动量空间 K 理论。在物理上连接这些方法需要从基础费米子理论中导出边界西格玛模型拓扑项。我们为八个真实 Altland-Zirnbauer 类中的最小无质量边界狄拉克模型开发了一个指数理论框架。其核心成分是在两个西格玛场纹理之间插值的椭圆柱算子、由圆柱的分级 Clifford 对称代数定义的商索引，以及用端点纹理的相对同伦类标识其受保护的零模式索引的索引定理。为了建立这种对应关系，我们使圆柱体纹理变形，同时保留内核的索引类别，并将障碍物定位到 Clifford 缺陷。精确的振荡器内核计算修复了生成器归一化。场独立同余和公共正则化提供了真正的反对称普法夫代表，其符号传输通过威滕的谱流论证与柱面模二指数相关。

这会产生一个最小物理模块的重要 $\mathbb{Z}_2$ theta 权重。将复母异常与物理 Clifford 多重性和真实目标周期相结合也给出了具有单位球面水平的真实类 Wess-Zumino 项。因此，该框架提供了边界狄拉克理论和与周期表相关的西格玛模型拓扑项之间的算子级连接。

title: Asymmetric Little--Parks Oscillations as a Probe of Coupled Pairing Channels in Surface-Superconducting \texorpdfstring{PtBi$_2$}{PtBi2}
abstract: Motivated by the recent discovery of unconventional surface superconductivity in PtBi$_{2}$, we theoretically study its signatures in the Little-Parks oscillations of a narrow ring made from the same material. Using a Ginzburg-Landau model with three coupled pairing channels allowed by the trigonal crystal symmetry, we show that a fixed in-plane magnetic field can make the mean-field transition temperature asymmetric under reversal of the normal flux through the ring, while preserving periodicity in the superconducting flux quantum. The leading weak-field contribution to this asymmetry is cubic in the in-plane field strength. The flux-odd component respects the threefold crystal symmetry and changes sign when the in-plane field is rotated by $\pi/3$ at fixed magnitude. Within the homogeneous ring model, this asymmetry is absent for a single pairing channel and arises from the coupling between the three channels. Our calculations further show that increasing the in-plane magnetic field can enhance the superconducting nucleation temperature through mixing of pairing channels, illustrating magnetic control of multicomponent superconductivity in mesoscopic rings. Little-Parks interferometry with independent control of flux and field direction thus offers a mesoscopic probe of the pairing state, complementary to spectroscopic studies of the gap structure.
summary:
受最近发现 PtBi$_{2}$ 非常规表面超导性的启发，我们从理论上研究了由相同材料制成的窄环的小帕克斯振荡特征。使用具有三角晶体对称性允许的三个耦合配对通道的金兹堡-朗道模型，我们表明固定的面内磁场可以使平均场转变温度在通过环的法向通量反转的情况下不对称，同时保持超导通量量子的周期性。对这种不对称性的主要弱场贡献是面内场强的三次方。当面内场以固定幅度旋转 $\pi/3$ 时，奇通量分量遵循三重晶体对称性并改变符号。在同质环模型中，单个配对通道不存在这种不对称性，这种不对称性是由三个通道之间的耦合引起的。我们的计算进一步表明，增加面内磁场可以通过配对通道的混合来提高超导成核温度，这说明了介观环中多组分超导性的磁控制。

因此，具有独立控制通量和场方向的小帕克斯干涉测量法提供了配对状态的介观探针，与间隙结构的光谱研究互补。

title: Three New Phases in the Two-Dimensional Potts Model at Complex Temperature
abstract: The complex-temperature phase structure of the two-dimensional Potts model has remained largely unresolved despite decades of study. Here we determine the complex-temperature phase diagram of the 3-state Potts model, and uncover three gapless phases beyond the familiar ferromagnetic and paramagnetic phases. This is done by combining tensor-network free energies with the Poisson equation to compute the Fisher zero density in the thermodynamic limit. The resulting zero distribution unifies and revises long-standing conjectures on the zero loci, and outlines each phase. One is a non-conformal gapless phase, with an exponentially growing number of low-lying transfer-matrix levels distributed across all momentum sectors. The other two are Luttinger-liquid phases with complex-valued Luttinger parameters related by the Kramers-Wannier duality. At the antiferromagnetic critical point, the Luttinger parameter equals 3, while its limit from the adjacent Luttinger-liquid phase is 6. These findings reveal rich phase structures and unconventional critical behavior in a classical textbook model.
summary: 尽管经过了数十年的研究，二维波茨模型的复杂温度相结构在很大程度上仍未得到解决。在这里，我们确定了三态 Potts 模型的复杂温度相图，并发现了除了熟悉的铁磁相和顺磁相之外的三个无间隙相。这是通过将张量网络自由能与泊松方程相结合来计算热力学极限中的费舍尔零密度来完成的。由此产生的零分布统一并修正了长期以来对零位点的猜想，并概述了每个阶段。一种是非共形无间隙相，分布在所有动量扇区的低洼转移矩阵水平数量呈指数增长。另外两个是具有与 Kramers-Wannier 对偶相关的复值 Luttinger 参数的 Luttinger 液相。在反铁磁临界点，Luttinger 参数等于 3，而邻近 Luttinger 液相的极限为 6。这些发现揭示了经典教科书模型中丰富的相结构和非常规的临界行为。

title: Weak-Signal Amplification through Stochastic Resetting
abstract: Stochastic resetting (SR) offers a distinct route to amplifying weak periodic signals in nonlinear systems. Here, we demonstrate SR-induced resonance (SRIR) in a system with double-well potential driven by a weak periodic force, where the amplitude of the mean periodic response exhibits a pronounced maximum at an optimal SR rate. The underlying mechanism exploits dynamical instability: SR repeatedly brings the system close to an unstable state, where the phase of the periodic force at each reset biases the subsequent motion toward one of the stable states. The local instability then amplifies this weak bias into a large-scale response. The SRIR arises from a competition between rare resets that limit phase-dependent state selection and frequent resets that prevent the system from fully relaxing to the selected state. We develop a general renewal formulation for the periodic response and a coarse-grained approximation that predicts the optimal resetting rate, revealing the low-frequency scaling $r_{\rm opt}(\omega)\propto\omega^{2/3}$, in agreement with numerical simulations. SRIR is fundamentally distinct from conventional noise-induced resonance (NIR), which relies on noise-activated interwell transitions whose rates are periodically modulated by the external driving force. In the weak-forcing and slow-driving regime, SRIR can achieve much stronger signal amplification than NIR. SRIR persists for a finite spread of resetting positions, and our framework extends beyond bistability. We further discuss how SRIR and NIR can be selectively controlled. Our work proposes a novel approach to the classical paradigm of stochastic resonance.
summary:
随机重置 (SR) 提供了一种在非线性系统中放大微弱周期信号的独特途径。在这里，我们在由弱周期力驱动的双阱电势系统中演示了 SR 诱导共振 (SRIR)，其中平均周期响应的幅度在最佳 SR 速率下表现出明显的最大值。底层机制利用了动态不稳定性：SR 反复使系统接近不稳定状态，其中每次重置时的周期性力的相位使后续运动偏向稳定状态之一。然后局部的不稳定性将这种微弱的偏差放大为大规模的响应。 SRIR 源于限制相相关状态选择的罕见重置和阻止系统完全放松到所选状态的频繁重置之间的竞争。我们开发了周期性响应的通用更新公式和预测最佳重置率的粗粒度近似，揭示了低频缩放 $r_{\rm opt}(\omega)\propto\omega^{2/3}$，与数值模拟一致。

SRIR 从根本上不同于传统的噪声引起的共振 (NIR)，后者依赖于噪声激活的井间跃迁，其速率由外部驱动力周期性调节。在弱强迫和慢速驱动的情况下，SRIR 可以实现比 NIR 更强的信号放大。 SRIR 持续存在于有限的重置位置范围内，并且我们的框架超越了双稳态。我们进一步讨论如何选择性地控制 SRIR 和 NIR。我们的工作提出了一种随机共振经典范式的新颖方法。

title: Topological Defect Statistics in a Weakly First-Order Phase Transition
abstract: The celebrated Kibble-Zurek mechanism (KZM) characterizes the nonequilibrium dynamics of second-order phase transitions and predicts universal scaling of the average number of defects with the quench time. However, the KZM is not directly applicable to first-order phase transitions, where defect formation is instead governed by nucleation processes. Here, using a Ginzburg-Landau model, we investigate the defect-number statistics in a weakly first-order phase transition. We show that the resulting statistics contain signatures of both Kibble-Zurek dynamics and nucleation, revealing the interplay between these two defect-formation mechanisms. In particular, we find that the defect-number distribution evolves from approximately Gaussian to nearly Poissonian across the crossover from the KZM regime to nucleation-dominated defect formation. While the first two cumulants are well described by a simple additive estimate of the KZM and nucleation contributions, the third cumulant exhibits a plateau and an enhancement beyond this estimate, providing a sensitive probe of the interplay between the two defect-formation mechanisms.
summary: 著名的 Kibble-Zurek 机制 (KZM) 描述了二阶相变的非平衡动力学特征，并预测了平均缺陷数量随淬火时间的普遍缩放。然而，KZM 并不直接适用于一阶相变，其中缺陷的形成是由成核过程控制的。在这里，我们使用 Ginzburg-Landau 模型研究弱一阶相变中的缺陷数统计。我们表明，所得统计数据包含 Kibble-Zurek 动力学和成核的特征，揭示了这两种缺陷形成机制之间的相互作用。特别是，我们发现，从 KZM 状态到成核主导的缺陷形成的交叉过程中，缺陷数分布从近似高斯分布演变为接近泊松分布。虽然前两个累积量可以通过 KZM 和成核贡献的简单相加估计得到很好的描述，但第三个累积量表现出一个平台期和超出此估计的增强，为两种缺陷形成机制之间的相互作用提供了灵敏的探测。

title: Valence-Selective Electrophoretic Transport in Neutral Carbon Nanotubes
abstract: Understanding how confinement alters the transport of charged molecules is central to the advancement of separation, energy, and sensing technologies. Polyamines are small, linear molecules with ionizable groups, making them an ideal model for investigating charge transport in confinement beyond monatomic ions. Using all-atom molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, we investigate how molecular length, net charge, and charge placement affect the electrophoretic transport of polyamines through single-walled carbon nanotubes (CNTs). We find that nanometer-scale confinement reverses the mobility ordering observed in free solution -- in a CNT of radius 0.68 nm, spermine (q = +4) travels more slowly than ethylamine (q = +1), contrasting with the expected scaling of mobility with valence in bulk. Further, we find that mobility decreases faster than the inverse of valence, though molecular size and length vary alongside this trend. Comparisons of doubly protonated spermidine microspecies reveal the additional influence of charge placement at fixed net valence. Upon moving one proton of dicationic spermidine from the central to a terminal nitrogen, the mobility is increased by 42%. We analyze hydration structure and solute-solvent association, identifying local-solvation differences between protonation topologies that accompany these distinct transport responses under confinement. These results suggest that neutral CNTs could support valence-selective nanofluidic transport, with additional sensitivity to molecular structure and protonation topology.
summary:
了解限制如何改变带电分子的传输对于分离、能源和传感技术的进步至关重要。多胺是具有可电离基团的小型线性分子，使其成为研究单原子离子之外的限制中的电荷传输的理想模型。利用全原子分子动力学 (MD) 模拟，我们研究了分子长度、净电荷和电荷布局如何影响多胺通过单壁碳纳米管 (CNT) 的电泳传输。我们发现，纳米级限制逆转了自由溶液中观察到的迁移率排序——在半径为 0.68 nm 的 CNT 中，精胺 (q = +4) 的移动速度比乙胺 (q = +1) 慢，这与预期的迁移率随价态的变化形成对比。此外，我们发现迁移率比价态的倒数下降得更快，尽管分子大小和长度随着这种趋势而变化。双质子化亚精胺微观物种的比较揭示了固定净价电荷放置的额外影响。将双亚精胺的一个质子从中心氮移动到末端氮后，迁移率增加了 42%。

我们分析了水合结构和溶质-溶剂关联，确定了质子化拓扑之间的局部溶剂化差异，这些差异伴随着限制下的这些不同的传输响应。这些结果表明，中性碳纳米管可以支持价态选择性纳米流体传输，并对分子结构和质子化拓扑具有额外的敏感性。

title: Unoccupied spin texture of ordered Bi films on vicinal Ge substrates
