Local theta-function algebras and their transition maps give explicit affine charts for opened (resolved) webs, extending familiar toric constructions to non-toric situations. We give a physical interpretation of the deformation parameters, in the case of one or several 7-branes, and deduce behavior under Hanany-Witten transitions and changes of tesselation.
summary: 我们基于 arXiv:2410.04714 [hep-th] 的想法，使用散射图和折线，对广义 Toric Calabi - Yau 三重进行了明确而实用的描述，它与以七膜结尾的五膜网相关。局部 theta 函数代数及其转换图为开放（解析）网络提供了显式仿射图，将熟悉的环面结构扩展到非环面情况。我们在一个或多个 7-膜的情况下给出了变形参数的物理解释，并推导出 Hanany-Witten 转变和镶嵌变化下的行为。

title: An obstruction to generalised discrete torsion in string theory
abstract: We reconsider the possibility of turning on generalised discrete torsion in orbifold compactifications, whereby different discrete torsion phases are attached to different fixed points of a given twisted sector. By an explicit inspection of the genus one and genus two vacuum amplitudes for the $T^6/\mathbb{Z}_2^2$ and $T^7/\mathbb{Z}_2^3$ cases, we show that this is not possible in String Theory. In fact, this generalised discrete torsion, although modular invariant at genus one, leads to an inconsistent interpretation of the spectrum which, in turn, implies a loss of modular invariance on genus-two Riemann surfaces. Our finding is in agreement with a recent classification of allowed topological deformations in equivariant cohomology, which does not include this possibility.
summary: 我们重新考虑在轨道折叠压缩中开启广义离散扭转的可能性，其中不同的离散扭转相位被附加到给定扭转扇区的不同固定点。通过对 $T^6/\mathbb{Z}_2^2$ 和 $T^7/\mathbb{Z}_2^3$ 情况的属一和属二真空振幅的显式检查，我们表明这在弦理论中是不可能的。事实上，这种广义离散挠率虽然在属一处具有模不变性，但会导致谱的解释不一致，这反过来又意味着在属二黎曼曲面上失去了模不变性。我们的发现与最近对等变上同调中允许的拓扑变形的分类一致，该分类不包括这种可能性。

title: The pinning-field line defect at finite temperature
abstract: We study the pinning-field line defect in the critical $\mathrm{O}(N)$ model at finite temperature, describing a static symmetry-breaking impurity at a quantum critical point. Using the operator product expansion (OPE), analyticity, and thermal periodicity, we construct a manifestly periodic expansion relating heavy-operator asymptotics to low-lying thermal OPE data. We determine thermal correlators and one-point coefficients in the $\varepsilon$-expansion and, combining these results with the two-dimensional Ising endpoint, obtain the Padé estimate $\langle \hat{\phi} \rangle \sim 1.701/\beta^{\smash{\hat{\Delta}_{\smash{\hat{\phi}}}}}$ for the lowest defect operator in the three-dimensional Ising model. We conjecture that truncating the periodic OPE to a few low-lying operators accurately approximates defect correlators. To test this, we numerically solve the large-$N$ thermal saddle and extract defect one-point coefficients across $2<d<4$. In three dimensions, we compute the tilt and longitudinal singlet two-point functions, finding very good agreement with the periodic OPE truncated to the identity and lowest singlet. Finally, we extend the analysis to finite spatial volume using antipodal defects on the sphere.
summary:
我们研究了有限温度下临界 $\mathrm{O}(N)$ 模型中的钉扎场线缺陷，描述了量子临界点处的静态对称性破缺杂质。使用算子乘积展开 (OPE)、解析性和热周期性，我们构造了一个明显的周期性展开，将重算子渐近与低位热 OPE 数据相关联。我们确定 $\varepsilon$ 展开中的热相关器和单点系数，并将这些结果与二维 Ising 端点相结合，获得三维 Ising 模型中最低缺陷算子的 Padé 估计 $\langle \hat{\phi} \rangle \sim 1.701/\beta^{\smash{\hat{\Delta}_{\smash{\hat{\phi}}}}}$。我们推测，将周期性 OPE 截断为几个低位算子可以准确地近似缺陷相关器。为了测试这一点，我们对大 $N$ 热鞍进行数值求解，并提取 $2<d<4$ 范围内的缺陷单点系数。在三个维度中，我们计算了倾斜和纵向单线态两点函数，发现与截断为恒等和最低单线态的周期性 OPE 非常吻合。

最后，我们使用球体上的对映缺陷将分析扩展到有限空间体积。

title: A local action for Kodaira--Spencer gravity
abstract: A local action is given for Kodaira--Spencer gravity by solving a constraint on the complex structure deformation of a Calabi--Yau threefold in terms of a $(1,1)$ form as the new gravity field. The gauge algebra becomes a genuine $L_{\infty}$ algebra based on a Courant algebroid, while the gravity field and its linearized gauge transformations coincide with those of double field theory. On a real three-dimensional slice, the free action reduces to the Fierz--Pauli action for massless spin-2 plus the Kalb--Ramond action for a B-field. Non-linearly, the theory carries parity-odd interactions with three derivatives, and it is gauge invariant without a level-matching constraint, in this sense defining an unconstrained double field theory. The full theory is encoded in a cyclic $L_{\infty}$ algebra, for which a double copy interpretation is given.
summary: 通过求解 Calabi-Yau 复杂结构变形的约束，以 $(1,1)$ 形式作为新的重力场，给出了 Kodaira-Spencer 重力的局部作用。规范代数成为基于库朗代数体的真正的$L_{\infty}$代数，而重力场及其线性化规范变换与双场论的一致。在真实的三维切片上，自由作用减少为无质量自旋 2 的 Fierz-Pauli 作用加上 B 场的 Kalb-Ramond 作用。非线性的是，该理论与三个导数具有奇偶校验相互作用，并且它是规范不变的，没有水平匹配约束，从这个意义上定义了无约束的双场理论。完整的理论被编码在循环 $L_{\infty}$ 代数中，并给出了双拷贝解释。

title: Reconstructing string dualities through symmetries of moduli spaces
abstract: We perform a bottom-up analysis of the possible duality descriptions characterizing the perturbative regimes associated to the asymptotic regions of quantum gravity moduli spaces. Our approach relies on the symmetries of such moduli spaces as scalar manifolds, as well as the Emergent String Conjecture, which constrains the possible towers of states becoming light, and thus the interpretation of the dual theories emerging at infinite distance. For supergravity theories with 32 and 16 supercharges, our reconstruction uniquely matches those duality frames associated to top-down toroidal compactifications of M-theory/Type II string theory and heterotic string theory, respectively. For theories with less supersymmetry, moduli spaces exhibit fewer symmetries, and quantum corrections can render certain directions of the classical moduli space inaccessible; nonetheless, we are still able to constrain the possible arrangements of dualities. While these are mostly realized by known top-down constructions, there are some intriguing additional possibilities which might lay in unexplored corners of the string landscape.
summary: 我们对可能的对偶描述进行了自下而上的分析，描述了与量子引力模空间渐近区域相关的微扰状态。我们的方法依赖于标量流形等模空间的对称性，以及涌现弦猜想，它限制了可能的状态塔变成光，从而限制了在无限距离处出现的对偶理论的解释。对于具有 32 和 16 个增压的超重力理论，我们的重建分别独特地匹配与 M 理论/II 型弦理论和异质弦理论的自上而下环形紧化相关的对偶框架。对于超对称性较少的理论，模空间表现出较少的对称性，并且量子校正可以使经典模空间的某些方向变得不可访问；尽管如此，我们仍然能够限制二元性的可能安排。虽然这些大多是通过已知的自上而下的结构来实现的，但在弦乐景观的未探索的角落中可能存在一些有趣的额外可能性。

title: 5d SCFTs and Intersection Theory of Generalized Toric Threefolds
abstract: Five-dimensional superconformal field theories are intrinsically strongly coupled fixed points that can be realized as M-theory on local Calabi-Yau threefolds with canonical singularities. The low-energy effective theory on their extended Coulomb branch is governed by a cubic prepotential, determined by the triple intersection numbers of divisors in the resolved geometry. For toric threefolds, dual to 5-brane webs, these numbers are computed combinatorially from the toric polygon. However, no such description has been available for generalized toric polygons (GTPs), dual to 5-brane webs with 7-branes, since the corresponding generalized toric Calabi-Yau threefolds are generally non-toric. We show that the 7-brane data are encoded by additional lines in the GTP, which correspond to non-toric, non-compact divisors that we call exuberant divisors. Building on a local analysis of these divisors and on the associativity of the intersection product, we develop an algorithm that computes the triple intersection numbers, and hence the prepotential, directly from the combinatorial data of the GTP. We illustrate it in examples and provide a Mathematica code implementation of the intersection algorithm.
summary:
五维超共形场论本质上是强耦合不动点，可以实现为具有正则奇点的局部 Calabi-Yau 三重的 M 理论。扩展库仑分支的低能有效理论由三次预势控制，三次预势由解析几何中除数的三重交集数决定。对于三重环面、双膜到五膜网，这些数字是根据环面多边形组合计算的。然而，对于广义复曲面多边形（GTP）、具有 7 膜的双膜至 5 膜网，还没有这样的描述，因为相应的广义复曲面 Calabi-Yau 三重通常是非复曲面。我们证明了 7 膜数据是由 GTP 中的附加线编码的，这些附加线对应于我们称为旺盛除数的非复曲面、非紧除数。基于对这些除数的局部分析和交集积的关联性，我们开发了一种算法，可以直接根据 GTP 的组合数据计算三重交集数，从而计算预势。

我们通过示例进行说明，并提供交集算法的 Mathematica 代码实现。

title: Wilsonian exact renormalization group flow in the gauged Nambu--Jona-Lasinio model
abstract: We study the Wilsonian exact renormalization group flow of the gauged Nambu--Jona-Lasinio (NJL) model, a four-dimensional $U(1)$ gauge theory with chirally invariant four-Fermi interactions, by using the gradient flow exact renormalization group~(GFERG). Our gauge-invariant ansatz (truncation) for the 1PI Wilson action keeps a general photon kinetic function~$\mathcal{K}_\tau(k^2)$, the fermion mass, and the scalar and vector four-Fermi couplings. For a fixed gauge coupling~$e^2$, the Gaussian and NJL (quasi-)fixed points on the critical surface merge at~$e_c^2\simeq17$, as anticipated by the ladder Schwinger--Dyson equation and the conventional Wilsonian renormalization group. We then let $e^2$ itself flow. Owing to the manifest gauge invariance of the GFERG, the flow of~$e^2$ is governed solely by the photon anomalous dimension~$\gamma_A$, which remains positive along both branches up to the merging point. Hence, no fixed point with~$e^2\neq0$ exists. Flows from a sufficiently large~$e^2$ in the ultraviolet (UV) reach the chirally broken phase even for vanishing four-Fermi couplings, so the gauge interaction does trigger chiral symmetry breaking. The merging point, however, is not a fixed point, and the gauge coupling vanishes in any continuum limit within our truncation.
summary:
我们通过使用梯度流精确重正化群~(GFERG)，研究了规范的 Nambu--Jona-Lasinio (NJL) 模型的威尔逊精确重整化群流，这是一种具有手性不变四费米相互作用的四维 $U(1)$ 规范理论。我们的 1PI Wilson 作用的规范不变 ansatz（截断）保留了一般光子动力学函数 ~$\mathcal{K}_\tau(k^2)$、费米子质量以及标量和矢量四费米耦合。对于固定规范耦合 ~$e^2$，临界面上的高斯和 NJL（准）固定点在 ~$e_c^2\simeq17$ 处合并，正如阶梯 Schwinger-Dyson 方程和传统威尔逊重正化群所预期的那样。然后我们让 $e^2$ 本身流动。由于 GFERG 明显的规范不变性，~$e^2$ 的流动仅由光子反常维度~$\gamma_A$ 控制，该维度沿着两个分支直到合并点都保持正值。因此，不存在 ~$e^2\neq0$ 的不动点。即使对于消失的四费米耦合，来自足够大的〜$e^2$的紫外（UV）流也会达到手性破缺相，因此规范相互作用确实会触发手性对称性破缺。

然而，合并点不是固定点，并且规范耦合在我们的截断范围内的任何连续统极限中消失。

title: Doubly-periodic instanton via the ADHM method and the self-dual monopole-center vortex chain
abstract: Calorons, i.e., instantons on $\mathbb{R}^3\times S^1$, with nontrivial asymptotic holonomy decompose into $N$ fundamental monopole constituents. This suggests that a doubly-periodic Yang--Mills instanton on $\mathbb{R}^2\times T^2$ may admit a description in terms of a periodic array of monopole constituents. Starting from the Atiyah--Drinfeld--Hitchin--Manin (ADHM) construction, we derive the $2$d Abelian Hitchin system with impurities as a dual description of the doubly-periodic instanton. We then give a prescription for reconstructing the instanton from the Green's function of this system, assuming a scaling ansatz for the ultraviolet divergences induced by the delta-function impurities. In the far-field limit with strongly anisotropic torus periods, we extend the analysis of Bruckmann and van Baal for multi-calorons and identify an alternating chain of BPS and Kaluza--Klein (KK) monopole constituents: The monopole-center vortex chain arises from the non-Abelian self-dual field especially when an 't Hooft twist cuts the torus into the $1/N$ fragment.
summary: 卡洛子，即 $\mathbb{R}^3\times S^1$ 上的瞬子，具有非平凡的渐近完整分解为 $N$ 基本单极子成分。这表明 $\mathbb{R}^2\times T^2$ 上的双周期 Yang--Mills 瞬子可以接受单极子成分周期阵列的描述。从 Atiyah--Drinfeld--Hitchin-Manin (ADHM) 结构开始，我们推导出带杂质的 $2$d 阿贝尔希钦系统作为双周期瞬子的对偶描述。然后，我们给出了根据该系统的格林函数重建瞬子的处方，假设由δ函数杂质引起的紫外线发散的缩放模拟。在具有强各向异性环面周期的远场极限中，我们扩展了 Bruckmann 和 van Baal 对多热量的分析，并确定了 BPS 和 Kaluza-Klein (KK) 单极子成分的交替链：单极子中心涡旋链源自非阿贝尔自对偶场，特别是当 't Hooft 扭曲将环面切割成 $1/N$ 片段时。

title: A note on the quantization of M2-branes on local Calabi-Yau manifolds
abstract: In this note we present a detailed computation of the BPS states from M2-branes wrapping 2-cycles in local Calabi-Yau manifolds, at the level of brane quantization. For the cases of local Calabi-Yau threefolds, the supersymmetric quantum mechanics is the 1d $\mathcal{N}=4$ non-linear sigma model. We achieve systematic, physical interpretations of refined Gopakumar-Vafa (GV) invariants, first for the curve classes with fixed geometric genus, and then for curves whose geometric genus jumps. The BPS states of 5d $\mathcal{N}=1$ superconformal field theories are interpreted from the local geometries, which are presented in a number of case studies. In particular, we compute the refined GV invariants for generalized conifolds, local CY3 giving 5d $\mathcal{N}=1$ gauge theories and a singularity whose crepant resolution contains a singular divisor. For the cases of local Calabi-Yau fourfolds, we point out the supersymmetric quantum mechanics is of type $\mathcal{N}=2B$. We set up the framework for studying M2-branes wrapping 2-cycles, and discuss a few cases of M2-brane wrapping genus-0 curves with this new approach.
summary: 在这篇文章中，我们在膜量化水平上详细计算了在局部 Calabi-Yau 流形中包裹 2 个周期的 M2 膜的 BPS 状态。对于局域 Calabi-Yau 三重的情况，超对称量子力学是 1d $\mathcal{N}=4$ 非线性 sigma 模型。我们对精致的 Gopakumar-Vafa (GV) 不变量进行了系统的物理解释，首先是对于具有固定几何亏格的曲线类，然后是对于几何亏格跳跃的曲线。 5d $\mathcal{N}=1$ 超共形场论的 BPS 状态是从局部几何结构解释的，这些几何结构在许多案例研究中都有介绍。特别是，我们计算了广义锥折的精化 GV 不变量，局部 CY3 给出了 5d $\mathcal{N}=1$ 规范理论和奇点，其 Crepant 分辨率包含奇异除数。对于局部卡拉比-丘四重的情况，我们指出超对称量子力学的类型为$\mathcal{N}=2B$。我们建立了研究 M2 膜包裹 2 周期的框架，并讨论了使用这种新方法的 M2 膜包裹 genus-0 曲线的一些情况。

title: Quantum Black Holes in Non-Linear Electrodynamics
abstract: Techniques of AdS/CFT correspondence and braneworld holography have proven to be a useful tool for solving the problem of semi-classical gravity where quantum matter provides the back-reaction to classical spacetime geometry. In this paper, we apply this approach to Einstein gravity coupled to RegMax nonlinear electrodynamics and construct novel type of charged quantum black holes. We then discuss their thermodynamics and horizon structure.
summary: AdS/CFT 对应和膜世界全息技术已被证明是解决半经典引力问题的有用工具，其中量子物质为经典时空几何提供了反作用。在本文中，我们将这种方法应用于与 RegMax 非线性电动力学耦合的爱因斯坦引力，并构建了新型的带电量子黑洞。然后我们讨论它们的热力学和层位结构。

title: Chiral magnetic wave and axial charge relaxation in flavor branes
abstract: We investigate the chiral magnetic wave and axial charge relaxation in the chiral symmetry broken phase of the holographic D3/D7 model with massless quarks, where the axial charge in the flavor sector can relax through transfer to the adjoint sector in the probe limit. We find that the dispersion relations of the quasi-normal modes are well described by the phenomenological expression for the chiral magnetic wave when the relaxation rate is small. We then determine how this rate depends on vector charge density and the chiral condensate. At higher temperatures, it increases with charge density and decreases with increasing condensate, while these dependences become non-monotonic at lower temperatures. These results show that the phenomenological description of the chiral magnetic wave also applies in the chiral symmetry broken phase in the quasi-hydrodynamic regime.
summary: 我们研究了无质量夸克全息 D3/D7 模型的手性对称破缺相中的手性磁波和轴向电荷弛豫，其中味道扇区中的轴向电荷可以通过转移到探测极限中的伴随扇区来弛豫。我们发现，当弛豫率较小时，手性磁波的唯象表达式很好地描述了准正规模的色散关系。然后我们确定该速率如何取决于矢量电荷密度和手性凝聚。在较高温度下，它随着电荷密度的增加而增加，并随着凝结物的增加而减少，而在较低温度下这些依赖性变得非单调。这些结果表明，手性磁波的现象学描述也适用于准流体动力学体系中的手性对称破缺相。

title: Quasinormal Modes Criticality across Black Hole Extremality
abstract: We investigate the extremal solution branch to nonextremal branch transition in Einstein-Euler-Heisenberg anti-de Sitter black holes, where the nonlinear electromagnetic parameter $\lambda$ governs the existence of the extremal branch solution. At fixed pressure and charge, extremal black hole only exist for $\lambda\leq\lambda_c$. For $\lambda>\lambda_c$, the lowest Hawking temperature keeps nonzero. Near this threshold, the lowest temperature follows a linear critical scaling, $T_{\min}\propto(\lambda-\lambda_c)^{\alpha_T}$. We investigate the corresponding dynamical behavior by computing the quasinormal modes of a massless scalar perturbation along the lowest-temperature black hole branch. As the critical threshold is approached, two complex-frequency quasinormal modes branches collide on the imaginary axis and reorganize into distinct purely imaginary branches. Then the imaginary parts of these modes, together with higher overtones, reach zero at the critical threshold, described by $\Gamma_n\propto(\lambda-\lambda_c)^{\alpha_n}$, with $\alpha_n\simeq\alpha_T$. The resulting zero-damped modes become increasingly localized near the event horizon, and their relative damping rates closely follow the overtone spacing predicted by the near-horizon AdS$_2$ spectrum. Our results show that the thermodynamic and dynamical critical behavior remain closely connected even when extremal black hole solutions cease to exist, providing further evidence for the relevance of near-extremal spectral behavior in this distinct critical regime.
summary:
我们研究了爱因斯坦-欧拉-海森堡反德西特黑洞中的极值分支到非极值分支的转变，其中非线性电磁参数 $\lambda$ 控制极值分支解的存在。在固定压力和电荷下，极值黑洞仅存在于$\lambda\leq\lambda_c$。对于 $\lambda>\lambda_c$，最低霍金温度保持非零。接近该阈值时，最低温度遵循线性临界缩放 $T_{\min}\propto(\lambda-\lambda_c)^{\alpha_T}$。我们通过计算沿最低温度黑洞分支的无质量标量扰动的拟正态模式来研究相应的动力学行为。当接近临界阈值时，两个复频拟正规模式分支在虚轴上碰撞并重新组织成不同的纯虚分支。然后这些模式的虚部与更高的泛音一起在临界阈值处达到零，由 $\Gamma_n\propto(\lambda-\lambda_c)^{\alpha_n}$ 和 $\alpha_n\simeq\alpha_T$ 描述。

由此产生的零阻尼模式在事件视界附近变得越来越局域化，并且它们的相对阻尼率密切遵循近视界 AdS$_2$ 频谱预测的泛音间隔。我们的结果表明，即使极值黑洞解不再存在，热力学和动力学临界行为仍然密切相关，这为这种独特临界状态下近极值光谱行为的相关性提供了进一步的证据。

title: An Amplitudes Approach to Spinning Black Hole Scattering
abstract: The detection of gravitational waves has opened a new era of precision studies of gravity, demanding advances in our understanding of compact binary dynamics. Scattering amplitudes provide a powerful framework for studying these systems using methods from high-energy physics. In this thesis, we study classical black hole scattering, systematically including spin---an important feature of real astrophysical systems---to describe Kerr black hole dynamics. We model Kerr black holes as massive point particles in finite-spin representations and compute their scattering dynamics perturbatively. We resolve an ambiguity mixing classical and quantum contributions using our spin interpolation method, obtaining a classical amplitude for Kerr black hole scattering through quartic order in spin at third post-Minkowskian order. From this amplitude, we extract the gauge-invariant radial action, enabling the computation of classical non-aligned-spin observables---such as the linear and angular impulses---using covariant Dirac brackets. The amplitude exhibits spin-shift symmetry, remaining invariant under a shift of the black hole spin by the momentum transfer. Motivated by this property, we study the conserved quantities governing the scattering process and show that the dynamics of a probe black hole remains integrable at asymptotic infinity through quartic order in probe spin. Finally, we show that the quartic-in-spin radial action for a probe black hole in a Kerr background, at any order in perturbation theory, is completely fixed by the aligned-spin dynamics, provided that it satisfies asymptotic integrability and spin-shift symmetry.
summary:
引力波的探测开启了重力精确研究的新时代，要求我们进一步加深对紧凑二元动力学的理解。散射振幅为使用高能物理学方法研究这些系统提供了强大的框架。在本论文中，我们研究了经典的黑洞散射，系统地包括自旋——真实天体物理系统的一个重要特征——来描述克尔黑洞动力学。我们将克尔黑洞建模为有限自旋表示中的大质量点粒子，并扰动地计算它们的散射动力学。我们使用自旋插值方法解决了混合经典和量子贡献的模糊性，获得了克尔黑洞在第三后闵可夫斯基阶自旋中通过四次阶散射的经典振幅。从这个振幅中，我们提取了规范不变的径向作用，从而能够使用协变狄拉克括号来计算经典的非对齐自旋可观测量（例如线性和角脉冲）。振幅表现出自旋位移对称性，在动量转移引起的黑洞自旋位移下保持不变。

受这一性质的启发，我们研究了控制散射过程的守恒量，并表明探测黑洞的动力学通过探测自旋的四次阶在渐近无穷大处保持可积。最后，我们证明了克尔背景中探测黑洞的四次自旋径向作用，在微扰理论中的任何阶上，都完全由对齐自旋动力学固定，只要它满足渐近可积性和自旋位移对称性。

title: Summing over Seifert Manifolds in Narain Ensemble Averages
abstract: The ensemble average of Narain conformal field theories over their moduli space is a real-analytic Eisenstein series, whose Poincaré expansion can be interpreted as a sum over lens spaces weighted by the partition functions of Abelian Chern-Simons theory. In this paper we extend this correspondence from lens spaces to Seifert manifolds, which gives an example of a restricted sum over topologies of the kind that arises in three-dimensional quantum gravity. A Seifert manifold is obtained from a fixed core, a punctured surface times a circle, by gluing solid tori to its boundary tori, and we place a copy of the Narain theory on each of these tori. The ensemble average supplies the sum over the solid tori, or more precisely over marked presentations with fixed base genus, number of fibers and integer Seifert invariant. The resulting sum converges absolutely and is a polynomial in the components of the vector-valued Eisenstein series. When all the boundary tori share a single modulus, the average acquires connected corrections, which we identify with wormholes gluing the core to itself; for two boundary tori, the terms with rational Lagrangian sublattices of the Siegel-Eisenstein series are realized by wormholes containing an exceptional fiber. After reduction along the fiber, the construction closely parallels the two-dimensional topological gravity of Marolf and Maxfield, with the base of the fibration playing the role of their spacetime. We also discuss Dehn fillings of 3-manifolds with torus boundary, non-orientable bases, and the surgery formula. Our results suggest that modularity could be an organizing principle in the summation of geometries in quantum gravity.
summary:
纳拉因共形场论在其模空间上的系综平均值是实解析爱森斯坦级数，其庞加莱展开可以解释为由阿贝尔陈-西蒙斯理论的配分函数加权的透镜空间上的总和。在本文中，我们将这种对应关系从透镜空间扩展到 Seifert 流形，这给出了三维量子引力中出现的那种拓扑上的受限和的例子。塞弗特流形是通过将实心圆环粘合到其边界圆环上，从固定核心、穿孔表面乘以圆获得的，并且我们在每个圆环上放置了纳拉因理论的副本。整体平均值提供了实体环面的总和，或者更准确地说，提供了具有固定基属、纤维数量和整数 Seifert 不变量的标记表示的总和。所得总和绝对收敛，并且是向量值爱森斯坦级数的分量中的多项式。

当所有边界圆环共享一个模数时，平均值会获得相关的校正，我们将其识别为将核心粘合到自身的虫洞；对于两个边界环面，西格尔-爱森斯坦级数的有理拉格朗日亚晶格项是通过包含特殊纤维的虫洞来实现的。沿纤维还原后，该结构与马洛夫和麦克斯菲尔德的二维拓扑引力紧密平行，纤维化的基础扮演了时空的角色。我们还讨论了具有环面边界、不可定向基底的 3 流形的 Dehn 填充以及手术公式。我们的结果表明，模块化可能是量子引力几何求和的组织原则。

title: Thermal Festina Lente
abstract: According to the Festina Lente bound, particles charged under a $U(1)$ gauge field cannot be too light. Otherwise, the largest charged black holes of de Sitter space would discharge in a way that leads to a crunching singularity in violation of cosmic censorship. The Festina Lente bound has previously been extended to also include a background of thermal radiation, but where vacuum energy still dominates cosmic evolution, which imposes a maximal temperature $T\leq T_{\max}=(cV/\sigma)^{1/4}$. We extend this analysis by accounting for thermal enhancement of the discharge process and making the analysis more quantitative. The result is a bound $m\gtrsim\ell (cV/\sigma)^{1/4}$ on the masses of charged particles. Here, $\ell$ is a term that depends logarithmically on the gauge coupling and particle charge. At weak coupling this leads to a significantly stronger constraint than the $\sqrt{gq}$ scaling of the original Festina Lente bound. As a result, the present vacuum energy requires every particle of charge $10^{-26}\lesssim gq\lesssim e$ to be heavier than $0.03$--$0.2$ eV, provided its gauge boson is lighter than the Hubble scale. An unbroken gauged $B-L$ with Dirac neutrinos gives $m_{\nu,{\rm lightest}}\gtrsim10$--$43$ meV for $10^{-29}\lesssim g_{B-L}\lesssim10^{-24}$, in tension with the DESI DR2 limit once $g_{B-L}\gtrsim7\times10^{-28}$. The same limit bounds a neutrino millicharge to $\epsilon_\nu\lesssim2\times10^{-27}$. We also revisit the Standard Model effective field theory constraints from the electroweak phase transition. During slow-roll inflation the Standard Model electron violates the bound over the whole range of Hubble rates allowed by the CMB tensor limit and by nucleosynthesis, unless the photon is Higgsed, its coupling is suppressed, or one considers very fine-tuned versions of Higgs inflation.
summary:
根据 Festina Lente 约束，在 $U(1)$ 规范场下带电的粒子不能太轻。否则，德西特空间中最大的带电黑洞会以一种违反宇宙审查制度的方式放电，导致奇点破裂。 Festina Lente 边界之前已扩展到包括热辐射背景，但真空能量仍然主导宇宙演化，这会施加最大温度 $T\leq T_{\max}=(cV/\sigma)^{1/4}$。我们通过考虑放电过程的热增强并使分析更加定量来扩展此分析。结果是带电粒子质量上的绑定 $m\gtrsim\ell (cV/\sigma)^{1/4}$。这里，$\ell$ 是一个对数依赖于规范耦合和粒子电荷的项。在弱耦合下，这会导致比原始 Festina Lente 边界的 $\sqrt{gq}$ 缩放明显更强的约束。因此，当前的真空能量要求每个电荷粒子 $10^{-26}\lesssim gq\lesssim e$ 重于 $0.03$--$0.2$ eV，前提是其规范玻色子比哈勃尺度轻。

狄拉克中微子的完整测量$B-L$给出$m_{\nu,{\rm最轻}}\gtrsim10$--$43$ meV，$10^{-29}\lesssim g_{B-L}\lesssim10^{-24}$，与DESI DR2极限有一次张力$g_{B-L}\gtrsim7\times10^{-28}$。同样的限制将中微子毫电荷限制为 $\epsilon_\nu\lesssim2\times10^{-27}$。我们还重新审视了电弱相变的标准模型有效场论约束。在慢滚膨胀过程中，标准模型电子违反了 CMB 张量极限和核合成所允许的整个哈勃速率范围的界限，除非光子是希格斯粒子，其耦合被抑制，或者人们认为希格斯膨胀的非常微调的版本。

title: No smooth real instanton saddles in self-dual Yang-Mills on AdS$_4$
abstract: In the self-dual limit of Yang-Mills theory on Euclidean AdS$_4$ studied by Heuveline, Ruzziconi, Sheta and Strominger, the boundary condition of the second-order action becomes vacuous, but the boundary equation of the first-order action is non-trivial. We show that, with this equation, the vacuum is the only saddle with a real gauge field when both fields are smooth up to the conformal boundary, for any compact gauge group. In particular, the self-dual solutions of Sarioglu and Tekin (2009) are not saddles; we also correct their charges, which omitted a surface term at the conformal boundary. Complex saddles and singular limits remain open.
summary: Heuveline、Ruzziconi、Sheta 和 Strominger 研究的欧几里得 AdS$_4$ 的 Yang-Mills 理论的自对偶极限中，二阶作用的边界条件变得空洞，但一阶作用的边界方程是非平凡的。我们证明，通过这个方程，对于任何紧凑规范组，当两个场都平滑到共形边界时，真空是唯一具有真实规范场的鞍座。特别是，Sarioglu 和 Tekin (2009) 的自对偶解不是鞍座；我们还纠正了它们的电荷，这省略了共形边界处的表面项。复杂的鞍座和单一的限制仍然开放。

title: General Form Factors from String Amplitudes
abstract: We extend the string-amplitude construction of single-insertion form factors to multiple operator insertions carrying independent off-shell momenta. By deforming the bulk closed-string punctures onto the open-string boundary, we establish a relation between stringy general form factors and scattering amplitudes. Using this relation, we evaluate the field-theory limit and find that the resulting form factors receive contributions from both separate operator insertions and local contact terms. Furthermore, we uncover several hidden structures of stringy general form factors at finite $\alpha'$: $2$-splits and hidden zeros analogous to those of scattering amplitudes, bulk zeros specific to form factors, and a decoupling split unique to multiple insertions.
summary: 我们将单插入形状因子的弦振幅结构扩展到携带独立离壳动量的多个算子插入。通过将大量闭弦穿孔变形到开弦边界上，我们建立了弦一般形状因数和散射幅度之间的关系。使用这种关系，我们评估了场论极限，并发现所得的形状因子受到单独算子插入和局部接触项的贡献。此外，我们还发现了有限 $\alpha'$ 处的弦状一般形状因子的几个隐藏结构：$2$ 分割和类似于散射幅度的隐藏零、特定于形状因子的块零以及对多次插入特有的解耦分割。

title: A Matrix View of Holographic Null-State Equations in $d\geq 2$
abstract: We show that the null-state-type partial differential equations recently derived from AdS gravity with a black hole can be efficiently organized using finite-dimensional matrices with systematic off-diagonal structures. This matrix formulation generates an infinite tower of CFT differential equations at arbitrary levels. The $d=2$ matrix reproduces a known result based on Virasoro null-state vectors at large central charge and admits an algebraic representation in terms of a linear combination of the identity matrix and $\mathfrak{sl}_2$ generators, with a heavy-state deformation encoding the central charge contribution. The $d=4$ governing matrix exhibits a similar yet richer structure involving products of $\mathfrak{sl}_2$ generators. We also discuss recursion relations and factorized product structures associated with these holographic differential equations.
summary: 我们证明，最近从黑洞 AdS 引力导出的零态型偏微分方程可以使用具有系统非对角结构的有限维矩阵有效地组织。该矩阵公式生成任意级别的无限 CFT 微分方程塔。 $d=2$ 矩阵根据大中心电荷处的 Virasoro 零状态向量再现已知结果，并允许以单位矩阵和 $\mathfrak{sl}_2$ 生成器的线性组合形式表示代数表示，并使用重状态变形编码中心电荷贡献。 $d=4$ 控制矩阵表现出类似但更丰富的结构，涉及 $\mathfrak{sl}_2$ 生成器的乘积。我们还讨论了与这些全息微分方程相关的递归关系和分解乘积结构。

title: The generalized entropy in holographic semiclassical de Sitter spacetime
abstract: We consider generalized de Sitter entropy which includes both entanglement entropy of the strongly coupled quantum field and the gravitational Wald entropy in the framework of holographic semiclassical gravity. The quantum corrected de Sitter spacetime is constructed perturbatively by considering static deformations of the classical solution. By applying the Noether charge formula to our semiclassical model, we show that both the renormalized entropies remain finite without introducing a cutoff, even when the bulk AdS gravitational field does not satisfy the Dirichlet boundary condition. We show that the first order variation of the generalized entropy with respect to the de Sitter horizon always vanishes when the conformal boundary metric is promoted to a dynamical variable.
summary: 我们考虑广义德西特熵，它包括强耦合量子场的纠缠熵和全息半经典引力框架中的引力瓦尔德熵。通过考虑经典解的静态变形，微扰地构造量子校正的德西特时空。通过将诺特电荷公式应用于我们的半经典模型，我们表明，即使当体 AdS 引力场不满足狄利克雷边界条件时，重整化熵仍然是有限的，而不引入截止。我们证明，当共形边界度量提升为动态变量时，广义熵相对于德西特视界的一阶变化总是消失。

title: Transgression branes in seven dimensions
abstract: A seven dimensional theory with branes, described by a Transgression Action is investigated. The theory has special properties owing to the factorization of the trace used to define the Transgression form. It is shown that in some cases the theory is similar to the models of branes proposed by Nepomechie, Wu and Zee as a higher dimensional generalization of models of particles with fractional statistics of Wilczek, Wu and Zee. Static Euclidean solutions are presented, and compared with similar solutions of Nepomechie,Wu and Zee. Then Lorentzian static solutions are considered, based in solutions of constant curvature black holes presented by Bañados and further studied by Guilleminot, Olea and Petrov. Topological phases and their implications for quantum statistics are discussed.
summary: 研究了由越界行为描述的七维膜理论。由于用于定义越界形式的迹因式分解，该理论具有特殊性质。结果表明，在某些情况下，该理论类似于 Nepomechie、Wu 和 Zee 提出的膜模型，作为具有 Wilczek、Wu 和 Zee 分数统计的粒子模型的高维推广。给出了静态欧氏解，并与Nepomechie、Wu和Zee的类似解进行了比较。然后考虑洛伦兹静态解，基于 Bañados 提出的常曲率黑洞解，并由 Guilleminot、Olea 和 Petrov 进一步研究。讨论了拓扑相及其对量子统计的影响。

title: Higher Groupoids of Gauge Potentials in Higher Gauge Theories admitting Weights
abstract: We construct an explicit small model for the $\infty$-groupoid of null-concordances of higher gauge curvatures by algorithmically trivializing their nonlinear Bianchi identities. More precisely, for a finite-type Sullivan minimal Bianchi algebra equipped with positive integer weights, we organize weighted potentials and higher gauge parameters at each fixed curvature into an $\infty$-groupoid whose gauge transformations are linear in the parameters. We prove that this model is naturally equivalent to the $\infty$-groupoid of null-concordances through an intermediate total-form model, with explicit projection and section maps and simplicial homotopies. When nonempty, its connected components form a torsor for the degree-zero cohomology of an associated weighted gauge complex, and its higher homotopy groups are computed by the higher cohomology of this complex.
summary: 我们通过算法对非线性 Bianchi 恒等式进行平凡化，为更高规范曲率的零一致性的 $\infty$-groupoid 构建了一个显式小模型。更准确地说，对于配备正整数权重的有限型沙利文最小比安奇代数，我们将每个固定曲率处的加权势和更高的规范参数组织成 $\infty$-groupoid，其规范变换在参数中是线性的。我们通过具有显式投影和剖面图以及单纯同伦的中间总体形式模型证明该模型自然等价于零索引的 $\infty$-groupoid。当非空时，其连通分量形成关联的加权规范复形的零度上同调的torsor，并且其较高同伦群由该复形的较高上同调计算。

title: Universality and Emergent Classicality in Krylov Space
abstract: Krylov complexity grows linearly at late times for many systems. In this regime, we give a general spectral formula for the leading growth coefficients of Krylov complexity and its higher moments, without requiring detailed knowledge of the Lanczos coefficients. For states with a narrow energy distribution compared to the bandwidth, dynamics in the Krylov basis resembles motion along a classical trajectory. We demonstrate our results for the critical XY chain and double-scaled SYK. For the latter, we compute the leading late-time behavior of the chord-number moments through one-loop order.
summary: 对于许多系统来说，克雷洛夫复杂度在后期会线性增长。在这种情况下，我们给出了 Krylov 复杂度及其更高矩的主要增长系数的通用谱公式，而不需要兰佐斯系数的详细知识。对于与带宽相比能量分布较窄的状态，克雷洛夫基的动力学类似于沿经典轨迹的运动。我们展示了关键 XY 链和双尺度 SYK 的结果。对于后者，我们通过单循环顺序计算弦数矩的主导后期行为。

title: What crossing symmetry forbids just above $c=1$
abstract: What does a unitary two-dimensional conformal field theory look like just above $c=1$? Using the numerical conformal bootstrap, we study the four-point function of a scalar Virasoro primary $\phi$ such that no primary lighter than $\phi$ appears in its operator product expansion with itself. Slightly above $c=1$, crossing symmetry excludes the interval $0.17\lesssim\Delta_\phi\lesssim1$, although the compact boson realizes every such $\Delta_\phi$ at $c=1$. Combining this exclusion with results from the modular bootstrap, we show that the lightest primary of a compact unitary conformal field theory at $c=1.0005$ or $1.001$ has dimension $\Delta_{\rm gap}<0.17$. Further from $c=1$, the largest excluded central charge at fixed $\Delta_\phi$ has two sharp minima near $\Delta_\phi=1/2$ and $4/7$. At these values it lies within $2\times10^{-7}$ of $c=8/7$, where the $\mathbb{Z}_5$ parafermion and its charge-conjugation orbifold have scalars of exactly these dimensions.
summary: $c=1$ 上方的酉二维共形场论是什么样子？使用数值共形自举，我们研究了标量 Virasoro 初级 $\phi$ 的四点函数，使得在其算子乘积展开中不会出现比 $\phi$ 更轻的初级。略高于 $c=1$，交叉对称性排除了区间 $0.17\lesssim\Delta_\phi\lesssim1$，尽管紧致玻色子在 $c=1$ 处实现了每个这样的 $\Delta_\phi$。将此排除与模块化自举的结果相结合，我们表明在 $c=1.0005$ 或 $1.001$ 处紧致酉共形场论的最轻初级具有维度 $\Delta_{\rm gap}<0.17$。进一步从 $c=1$ 开始，固定 $\Delta_\phi$ 的最大排除中心费用在 $\Delta_\phi=1/2$ 和 $4/7$ 附近有两个尖锐的最小值。在这些值下，它位于 $c=8/7$ 的 $2\times10^{-7}$ 范围内，其中 $\mathbb{Z}_5$ parafermion 及其电荷共轭轨道具有恰好这些尺寸的标量。

title: From photons to fractons: Casimir effect in higher-rank electrodynamics and its fractonic branch
abstract: The Casimir effect probes the modes that can propagate between boundaries. This makes it useful for fracton gauge theories, where restricted mobility follows from the simultaneous conservation of charge and dipole moment and changes the physical sector of the theory. We compare ordinary Maxwell electrodynamics with a Lorentz-covariant higher-rank theory of a symmetric tensor gauge field and with the scalar-charge fractonic branch selected from it by a preferred timelike background. The comparison shows why the distinction matters. In the full covariant theory, the Euclidean slab problem contains three independently propagating Maxwell-like modes and two coupled vector sectors that do not reduce to independent ordinary modes. Their boundary determinants are well defined, but a Lorentzian analysis shows that the vector sector has an unbounded Hamiltonian, so these determinants do not describe the vacuum energy of a stable fractonic phase. On the fractonic branch, the Gauss constraint removes that vector sector and leaves three stable massless modes: two transverse-traceless tensor modes and one scalar trace mode. For ideal reflectors, the physical Casimir energy is therefore 3/2 of the corresponding Maxwell result, for both equal and complementary boundary conditions. The calculation isolates the effect of the fractonic restriction on the radiative spectrum and clarifies which features of the full higher-rank boundary problem survive in the physical fracton sector.
summary:
卡西米尔效应探测可以在边界之间传播的模式。这使得它对于分形规范理论非常有用，在分形规范理论中，电荷和偶极矩同时守恒导致受限的迁移率，并改变了理论的物理部分。我们将普通麦克斯韦电动力学与对称张量规范场的洛伦兹协变高阶理论以及通过首选类时背景从中选择的标量电荷分形分支进行比较。通过比较可以看出为什么这种区别很重要。在完全协变理论中，欧几里得板问题包含三个独立传播的类麦克斯韦模式和两个不简化为独立普通模式的耦合矢量扇区。它们的边界行列式被明确定义，但洛伦兹分析表明矢量扇区具有无界哈密顿量，因此这些行列式不能描述稳定分形相的真空能量。在分形分支上，高斯约束删除了矢量扇区并留下三种稳定的无质量模式：两种横向无迹张量模式和一种标量迹模式。

因此，对于理想反射器，对于相等和互补边界条件，物理卡西米尔能量是相应麦克斯韦结果的 3/2。该计算隔离了分形限制对辐射光谱的影响，并阐明了完整的高阶边界问题的哪些特征在物理分形扇区中仍然存在。

title: Functional Dimensional Regularization for the Lee-Yang Model
abstract: We apply functional dimensional regularization (FDR) to the Lee-Yang universality class, a paradigmatic non-unitary theory, and compute its main critical exponents across the dimension range $3\leq d\leq 6$. By combining a second-order derivative expansion with polynomial field expansions, we obtain results that are compatible with resummed $\varepsilon$-expansion as well as with state-of-the-art estimates from Conformal Bootstrap and Fuzzy Sphere techniques. This demonstrates that, in the context of non-unitary theories, FDR retains the efficiency and rapid convergence to accurate critical exponents already observed in the Ising and O(N) cases.
summary: 我们将函数维度正则化（FDR）应用于 Lee-Yang 普遍性类（一种范式非统一理论），并计算其在维度范围 $3\leq d\leq 6$ 上的主要临界指数。通过将二阶导数展开与多项式域展开相结合，我们获得的结果与恢复的 $\varepsilon$ 展开以及来自 Conformal Bootstrap 和 Fuzzy Sphere 技术的最新估计兼容。这表明，在非统一理论的背景下，FDR 保留了在 Ising 和 O(N) 情况下观察到的精确临界指数的效率和快速收敛。

title: Smoothing the Bouncing-Geodesic Singularity in AdS/CFT
abstract: Black hole singularities remain a central open problem in quantum gravity. In the AdS/CFT correspondence, bulk spacelike extremal surfaces can probe the black hole interior, and information about the near-singularity geometry is encoded in analytically continued boundary correlators. As the bouncing geodesic approaches the black hole singularity, it becomes nearly null and gives rise to characteristic divergences at complex times. Importantly, these complex-time singularities emerge only in the strict semiclassical limit ($G_N\to 0$ or $c\to\infty$) and are governed by the asymptotically linear quasinormal mode (QNM) spectrum. At finite $c$, nonlinear deformations of the QNM trajectories produce suppression kernel that smooths out the complex-time singularities. Using Liouville CFT as an analytically solvable example, we explicitly demonstrate the finite-$c$ deformation of the QNM spectrum and its associated pole-zero structure. We also identify a complementary Gaussian smoothing mechanism arising from finite-energy fluctuations in the thermal spectral decomposition. These results show how finite $G_N$ quantum corrections modify the holographic imprints of the classical black hole singularity.
summary:
黑洞奇点仍然是量子引力中的一个核心开放问题。在 AdS/CFT 对应中，块状空间极值表面可以探测黑洞内部，并且有关近奇点几何形状的信息被编码在分析连续边界相关器中。当弹跳测地线接近黑洞奇点时，它几乎为零，并在复杂时间产生特征散度。重要的是，这些复杂时间奇点仅出现在严格的半经典极限（$G_N\to 0$ 或 $c\to\infty$）中，并受渐近线性拟正态模式 (QNM) 谱控制。在有限的 $c$ 下，QNM 轨迹的非线性变形会产生抑制核，从而平滑复杂时间奇点。使用 Liouville CFT 作为解析可解的例子，我们明确地证明了 QNM 谱的有限 $c$ 变形及其相关的零极点结构。我们还确定了热谱分解中有限能量波动产生的互补高斯平滑机制。

这些结果显示了有限 $G_N$ 量子校正如何修改经典黑洞奇点的全息印记。

title: Geometric duality between effective field theories. Part II. Exact classical solutions
abstract: Geometric duality reveals a novel bridge between a series of well-known scalar effective field theories: the Yang-Mills theory coupled to a specific scalar sector (aka the Yang-Mills-scalar theory), the nonlinear sigma model on a symmetric coset space, the Dirac-Born-Infeld theory, and the special Galileon theory. In our previous work, we used the geometric duality to map scattering amplitudes in the various theories to one another. In this sequel, we show that the duality makes it also possible to transport exact classical solutions. Thus, exact solutions of the nonlinear sigma model are mapped to a subset of solutions of the Yang-Mills-scalar theory. Likewise, solutions of the special Galileon theory map to solutions of the Dirac-Born-Infeld theory, which in turn map to solutions of the nonlinear sigma model coupled to dynamical gravity. For all these duality maps, we provide explicit examples of exact solutions of the source theory and their corresponding image in the target theory. While the duality maps are manifest at the level of certain geometric building blocks of the theories, we show that with a suitable choice of parametrisation, it is also possible to map directly the elementary scalar fields of the various theories to one another. This offers a practically convenient tool for constructing new exact solutions of the target theories. Finally, the duality sequence including the nonlinear sigma model and the Yang-Mills-scalar theory can be extended by uplifting the solutions of the latter to a higher-dimensional spacetime. One thus arrives at a class of exact solutions of pure Yang-Mills theory in higher dimensions. In a similar vein, it is possible to obtain exact solutions of higher-dimensional pure gravity by uplifting solutions of the nonlinear sigma model, coupled to dynamical gravity, obtained via a duality map from solutions of the special Galileon theory.
summary:
几何对偶性揭示了一系列著名的标量有效场理论之间的一座新颖桥梁：耦合到特定标量扇区的杨-米尔斯理论（又名杨-米尔斯标量理论）、对称陪集空间上的非线性西格玛模型、狄拉克-玻恩-因菲尔德理论和特殊伽利略理论。在我们之前的工作中，我们使用几何对偶性将各种理论中的散射振幅相互映射。在这篇续集中，我们证明了对偶性也使得传输精确的经典解成为可能。因此，非线性 sigma 模型的精确解被映射到 Yang-Mills 标量理论的解的子集。同样，特殊伽利略理论的解映射到狄拉克-玻恩-因费尔德理论的解，而狄拉克-玻恩-因菲尔德理论的解又映射到与动态重力耦合的非线性西格玛模型的解。对于所有这些对偶图，我们提供了源理论的精确解及其在目标理论中的相应图像的明确示例。

虽然对偶图在理论的某些几何构建块的层面上表现出来，但我们表明，通过适当选择参数化，也可以将各种理论的基本标量场直接映射到彼此。这为构建目标理论的新精确解提供了一个实用方便的工具。最后，包括非线性西格玛模型和杨米尔斯标量理论的对偶序列可以通过将后者的解提升到更高维的时空来扩展。因此，我们得到了高维纯杨米尔斯理论的一类精确解。类似地，通过提升非线性西格玛模型的解，耦合到动态重力，可以得到高维纯重力的精确解，动态重力是通过特殊伽利略理论解的对偶图获得的。

title: Symmetry breaking from conformality loss on holographic Rényi defects
abstract: The Rényi entropies of a ball are computed by a conformal defect, the Rényi defect, dual in holography to a hyperbolic black hole. At an index $n_*$ its charged operator merges with its alternate-quantization partner, and the defect loses conformality. Beyond $n_*$ it flows with no source to a conformal defect that breaks the U(1) symmetry; below $n_*$ that defect needs a symmetry-breaking source, so at large $N$, conformality loss makes the breaking spontaneous. The scalar hair beyond $n_*$, expected to break the symmetries of hyperbolic space, thus preserves them outside a thin layer at the entangling surface, as conformal symmetry requires. The region outside the layer sets the universal term of the Rényi entropy. We demonstrate the mechanism in the probe Abelian Higgs model in AdS$_5$ at the Bogomolny point, where the saddles are in closed form and numerical methods confirm the flows. On a sphere we prove that a positive source-free flow exists exactly when $n>n_*$ and the sphere is large enough; it is then unique and ends at the symmetry-breaking defect. The mechanism needs a scalar mass in a finite window, and for potentials attractive at small amplitude, the symmetry can break before conformality is lost. For operators of low enough dimension, already the second Rényi entropy lies beyond the merger. Classical backreaction does not move the merger at any order; we argue that away from $n_*$ the flows persist at first order.
summary:
球的 Rényi 熵是通过共形缺陷（Rényi 缺陷）计算的，它在全息术中与双曲黑洞对偶。在索引 $n_*$ 处，其带电算子与其交替量化伙伴合并，并且缺陷失去共形性。超出 $n_*$ 后，它会无源地流向破坏 U(1) 对称性的共形缺陷；低于 $n_*$ 时，该缺陷需要对称性破缺源，因此在较大的 $N$ 时，保形性损失会使破缺自发发生。 $n_*$ 之外的标量毛发预计会打破双曲空间的对称性，因此将它们保留在纠缠表面的薄层之外，正如共角对称所要求的那样。该层外部的区域设置了 Rényi 熵的通用项。我们在 AdS$_5$ 的 Bogomolny 点处演示了探针阿贝尔希格斯模型中的机制，其中鞍座处于闭合形式，并且数值方法确认了流动。在球体上，我们证明当 $n>n_*$ 并且球体足够大时，存在正的无源流；然后它是唯一的并以对称破缺缺陷结束。

该机制需要有限窗口内的标量质量，并且对于小幅度吸引的势能，对称性可能会在共形性丧失之前破裂。对于足够低维度的算子，第二个 Rényi 熵已经超出了合并范围。经典的逆反应不会以任何顺序移动合并；我们认为，远离 $n_*$ 的流动仍然处于一阶。

title: Fractional $θ$-dependence from the sum over all instanton sectors
abstract: An instanton carries integer topological charge, seemingly at odds with the multibranched $\theta$ dependence of the Yang-Mills vacuum. We show that summing over all instanton sectors resolves this mismatch in self-dual supersymmetric $\mathbb{C}P^{N-1}$ and $\mathrm{SU}(N)$ Yang-Mills theories with a chiral mass, in two and four dimensions. The path integral reduces to a sum of instanton moduli-space volumes, yielding the multibranched vacuum structure. In four dimensions, this extends Nekrasov's instanton counting for Seiberg-Witten theory to a QCD-like theory without scalars.
summary: 瞬子带有整数拓扑电荷，这似乎与杨-米尔斯真空的多分支 $\theta$ 依赖性不一致。我们证明，对所有瞬子扇区求和可以解决二维和四维具有手性质量的自对偶超对称 $\mathbb{C}P^{N-1}$ 和 $\mathrm{SU}(N)$ Yang-Mills 理论中的这种不匹配问题。路径积分减少为瞬子模空间体积之和，产生多分支真空结构。在四个维度上，这将 Nekrasov 的 Seiberg-Witten 理论瞬时子计数扩展到没有标量的类 QCD 理论。

title: I want to Break Free: The Positive Side of Symmetry Breaking
abstract: We study the role of internal field-space symmetries in Effective Field Theories constrained by positivity bounds. For theories with $N$ real scalar fields, we classify derivative operators according to the internal symmetries they preserve, organising them into hierarchies based on the maximal symmetry $O(N)$ and its subgroups. We find that the Wilson coefficients of operators that depart from an enhanced symmetry are bounded in terms of those that respect it. This means that departures from an enhanced internal symmetry cannot be made arbitrarily large while maintaining a standard UV completion, even when the enhanced internal symmetry was not imposed in constructing the low-energy theory. Moreover, along a cascade of progressively smaller preserved subgroups, the coefficients of operators preserving lower levels of symmetry are bounded by those preserving larger subgroups in the cascade, and are consequently subject to progressively stronger constraints. We demonstrate these results through a variety of examples involving $2-2$ and $3-3$ scattering of indefinite states formed from superpositions of multiple scalar species.
summary: 我们研究内部场空间对称性在有效场论中受正界约束的作用。对于具有 $N$ 实标量场的理论，我们根据导数算子保留的内部对称性对它们进行分类，并根据最大对称性 $O(N)$ 及其子群将它们组织成层次结构。我们发现，偏离增强对称性的算子的威尔逊系数受到遵守增强对称性的算子的限制。这意味着，即使在构建低能理论时没有强加增强的内部对称性，在保持标准 UV 完成的同时，也不能任意大地偏离增强的内部对称性。此外，沿着级联逐渐变小的保留子群，保留较低对称性水平的算子的系数受到级联中保留较大子群的算子的系数的限制，因此受到逐渐更强的约束。我们通过涉及由多个标量物种叠加形成的不定态的 $2-2$ 和 $3-3$ 散射的各种示例来证明这些结果。

title: The Virasoro Bootstrap: from the $c\sim1$ desert to coupled Potts
abstract: We develop a numerical conformal bootstrap for two-dimensional CFTs with $c>1$ based on Virasoro conformal blocks, computed with Zamolodchikov's recursion and optimal polynomial interpolation. As a first test we isolate an island around three decoupled Ising models. We then consider three 3-state Potts models coupled through their energy operators, a candidate irrational CFT. Mixed correlators isolate the decoupled theory in an island, and different gap assumptions, motivated by perturbation theory, yield a peninsula that contains the coupled fixed point but not the decoupled one. Finally, we explore the standard single-correlator bound on the lowest-dimension scalar primary in the OPE of two identical scalars. We find that for central charges just above $c=1$ the bound collapses over a wide range of external dimensions. This excludes any theory whose lightest scalar is absent from its own OPE and lies in this range, and supports the conjecture that no compact CFT exists in this region. We explain several features of these bounds analytically.
summary: 我们基于 Virasoro 共形块，为 $c>1$ 的二维 CFT 开发了一个数值共形自举程序，通过 Zamolodchikov 递归和最优多项式插值计算。作为第一个测试，我们在三个解耦的伊辛模型周围隔离了一个岛。然后，我们考虑通过能量算子耦合的三个三态 Potts 模型，即候选的非理性 CFT。混合相关器将解耦理论隔离在一个岛中，并且在微扰理论的推动下，不同的间隙假设产生一个包含耦合不动点但不包含解耦不动点的半岛。最后，我们探索两个相同标量的 OPE 中最低维标量初级上的标准单相关器界限。我们发现，对于略高于 $c=1$ 的中心费用，边界在很宽的外部尺寸范围内崩溃。这排除了任何其最轻标量不存在于其自身 OPE 中并且位于该范围内的理论，并且支持了该区域中不存在紧致 CFT 的猜想。我们分析地解释了这些边界的几个特征。

title: Nonlinear gauge maps and the structure of Goldstone loops in canonical inflation
abstract: We clarify the nonlinear relation between the spatially flat scalar and Goldstone descriptions of canonical single-field inflation. An exact clock map shows how potential interactions are reorganized into derivative Goldstone interactions. A change of slicing further connects their dilation symmetry to its comoving realization. We then study the Goldstone two-point function at one loop in the decoupling limit. Using identities derived from the general mode equation, we reveal how seemingly independent loop contributions combine and their non-boundary parts cancel once the associated counterterms are included. This reduction requires no explicit mode-function solution. The leading adiabatic long-mode response reduces to a total derivative in loop momentum, which requires an additional regularization prescription.
summary: 我们阐明了空间平坦标量与规范单场暴胀的戈德斯通描述之间的非线性关系。精确的时钟图显示了潜在的相互作用如何重组为衍生的戈德斯通相互作用。切片的变化进一步将它们的膨胀对称性与其共动实现联系起来。然后我们研究解耦极限下一次循环的戈德斯通两点函数。使用从一般模式方程导出的恒等式，我们揭示了一旦包含相关的反项，看似独立的循环贡献如何组合以及它们的非边界部分如何取消。这种减少不需要显式的模式函数解。领先的绝热长模响应减少为环动量的全导数，这需要额外的正则化规定。

title: Mutual information to all orders from modular flow: a replica-free approach
abstract: We derive an all-orders long-distance expansion of vacuum mutual information between two disjoint balls in generic $d$-dimensional CFTs. The derivation uses a novel radial sewing expansion of the joint vacuum density matrix, together with a modular response formula for relative entropy and the geometric modular flow of a single ball, without analytic continuation in replica number. The expansion coefficients are modular integrals of modular-flowed vacuum correlators. Our formula provides a systematic treatment of arbitrary multi-point sectors, and recovers known results on two-point sector derived from replica methods. The full two-point sector resums into a modular integral of the thermal partition function on $S^{d-1}$, with an effective temperature depending on ball configuration and modular time. We compute the expansion explicitly in CFTs. In two-dimensional Ising CFT, using analytic reductions and multidimensional numerical integration, we obtain the first ten radial orders in the long-distance expansion, which involve sphere correlators with up to twenty spin insertions. The truncated expansion agrees well with lattice data at finite separation, and approximately satisfies crossing symmetry. Analytic calculations also reproduce known expansion coefficients for 2d free compact boson at self-dual radius and its current sector, as well as for free scalars in higher dimensions.
summary:
我们推导了通用 $d$ 维 CFT 中两个不相交球之间真空互信息的全阶长距离展开。该推导使用了联合真空密度矩阵的新颖径向缝合展开，以及相对熵的模响应公式和单个球的几何模流，而无需复制数的解析延续。展开系数是模流真空相关器的模积分。我们的公式提供了对任意多点扇区的系统处理，并恢复从复制方法导出的两点扇区的已知结果。完整的两点扇区恢复为 $S^{d-1}$ 上热分区函数的模积分，有效温度取决于球配置和模时间。我们在 CFT 中明确计算展开式。在二维 Ising CFT 中，使用解析约简和多维数值积分，我们获得了长距离扩展中的前十个径向阶，其中涉及具有多达 20 个自旋插入的球体相关器。

截断展开式与有限间隔处的晶格数据非常吻合，并且近似满足交叉对称性。解析计算还重现了二维自由紧致玻色子在自对偶半径及其当前扇区以及更高维度的自由标量的已知膨胀系数。

title: Phase-space dynamics and multicomponent wave-packet structures in the Dunkl anharmonic oscillator
abstract: We study the phase-space dynamics and multicomponent wave-packet structures of the Dunkl anharmonic oscillator (Kerr medium). Starting from the time-evolved state, we derive analytical expressions for the Dunkl-Husimi $Q$-function and a normalized angular Husimi profile. The Dunkl parameter modifies the coherent-state excitation weights and the parity-dependent phase accumulation, producing angular anisotropy and asymmetric phase-space separation. For the half-integer deformation $\mu=0.5$, the dynamics generate asymmetric multicomponent Husimi patterns with unequal peak heights and an early reconstruction at $t=\pi/\lambda$. For the deformation $\mu=1.0$, the Husimi distribution exhibits broadening while retaining its multimodal structure and unitary evolution. At the fundamental nonlinear revival time, the wave packet is reconstructed for the selected parameter ratio. The standard Kerr dynamics are recovered in the limit $\mu\rightarrow 0$.
summary: 我们研究了 Dunkl 非简谐振子（克尔介质）的相空间动力学和多分量波包结构。从时间演化状态开始，我们推导了 Dunkl-Husimi $Q$ 函数的解析表达式和归一化角度 Husimi 轮廓。 Dunkl 参数修改相干态激励权重和奇偶校验相关相位累积，产生角度各向异性和不对称相空间分离。对于半整数变形 $\mu=0.5$，动力学生成具有不等峰值高度的不对称多分量 Husimi 图案，并在 $t=\pi/\lambda$ 处进行早期重建。对于变形 $\mu=1.0$，Husimi 分布表现出展宽，同时保留其多模态结构和单一演化。在基本非线性复兴时间，波包被重建为选定的参数比。标准克尔动力学在极限 $\mu\rightarrow 0$ 内恢复。

title: Painlevé VI superintegrability and Heun-Racah algebras
abstract: We study the two fourth-order quantum superintegrable systems in the Euclidean plane that separate in polar coordinates and whose angular potentials are determined by the general four-parameter sixth Painlevé transcendent. One system has an oscillator radial term and the other an extended-Coulomb radial term. For both systems we give the fourth-order quantum integral explicitly, derive the cubic symmetry algebra and its Casimir, and construct a deformed-oscillator realization. At fixed energy the two algebras are specializations of the Heun--Racah algebra. Their structure functions contain the same quartic angular factor, determined by the Painlevé~VI parameters, while different radial factors distinguish oscillator and Coulomb dynamics. The Coulomb integral is obtained by transforming the Cartesian Hermitian symmetry at the operator level. The lower-order terms generated by the polar coordinate change are essential for commutation with the Hamiltonian. The two quantum systems are also related by the Levi-Civita transformation and coupling-constant metamorphosis, which gives a direct correspondence between their Painlevé parameters, algebras, Casimirs and representations. Earlier exceptional-Jacobi models arise at special rational parameter values, whereas the results here apply to the full four-parameter Painlevé~VI family. We also compare the quantum results with the corresponding classical Poisson algebras.
summary:
我们研究了欧几里得平面上的两个四阶量子超可积系统，它们在极坐标中分离，其角势由一般的四参数第六 Painlevé 超越项确定。一个系统具有振荡器径向项，另一个系统具有扩展库仑径向项。对于这两个系统，我们明确给出四阶量子积分，推导立方对称代数及其卡西米尔，并构造变形振荡器实现。在固定能量下，这两个代数是 Heun-Racah 代数的特化。它们的结构函数包含相同的四次角因子，由 Painlevé~VI 参数确定，而不同的径向因子区分振子和库仑动力学。库仑积分是通过在算子级别变换笛卡尔埃尔米特对称性获得的。极坐标变化产生的低阶项对于与哈密顿量交换至关重要。这两个量子系统还通过列维-奇维塔变换和耦合常数变形相关联，这给出了它们的 Painlevé 参数、代数、卡西米尔和表示之间的直接对应关系。

早期的异常雅可比模型出现在特殊的有理参数值下，而这里的结果适用于完整的四参数 Painlevé~VI 系列。我们还将量子结果与相应的经典泊松代数进行了比较。

title: Stability of Solitons in the Parametrically Driven and Damped Nonlinear Schrödinger Equation in Arbitrary Dimension
abstract: We study the spectral stability of soliton solutions of the parametrically driven and damped nonlinear Schrödinger (PDDNLS) equation with power-law nonlinearity $|\Psi|^{2\kappa}\Psi$ in $N$ dimensions. We identify two families of stationary solutions, $\Psi_\pm$, whose existence is determined by two conditions: one involving the nonlinearity exponent~$\kappa$ and the spatial dimension~$N$, and another involving the forcing amplitude~$r$ and the damping coefficient~$\rho$. By linearising around these solutions and introducing a convenient parametrisation through~$\varepsilon$, we reduce the stability problem to a dissipationless eigenvalue problem for two Schrödinger-type operators, $L_0$ and $L_1$. We prove that $\Psi_-$ is always unstable, while for $\Psi_+$, we carry out a complete spectral analysis by decomposing the problem into angular momentum sectors $\mathcal{S}_l$. We show that modes with $l \geq 2$ generate no instabilities and that no complex quadruplets arise on~$\mathcal{S}_1$. We also derive an analytical instability criterion on $\mathcal{S}_l$ by combining a Vakhitov--Kolokolov-type argument with a local analysis that determines the direction of the eigenvalue splitting near the origin. In addition, we uncover new phenomena at both small and large values of $\kappa$ that were not investigated in earlier one-dimensional studies. Numerical stability diagrams for $N = 1, 2, 3$ are presented.
summary:
我们研究了参数驱动和阻尼非线性薛定谔 (PDDNLS) 方程的孤子解的谱稳定性，其幂律非线性 $|\Psi|^{2\kappa}\Psi$ 在 $N$ 维度上。我们确定了两个稳态解族$\Psi_\pm$，它们的存在由两个条件决定：一个涉及非线性指数~$\kappa$和空间维度~$N$，另一个涉及强迫幅度~$r$和阻尼系数~$\rho$。通过对这些解进行线性化并通过~$\varepsilon$引入方便的参数化，我们将两个薛定谔型算子$L_0$和$L_1$的稳定性问题简化为无耗散特征值问题。我们证明$\Psi_-$总是不稳定的，而对于$\Psi_+$，我们通过将问题分解为角动量扇区$\mathcal{S}_l$来进行完整的谱分析。我们证明 $l \geq 2$ 的模式不会产生不稳定性，并且 ~$\mathcal{S}_1$ 上不会出现复杂的四元组。

我们还通过将 Vakhitov--Kolokolov 型参数与确定原点附近特征值分裂方向的局部分析相结合，得出了 $\mathcal{S}_l$ 上的分析不稳定性准则。此外，我们还发现了 $\kappa$ 小值和大值下的新现象，这些现象在早期的一维研究中没有研究过。给出了 $N = 1, 2, 3$ 的数值稳定性图。

title: A block-encoding approach to the Segawa-Suzuki spectral mapping theorem
abstract: We revisit the Segawa--Suzuki spectral mapping theorem for abstract Szegedy-type quantum walks from a block-encoding viewpoint. Retaining both eigenspaces of the involution underlying the chiral symmetry yields a natural two-by-two block representation in which the usual discriminant operator and its counterpart form the diagonal blocks. The non-endpoint spectral mapping theorem then follows from an elementary Schur decomposition, substantially simplifying the original proof by avoiding its invariant-subspace decomposition and approximate-eigenvector arguments. The same framework establishes the result for the spectrum, point spectrum, and Fredholm essential spectrum and gives a direct block-theoretic description of the endpoint inherited and birth eigenspaces. We illustrate the construction with a one-dimensional split-step quantum walk.
summary: 我们从块编码的角度重新审视抽象 Szegedy 型量子行走的 Sekawa-Suzuki 谱映射定理。保留手性对称性下的对合的两个特征空间产生自然的二乘二块表示，其中通常的判别算子及其对应物形成对角块。然后，非端点谱映射定理由初等 Schur 分解得出，通过避免其不变子空间分解和近似特征向量参数，大大简化了原始证明。相同的框架建立了谱、点谱和 Fredholm 本质谱的结果，并给出了端点继承和出生特征空间的直接块理论描述。我们用一维分步量子行走来说明该结构。

title: Large $N$ limit of the ratio of Lukyanov integrals
abstract: We study the large-$N$ asymptotics of ratios of Lukyanov integrals for fixed real coupling $b\geq1$. Our approach uses their biorthogonal ensemble structure and vector Riemann--Hilbert techniques. Under stated analytic hypotheses, we derive the logarithmic ratio through its constant term, which is expressed by a Fredholm determinant. The expansion is locally uniform in the real parameter $\alpha$ and is formulated separately for even and odd particle numbers. We verify the hypotheses for the correction defined by the physical ground-state thermodynamic Bethe ansatz. The relation to quantum-field-theoretic one-point functions is discussed separately.
summary: 我们研究固定实数耦合 $b\geq1$ 的 Lukyanov 积分比率的大 $N$ 渐近。我们的方法使用他们的双正交系综结构和矢量黎曼-希尔伯特技术。在规定的分析假设下，我们通过常数项推导出对数比，该常数项由 Fredholm 行列式表示。展开式在实参数 $\alpha$ 中是局部均匀的，并且针对偶数和奇数粒子数分别制定。我们验证了物理基态热力学 Bethe ansatz 定义的修正假设。与量子场论单点函数的关系将单独讨论。

title: Boosted Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Solving Homogeneous and Non-Homogeneous Lane-Emden Type Equations
abstract: The Lane-Emden Equation is a class of nonlinear differential equations commonly used to model phenomena in astrophysics and mathematical physics, such as stellar structure and thermal behavior in polytropic gas spheres. This study presents a novel hybrid framework that integrates Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) with boosting methods to enhance the accuracy and robustness of solutions for Lane-Emden type differential equations. Standard PINNs leverage physical laws encoded within the loss function, but their predictive performance can be constrained by optimization challenges and approximation errors. To address this, we introduce a post-processing boosting stage where the residual errors from the PINN prediction are modeled using some regression algorithms - including LightGBM, Random Forest, XGBoost, and Support Vector Regression (SVR). The outputs from these boosted models are aggregated to generate a corrected, high-fidelity prediction. The proposed methodology is systematically validated through quantitative metrics and comparative analysis against the standard PINN baseline. The results demonstrate that the boosted PINN framework significantly reduces prediction error, and improves generalization, offering a powerful and flexible approach for solving scientific and engineering problems governed by differential equations.
summary:
Lane-Emden 方程是一类非线性微分方程，通常用于对天体物理学和数学物理学中的现象进行建模，例如恒星结构和多变气球中的热行为。这项研究提出了一种新颖的混合框架，它将物理信息神经网络 (PINN) 与增强方法相结合，以提高 Lane-Emden 型微分方程解的准确性和鲁棒性。标准 PINN 利用损失函数中编码的物理定律，但其预测性能可能会受到优化挑战和近似误差的限制。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了后处理增强阶段，其中使用一些回归算法（包括 LightGBM、随机森林、XGBoost 和支持向量回归 (SVR)）对 PINN 预测的残余误差进行建模。这些增强模型的输出被汇总以生成经过校正的高保真预测。通过定量指标和与标准 PINN 基线的比较分析，系统地验证了所提出的方法。

结果表明，增强的 PINN 框架显着降低了预测误差，并提高了泛化能力，为解决微分方程控制的科学和工程问题提供了强大而灵活的方法。

title: A Representation Theorem for Fractional Viscoelastic Networks
abstract: We prove a representation theorem for finite series-parallel viscoelastic networks composed of springs and spring-pots of a common order $0<\alpha<1$. The associated complex shear modulus, expressed in an appropriately chosen auxiliary variable, is rational and admits a finite partial-fraction representation with simple poles on the negative real axis and negative residues. Its reciprocal admits an analogous representation with positive residues and a possible additional pole at the origin. Inverting the corresponding Laplace transforms gives finite fractional Prony representations of the relaxation modulus and creep compliance with non-negative amplitudes. These results provide a rigorous proof of a corrected version of the Mainardi-Spada conjecture for this network class. A six-element network illustrates the construction.
summary: 我们证明了由弹簧和弹簧罐组成的有限串并联粘弹性网络的表示定理，其公共阶数为 $0<\alpha<1$。以适当选择的辅助变量表示的相关复剪切模量是有理数，并且允许在负实轴和负余数上具有简单极点的有限部分分数表示。它的倒数允许具有正残基的类似表示以及原点处可能的附加极点。反转相应的拉普拉斯变换给出松弛模量和非负振幅蠕变柔量的有限分数 Prony 表示。这些结果为该网络类的 Mainardi-Spada 猜想的修正版本提供了严格的证明。六元网络说明了该结构。

title: Lieb-Robinson Light Cones in Long-Range Bosonic Systems
abstract: Lieb-Robinson bounds formulate emergent causality in quantum many-body dynamics. In this Letter, we study interacting bosonic systems with long-range interactions, in which both the standard assumptions of short-range interactions and uniformly bounded local energy scales are absent. We derive upper and lower bounds whose effective light-cone exponents are governed by a nontrivial interplay between the decay exponent $\alpha$ and the bosonic interaction order $p$. The propagation protocol concentrates bosons within blocks, creating a mediating sublattice with amplified interactions. For $p\ge4$ and $2d<\alpha\le2d+1$, the resulting exponents coincide, determining the optimal leading light-cone power. The upper bound includes $\alpha=2d+1$ with arbitrarily small exponent loss, using a fixed-$k$ extension of the bounded-interaction result. Our results reveal that the interplay between long-range couplings and unbounded bosonic degrees of freedom gives rise to a richer light-cone structure than in either long-range bounded systems or short-range bosonic systems alone.
summary: Lieb-Robinson 界限阐述了量子多体动力学中的涌现因果关系。在这封信中，我们研究了具有长程相互作用的玻色子系统，其中短程相互作用和均匀有界局部能量尺度的标准假设都不存在。我们推导了其有效光锥指数的上限和下限，该上限和下限由衰减指数 $\alpha$ 和玻色子相互作用阶 $p$ 之间的重要相互作用控制。传播协议将玻色子集中在块内，创建具有放大相互作用的中介子晶格。对于 $p\ge4$ 和 $2d<\alpha\le2d+1$，所得指数一致，从而确定最佳的主导光锥功率。上限包括具有任意小指数损失的 $\alpha=2d+1$，使用有界交互结果的固定 $k$ 扩展。我们的结果表明，长程耦合和无界玻色子自由度之间的相互作用产生了比单独的长程有界系统或短程玻色子系统更丰富的光锥结构。

title: Explicit Boundary-Entropy Deficits in the XX Spin Chain with arbitrary boundary fields
abstract: The exact thermodynamics of the XX spin-1/2 chain with arbitrary Hermitian boundary fields is constructed via fusion techniques. The rigorous result shows that (1) each end with a nonzero transverse field contributes $+\frac12T\ln2$ to the low-temperature free energy, whereas strictly diagonal and free ends contribute no such linear term; (2) each nondiagonal end has a characteristic temperature $T_B$, which scales as $T_B\propto h_\perp^2/J$ in the weak-field regime. For $T\ll\min\{J,T_B\}$, the boundary entropy approaches a deficit of $\frac12\ln2$ relative to a diagonal end. As the transverse field tends to zero, the boundary crossover scale vanishes and the low-temperature expansion becomes nonuniform. The present result provides a clear benchmark not only for the boundary thermodynamics of open boundary quantum integrable systems, but also for dot defects in quantum critical systems.
summary: 具有任意埃尔米特边界场的 XX 自旋 1/2 链的精确热力学是通过融合技术构建的。严格的结果表明（1）具有非零横向场的每个端部都对低温自由能贡献$+\frac12T\ln2$，而严格对角线和自由端则不贡献这样的线性项； (2) 每个非对角端都有一个特征温度 $T_B$，在弱场状态下其比例为 $T_B\propto h_\perp^2/J$。对于 $T\ll\min\{J,T_B\}$，边界熵相对于对角线末端接近 $\frac12\ln2$ 的赤字。当横向场趋于零时，边界交叉尺度消失，低温膨胀变得不均匀。目前的结果不仅为开放边界量子可积系统的边界热力学提供了明确的基准，而且还为量子临界系统中的点缺陷提供了明确的基准。

title: Equivalence of superintegrable Poisson projection chains: magnetic cotangent bundles and spin Calogero-Moser models
abstract: We study superintegrable Hamiltonian systems in terms of Poisson projection chains and their (spectral) equivalence. We compare two reduction constructions: (i) the cotangent bundle $T^*(G/A)$, $A=Z_G(\gamma)$, with the magnetic symplectic form defined by the orbit $G\cdot \gamma\cong G/A$, and (ii) the left-right Hamiltonian reduction of $T^*G$ that gives spin Calogero-Moser type systems. We prove that the two resulting chains are equivalent on an open set of regular points of principal orbit type: the phase spaces, the intermediate Poisson manifolds and the base spaces are identified compatibly with the projections. In particular, both constructions give the same commuting Hamiltonians.
summary: 我们根据泊松投影链及其（谱）等价性研究超可积哈密顿系统。我们比较两种约简结构：(i) 余切丛 $T^*(G/A)$、$A=Z_G(\gamma)$，其磁辛形式由轨道 $G\cdot \gamma\cong G/A$ 定义，以及 (ii) $T^*G$ 的左右哈密顿约简，给出自旋 Calogero-Moser 型系统。我们证明了两个所得的链在主轨道类型的规则点的开集上是等价的：相空间、中间泊松流形和基空间与投影兼容地识别。特别是，两种结构都给出相同的通勤哈密顿量。

title: Canonical quantum curve I
abstract: We formulate a canonical quantum curve conjecture $\widehat H\Psi_*=0$ for spectral curves of positive genus. Here $\Psi_*$ is the non-perturbative wave function associated with Eynard--Orantin topological recursion, specialized at the \emph{canonical vanishing point}, a distinguished zero of the closed non-perturbative partition function. The operator $\widehat H$ is obtained by Weyl quantization of $H(x,y)$, with $\widehat x=x\cdot$ and $\widehat y=\hbar\partial_x$, together with quantum corrections to its coefficients. These corrections depend only on closed moduli and $\hbar$ and vanish classically. Whenever a geometric definition is available, we conjecture that the corrected coefficients are suitably normalized Wilson-loop expectation values. When a corresponding refined theory exists, we conjecture a relation between the canonical vanishing point and the closed Nekrasov--Shatashvili free energy. We prove the quantum curve conjecture for Weierstrass curves and the mirror curves of canonical bundles of smooth projective toric weak del Pezzo surfaces, including local $\mathbb P^2$. For the local surfaces considered here, we relate the canonical vanishing point to a derivative of the closed NS free energy. For local $\mathbb P^2$, we also identify the corrected coefficient with a suitably normalized, geometrically defined NS Wilson-loop expectation value.
summary:
我们针对正亏格的谱曲线制定了规范量子曲线猜想 $\widehat H\Psi_*=0$。这里 $\Psi_*$ 是与 Eynard-Orantin 拓扑递归相关的非微扰波函数，专门针对 \emph{规范消失点}，即封闭非微扰配分函数的一个显着零。算子 $\widehat H$ 是通过 $H(x,y)$ 的 Weyl 量化获得的，其中 $\widehat x=x\cdot$ 和 $\widehat y=\hbar\partial_x$ 以及对其系数的量子校正。这些修正仅取决于闭模和 $\hbar$ 并且在经典情况下消失。只要几何定义可用，我们就推测校正系数是适当归一化的威尔逊环期望值。当存在相应的完善理论时，我们推测正则消失点与封闭的涅克拉索夫-沙塔什维利自由能之间的关系。我们证明了Weierstrass曲线的量子曲线猜想和光滑射影复曲面弱del Pezzo曲面正则束的镜像曲线，包括局部$\mathbb P^2$。

对于这里考虑的局部表面，我们将规范消失点与闭合 NS 自由能的导数联系起来。对于局部 $\mathbb P^2$，我们还使用适当归一化的、几何定义的 NS Wilson 环期望值来识别校正系数。

title: Semiclassical Wave Packet Dynamics For Nonlinear Schrödinger Equations with Harmonic Potentials
abstract: We propose an approximate Hamiltonian dynamics for the Gross--Pitaevskii equation $i\hbar\psi_t = -\frac{\hbar^2}{2m}\Delta \psi + V(x)\psi + \hbar^2 \lambda |\psi|^2\psi$ with harmonic potential $V(x)$ and $x\in\mathbb{R}^d$. We do this by extending the Gaussian ansatz of Perez-Garcia et al.~(Phys.~Rev.~A 56, 1424 (1997)) to the semiclassical wave packets of Hagedorn. We derive the evolution equations for the wave packets from the Hamiltonian/symplectic perspective, rather than the Lagrangian/variational one taken by Perez-Garcia et al. We first show that these two perspectives yield identical evolution equations in the Gaussian case. We then derive the evolution equations for an arbitrary element of the semiclassical wave packets. Finally, we demonstrate the efficacy of the approximate dynamics with numerical experiments.
summary: 我们提出了 Gross--Pitaevskii 方程 $i\hbar\psi_t = -\frac{\hbar^2}{2m}\Delta \psi + V(x)\psi + \hbar^2 \lambda |\psi|^2\psi$ 的近似哈密顿动力学，其谐波势为 $V(x)$ 和 $x\in\mathbb{R}^d$。我们通过将 Perez-Garcia 等人~(Phys.~Rev.~A 56, 1424 (1997)) 的高斯 ansatz 扩展到 Hgedorn 的半经典波包来做到这一点。我们从哈密顿/辛的角度推导出波包的演化方程，而不是 Perez-Garcia 等人采用的拉格朗日/变分方程。我们首先表明，这两种观点在高斯情况下产生相同的演化方程。然后我们推导半经典波包的任意元素的演化方程。最后，我们通过数值实验证明了近似动力学的有效性。

title: Density functionals for the Pauli-Fierz Hamiltonian
abstract: We develop a density-functional theory for the Pauli-Fierz Hamiltonian of nonrelativistic quantum electrodynamics in the spirit of the convex-analytic formulation of Lieb. We consider finitely many electrons, subject to external scalar and vector potentials, coupled to the full continuum of massless transverse photons with an ultraviolet cutoff. The natural basic variables are the standard electron density and a combined current density, the sum of the paramagnetic current density and a field-induced current density generated by the quantized vector potential. We prove representability results for these density-current pairs and show that the mixed-state constrained-search functional attains its infimum and coincides with the Lieb functional obtained by convex conjugation. Since arbitrarily soft photons purify mixed states at a negligible energy cost without changing their density and combined current density, the pure-state Levy-Lieb functional equals the Lieb functional and is therefore convex, even though its infimum need not be attained. In addition, we establish the zero-coupling limit, which recovers the mixed-state Vignale-Rasolt functional of current-density-functional theory. Finally, we consider the long-wavelength (dipole) limit and show that the limiting functional can be written as a constrained search for the well-known length-gauge dipole Hamiltonian.
summary:
我们本着 Lieb 凸解析公式的精神，为非相对论量子电动力学的泡利-菲尔兹哈密顿量开发了密度泛函理论。我们考虑有限数量的电子，受外部标量和矢量势的影响，与具有紫外线截止的无质量横向光子的完整连续体耦合。自然基本变量是标准电子密度和组合电流密度，即顺磁电流密度和由量化矢量势产生的场感应电流密度之和。我们证明了这些密度-电流对的可表示性结果，并表明混合状态约束搜索泛函达到其下确界，并且与通过凸共轭获得的 Lieb 泛函一致。由于任意软光子以可忽略的能量成本纯化混合态，而不改变其密度和组合电流密度，因此纯态 Levy-Lieb 泛函等于 Lieb 泛函，因此是凸的，即使不需要达到其下确界。

此外，我们建立了零耦合极限，恢复了电流密度泛函理论的混合态 Vignale-Rasolt 泛函。最后，我们考虑长波长（偶极子）极限，并表明极限泛函可以写成对众所周知的长度规偶极子哈密顿量的约束搜索。

title: Exponential suppression of bit-flip errors in dissipative cat qubits
abstract: We study the infinite-dimensional Lindblad generator $L_\epsilon=D[a^2-\alpha^2]+\epsilon D[a]$, describing a dissipative cat qubit subject to single-photon loss. For sufficiently large $\alpha$ and sufficiently small $\epsilon>0$, we identify a two-dimensional spectral subspace near zero and establish an upper bound on the slow decay rate that decreases exponentially with $\alpha^2$, uniformly in $\epsilon$. This proves exponential suppression of bit-flip errors.
summary: 我们研究无限维 Lindblad 生成器 $L_\epsilon=D[a^2-\alpha^2]+\epsilon D[a]$，描述了受单光子损失影响的耗散猫量子位。对于足够大的 $\alpha$ 和足够小的 $\epsilon>0$，我们确定一个接近于零的二维谱子空间，并建立缓慢衰减率的上限，该上限随着 $\alpha^2$ 呈指数下降，均匀地在 $\epsilon$ 中。这证明了位翻转错误的指数抑制。

title: Eynard-Orantin Topological Recursions for Higher Weil-Petersson Volumes on Moduli Spaces of Super Riemann Surfaces
abstract: We derive an Eynard-Orantin topological recursion for intersection numbers involving Norbury's $\Theta$-class together with $\psi$-classes and higher $\kappa$-classes. These intersection numbers encode higher Weil-Petersson volumes of moduli spaces of super Riemann surfaces. The resulting recursion is a higher-$\kappa$ deformation of the topological recursion associated with the Bessel curve, which encodes the Brézin-Gross-Witten model.
summary: 我们针对涉及 Norbury 的 $\Theta$ 类以及 $\psi$ 类和更高的 $\kappa$ 类的交集数导出了 Eynard-Orantin 拓扑递归。这些交集数编码了超级黎曼曲面模空间的更高 Weil-Petersson 体积。由此产生的递归是与贝塞尔曲线相关的拓扑递归的更高 $\kappa$ 变形，贝塞尔曲线编码了 Brézin-Gross-Witten 模型。

title: On Emergent Geometry of the Generalized BGW Theory
abstract: We present a systematic study of the mathematical theory of the generalized Brézin-Gross-Witten (BGW) theory using methods from statistical physics. We prove the multidifferentials of the generalized BGW theory are given by the Eynard-Orantin topological recursion in a generic background with general coupling constants. Furthermore, we characterize the transition between the Witten-Kontsevich model and the generalized BGW theory. This approach yields a new proof of the Okuyama-Sakai conjecture, further elucidating the deep structural connections between these two fundamental models.
summary: 我们使用统计物理学的方法对广义 Brézin-Gross-Witten (BGW) 理论的数学理论进行了系统研究。我们证明了广义 BGW 理论的多重微分是由具有一般耦合常数的一般背景下的 Eynard-Orantin 拓扑递归给出的。此外，我们描述了 Witten-Kontsevich 模型和广义 BGW 理论之间的转变。这种方法为奥山-酒井猜想提供了新的证明，进一步阐明了这两个基本模型之间的深层结构联系。

title: The massive phase of the two-dimensional Heisenberg model is stable under small anisotropy
abstract: Polyakov predicted that the classical Heisenberg model on $\mathbb{Z}^2$ has exponentially decaying correlations at every temperature, and a proof of this has recently been posted. We show that the massive phase survives small anisotropy. For every inverse temperature $\beta$ there is $\delta(\beta)>0$ such that the $S^2$-valued model with couplings $\sum_iJ^i\sigma_x^i\sigma_y^i$ has exponentially decaying spin two-point functions, uniformly in finite subgraphs with free boundary conditions and in edge strengths up to $\beta$, whenever $|J^i-1|\le\delta(\beta)$ for $i=1,2,3$. For the easy-plane model with couplings $\sigma^x\sigma^x+\sigma^y\sigma^y+\lambda\sigma^z\sigma^z$ this shows that the onset of the Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless phase, proved by Garban and de Montgolfier for every $\lambda\in(-1,1)$, moves to zero temperature as $\lambda\uparrow1$: in free-boundary limits, correlations decay exponentially for every $\beta\le c |\log(1-\lambda)|^{1/2}$. The physical prediction is of order $|\log(1-\lambda)|$. The same holds for aligned single-ion anisotropy, which includes a confining potential $\varepsilon\sum(\sigma^z)^2$, and for nearly isotropic $O(n)$ models with $n\ge3$. The proof keeps the sign-cluster argument of the isotropic proof, using Ginibre's correlation inequality for anisotropic planar energies, and uses the rotation symmetry only on one finite annulus, where the anisotropy is a bounded perturbation of the Hamiltonian.
summary:
波利亚科夫预测 $\mathbb{Z}^2$ 上的经典海森堡模型在每个温度下都具有指数衰减的相关性，并且最近发布了这一点的证明。我们证明了大相在小的各向异性下仍然存在。对于每个逆温度 $\beta$ ，$\delta(\beta)>0$ 使得具有耦合 $\sum_iJ^i\sigma_x^i\sigma_y^i$ 的 $S^2$ 值模型具有指数衰减的自旋两点函数，在具有自由边界条件和边缘强度高达 $\beta$ 的有限子图中一致，只要 $|J^i-1|\le\delta(\beta)$ 为$i=1,2,3$。对于耦合 $\sigma^x\sigma^x+\sigma^y\sigma^y+\lambda\sigma^z\sigma^z$ 的简单平面模型，这表明 Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless 阶段的开始，由 Garban 和 de Montgolfier 证明，对于每个 $\lambda\in(-1,1)$，移动到零温度为 $\lambda\uparrow1$：自由边界限制，相关性对于每个 $\beta\le c |\log(1-\lambda)|^{1/2}$ 呈指数衰减。物理预测的顺序为 $|\log(1-\lambda)|$。

这同样适用于对齐的单离子各向异性，其中包括限制势 $\varepsilon\sum(\sigma^z)^2$，以及具有 $n\ge3$ 的近各向同性 $O(n)$ 模型。该证明保留了各向同性证明的符号簇论证，使用各向异性平面能量的吉尼布尔相关不等式，并仅在一个有限环上使用旋转对称性，其中各向异性是哈密顿量的有界扰动。

title: Covariant Calculus and Hamiltonian Flows for Nonlocal Wasserstein Metrics
abstract: In this paper, we study nonlocal metrics on smooth positive probability densities on a closed manifold, induced by symmetric jump kernels and density-dependent mobilities. First, we introduce the density-variation operator to express the density derivatives of the Dirichlet form and kinetic energy. Second, we construct density and velocity-field representations of the tangent space and prove their isometric equivalence. We use the generator's pseudoinverse to derive Levi-Civita connections and covariant differentials in both representations. Third, we establish mechanical Hamiltonian dynamics in both tangent representations; an action principle and Legendre duality identify the Hamilton--Jacobi and covariant Newton equations; smooth negative gradient flows admit a zero-energy Hamiltonian lift. Entropy diffusion, nonlocal mean-field equations, Keller--Segel dynamics, and a nonlocal Vlasov equation illustrate the resulting calculus. For geometric-mean mobility, the Hopf--Cole transformation of the nonlocal Schrödinger bridge system and the Madelung transformation of the nonlocal Schrödinger equation yield hyperbolic and trigonometric phase energies, respectively. At zero momentum, both recover the metric kinetic energy to second order.
summary:
在本文中，我们研究了由对称跳跃核和密度相关迁移率引起的闭合流形上平滑正概率密度的非局部度量。首先，我们引入密度变分算子来表达狄利克雷形式和动能的密度导数。其次，我们构造切空间的密度和速度场表示并证明它们的等距等价性。我们使用生成器的伪逆来导出两种表示中的 Levi-Civita 连接和协变差分。第三，我们在两种切线表示中建立机械哈密顿动力学；作用原理和勒让德对偶性确定了 Hamilton-Jacobi 和协变牛顿方程；平滑的负梯度流允许零能量哈密顿升力。熵扩散、非局部平均场方程、Keller-Segel 动力学和非局部 Vlasov 方程说明了所得到的微积分。对于几何平均迁移率，非局部薛定谔桥系统的 Hopf-Cole 变换和非局部薛定谔方程的马德隆变换分别产生双曲和三角相能。

在零动量时，两者都将公制动能恢复到二阶。

title: Nonlinear adiabatic theorem for the Gross-Pitaevskii equation
abstract: We prove a nonlinear adiabatic theorem for the repulsive Gross-Pitaevskii (GP) equation with a time-dependent trapping potential $V(x,t)$. If either (i) $V(\cdot,t)$ is smooth, subquadratic in space and with uniformly bounded spatial derivatives of order $\geq 2$, or (ii) $V(\cdot,t)$ is a uniformly bounded perturbation of a fixed non-negative potential which is asymptotically $|x|^m, m\geq 2$, then the GP equation has a global solution, which remains uniformly close to the instantaneous minimizer of the time-independent GP functional, provided the initial condition is a ground state. In fact, we show that the existence of a solution of the GP equation is the real bottleneck: If existence is assumed, then adiabaticity holds under very minimal assumptions.
summary: 我们证明了排斥 Gross-Pitaevskii (GP) 方程的非线性绝热定理，该方程具有与时间相关的捕获势 $V(x,t)$。如果 (i) $V(\cdot,t)$ 是平滑的、空间中的次二次函数，并且具有 $\geq 2$ 阶的一致有界空间导数，或者 (ii) $V(\cdot,t)$ 是渐近 $|x|^m, m\geq 2$ 的固定非负势的一致有界扰动，则 GP 方程具有全局解，该解始终一致地接近瞬时极小值与时间无关的 GP 泛函，前提是初始条件是基态。事实上，我们表明 GP 方程解的存在性是真正的瓶颈：如果假设存在，那么绝热性在非常小的假设下成立。

title: Projective relativistic dynamics from a quantum Lorentz algebra: time-dependent deformed Hamiltonians on (anti-)de Sitter spaces
abstract: A (non-standard) quantum deformation of the Lorentz algebra $\mathfrak{so}(1,3)$ is used to construct novel time-dependent Hamiltonian systems on the (anti-)de Sitter spacetimes in $(1+1)$-dimensions. The specific deformation considered here contains, among others, the non-standard quantum deformation of $\mathfrak{sl}(2, \mathbb{R})$ and that of the `book' algebra $\mathfrak{b}_{2}$ as quantum subalgebras. The guiding idea is to apply the theory of Poisson--Hopf deformations of Lie--Hamilton systems to the Lorentz deformation, giving rise to a broad family of time-dependent deformed systems that share the same deformed Poisson--Hopf Lorentz algebra symmetry. In particular, this approach provides Hamiltonian vector fields expressed in terms of certain projective canonical variables, which, in turn, are related to the usual Beltrami variables via a canonical transformation. Under this construction, it is shown that the underlying Lorentizan spaces possess constant curvature $\kappa$ and the quantum deformation parameter $z$ can be identified with $\kappa$, such that the cosmological constant is $\Lambda=-z\equiv -\kappa$. Therefore, we deal with the anti-de Sitter, de Sitter and Minkowskian spaces for $z>0$, $z<0$ and $z=0$ (the undeformed case), respectively. Finally, as applications, we study time-dependent deformed oscillators on the (anti-)de Sitter spaces in detail, as well as time-dependent deformed Bateman and generalised coupled Caldirola--Kanai Hamiltonians.
summary:
洛伦兹代数 $\mathfrak{so}(1,3)$ 的（非标准）量子变形用于在 $(1+1)$ 维度的（反）德西特时空中构造新颖的时间相关哈密顿系统。这里考虑的具体变形包括 $\mathfrak{sl}(2, \mathbb{R})$ 的非标准量子变形和作为量子子代数的“书”代数 $\mathfrak{b}_{2}$ 的非标准量子变形。其指导思想是将李-哈密尔顿系统的泊松-霍普夫变形理论应用于洛伦兹变形，产生一个广泛的时间相关变形系统家族，它们具有相同的变形泊松-霍普夫洛伦兹代数对称性。特别是，这种方法提供了用某些射影正则变量表示的哈密顿向量场，而这些射影正则变量又通过正则变换与通常的贝尔特拉米变量相关。在此构造下，表明底层洛伦提赞空间具有恒定曲率$\kappa$，并且量子变形参数$z$可以用$\kappa$来识别，使得宇宙学常数为$\Lambda=-z\equiv -\kappa$。

因此，我们分别处理 $z>0$、$z<0$ 和 $z=0$（未变形情况）的反德西特空间、德西特空间和闵可夫斯基空间。最后，作为应用，我们详细研究了（反）德西特空间上的时间相关变形振子，以及时间相关变形贝特曼和广义耦合卡尔迪罗拉-卡奈哈密顿量。

title: Lieb-Robinson bounds for Bose-Hubbard Hamiltonians via path expansions
abstract: We study the transport properties of Bose-Hubbard-type Hamiltonians. Kuwahara, Vu, and Saito proved sharp bounds on (i) particle transport and (ii) the Lieb-Robinson velocity for initial states with controlled boson density. We provide simpler and shorter proofs for both results using a new set of methods. For (i), boson transport, we use a class of weighted extended particle number operators that directly enables closing the associated differential inequalities. For (ii), the Lieb-Robinson bounds, we develop a bosonic version of the Chen-Lucas path expansion technique and recover the sharp velocity bound $t^{d-1}$ up to logarithmic corrections, where $d$ denotes the lattice dimension. We also extend the transport bounds (i) to long-range hopping with a power-law exponent $\alpha>d$.
