The range $\alpha\in (d,d+1)$ corresponds to an algebraic light cone for boson transport and has not been previously covered.
summary: 我们研究了 Bose-Hubbard 型哈密顿量的输运特性。 Kuwahara、Vu 和 Saito 证明了在受控玻色子密度的初始状态下 (i) 粒子输运和 (ii) Lieb-Robinson 速度的尖锐界限。我们使用一组新方法为这两个结果提供更简单、更简短的证明。对于 (i)，玻色子输运，我们使用一类加权扩展粒子数算子，可以直接关闭相关的微分不等式。对于 (ii)，即 Lieb-Robinson 边界，我们开发了 Chen-Lucas 路径扩展技术的玻色子版本，并将锐速度边界 $t^{d-1}$ 恢复到对数校正，其中 $d$ 表示晶格维度。我们还将传输界限 (i) 扩展到具有幂律指数 $\alpha>d$ 的长距离跳跃。 (d,d+1)$ 中的 $\alpha\in 范围对应于玻色子输运的代数光锥，之前没有涉及过。

title: Quantum 6j-symbols arising from a subfactor of finite index and finite depth and the zipper condition for 4-tensors in two-dimensional topological order
abstract: We study 3-tensors satisfying the ``zipper condition,'' which play an important role in tensor network approaches to two-dimensional topological order. In our previous work, we identified the 4-tensors appearing in these approaches with bi-unitary connections in the Jones theory of subfactors in operator algebras. These bi-unitary connections give rise to subfactors of finite index. We prove that, when the associated subfactor has finite depth, the 3-tensors satisfying the zipper condition correspond precisely to the quantum $6j$-symbols, also known as $F$-symbols, of the unitary multi-fusion category arising from the subfactor. This realization of quantum $6j$-symbols differs from their realization through a flat bi-unitary connection arising from the higher relative commutants of a subfactor.
summary: 我们研究满足“拉链条件”的 3 张量，它在二维拓扑顺序的张量网络方法中发挥着重要作用。在我们之前的工作中，我们确定了这些方法中出现的 4 张量与算子代数子因子琼斯理论中的双酉连接。这些二元连接产生有限指数的子因子。我们证明，当相关子因子具有有限深度时，满足拉链条件的 3 张量精确对应于子因子产生的酉多重融合类别的量子 $6j$ 符号，也称为 $F$ 符号。量子 $6j$ 符号的这种实现不同于它们通过由子因子的较高相对交换子产生的平面二元连接的实现。

title: Derivation of Novel Isotropic Metamaterials at the Hashin Shtrikman Stiffness Limit Enabled by Physics Informed Neural Networks
abstract: Current methods of deriving ultrastiff isotropic metamaterials require heuristics or topology optimization, which are highly inefficient and limited by human input. To circumvent this, Physics Informed Neural Networks are applied to analytical equations to systematically solve for plate orientations in closed cell lattices. Following a standardized procedure, the plate orientations were modelled and assembled into geometries resembling quasi random foams for validation via finite element simulations. Closed cell 6-plate geometries were also additively manufactured using LAPIS and experimentally characterized. The results indicate that a minimum of 6 plates is required to constitute an ultrastiff isotropic lattice, 7 plates would return the established plate Cubic Octet structure while 8 to 10 plate geometries did not show significant differences in properties. Despite the introduction of some plate bending due to sub-optimal plate placement strategy, relative stiffness of the PINNs lattices adheres closely to the Hashin Shtrikman upper bound, 90 percent of Hashin Shtrikman upper bound at a relative density of 0.4, and the lattices maintain near isotropic behaviour, achieving a Zener ratio of 0.95 at a relative density of 0.1. Benchmarking results show that specific stiffness of PINNs lattices is higher than the majority of isotropic architectures reported in the literature.
summary:
目前导出超硬各向同性超材料的方法需要启发式或拓扑优化，但效率极低且受到人类输入的限制。为了解决这个问题，物理信息神经网络被应用于解析方程，以系统地求解闭孔晶格中的板方向。按照标准化程序，对板的方向进行建模并组装成类似于准随机泡沫的几何形状，以便通过有限元模拟进行验证。闭孔 6 板几何形状也使用 LAPIS 增材制造并进行了实验表征。结果表明，至少需要 6 个板才能构成超硬各向同性晶格，7 个板将返回已建立的板立方八位组结构，而 8 至 10 个板几何形状在性能上没有表现出显着差异。

尽管由于次优板放置策略而引入了一些板弯曲，但 PINN 晶格的相对刚度紧密贴合于 Hashin Shtrikman 上限，在相对密度为 0.4 时达到 Hashin Shtrikman 上限的 90%，并且晶格保持接近各向同性的行为，在相对密度为 0.1 时实现了 0.95 的齐纳比。基准测试结果表明，PINN 晶格的比刚度高于文献中报道的大多数各向同性结构。

title: Mathematical and Numerical Analysis of Tsunami Generation and Propagation: The Initial Tsunami Condition
abstract: This work investigates the appropriate initial condition for tsunami propagation that allows replacing a kinematic system with its corresponding static formulation, where the bottom is fixed at its final earthquake-induced deformation. Using the two-dimensional (2D) nonlinear shallow-water equations (NSW) and a 2D dispersive $abcd$-Boussinesq system, we prove that for the NSW system, the appropriate initial free-surface condition is exactly the final bottom deformation. For the Boussinesq model, this condition is obtained by first applying a \textit{ Boussinesq filtering operator} to the bottom profile. Furthermore, for both models, we establish an error estimate between the kinematic and static solutions that depends linearly on the earthquake rise time. This result provides a rigorous mathematical explanation for the errors observed in previous numerical tsunami simulations. As a direct consequence, the error vanishes as the bottom motion becomes instantaneous. We validate the theoretical results using an Okada solution for the seabed deformation. In particular, both the NSW model and the passive approach, which initializes the free surface with the unfiltered bottom deformation, overestimate the amplitudes of the tsunami waves relative to the linear potential theory for the configurations considered.
summary:
这项工作研究了海啸传播的适当初始条件，允许用相应的静态公式替换运动系统，其中底部固定在其最终的地震引起的变形处。使用二维（2D）非线性浅水方程（NSW）和二维色散$abcd$-Boussinesq系统，我们证明对于NSW系统，适当的初始自由表面条件正是最终的底部变形。对于 Boussinesq 模型，此条件是通过首先将 \textit{ Boussinesq 过滤运算符} 应用于底部轮廓来获得的。此外，对于这两个模型，我们在运动学和静态解之间建立了线性依赖于地震上升时间的误差估计。这一结果为之前数值海啸模拟中观察到的错误提供了严格的数学解释。直接的结果是，随着底部运动变得瞬时，误差消失。我们使用 Okada 解决方案验证了海底变形的理论结果。

特别是，NSW 模型和被动方法（通过未过滤的底部变形初始化自由表面）相对于所考虑的配置的线性势理论高估了海啸波的振幅。

title: All-Disorder Localization for the One-Dimensional Anderson Model with Power-Law Hopping
abstract: We consider the one-dimensional random operator \[ (H_{\lambda,\omega}u)(n) = \sum_{m\ne n}\frac{u(m)}{|n-m|^r} +\lambda\omega_nu(n), \] where the random variables $\omega_n$ are independent and uniformly distributed on $[-1,1]$ (i.e., \mbox{$\omega_n\stackrel{\mathrm{i.i.d.}}{\sim}\operatorname{Unif}[-1,1]$}). For every $\lambda>0$ and $r>3/2$, we prove that $H_{\lambda,\omega}$ almost surely has pure point spectrum and admits an orthonormal eigenbasis $\{\psi_j\}$ satisfying \[ \sum_{n\in\bbZ}(1+|n|)^{2\tau}|\psi_j(n)|^2<\infty \qquad \text{for every }j\text{ and }0\le\tau<r-\frac32. \] These conclusions establish spectral localization, thereby rigorously confirming the prediction of earlier analytical and numerical studies in the physics literature, which identified $r=3/2$ as the marginal exponent.
summary: 我们考虑一维随机算子 \[ (H_{\lambda,\omega}u)(n) = \sum_{m\ne n}\frac{u(m)}{|n-m|^r} +\lambda\omega_nu(n), \]，其中随机变量 $\omega_n$ 独立且均匀分布在 $[-1,1]$ 上（即， \mbox{$\omega_n\stackrel{\mathrm{i.i.d.}}{\sim}\operatorname{Unif}[-1,1]$}）。对于每个 $\lambda>0$ 和 $r>3/2$，我们证明 $H_{\lambda,\omega}$ 几乎肯定具有纯点谱，并承认正交本征基 $\{\psi_j\}$ 满足 \[ \sum_{n\in\bbZ}(1+|n|)^{2\tau}|\psi_j(n)|^2<\infty \qquad \text{对于每个}j\text{ 和 }0\le\tau<r-\frac32。 \] 这些结论建立了光谱定位，从而严格证实了物理文献中早期分析和数值研究的预测，该预测将 $r=3/2$ 确定为边际指数。

title: Correlators of the Jacobi Unitary Ensemble on a General Interval and Hurwitz Numbers
abstract: We study correlators of the Jacobi Unitary Ensemble $\mathbf J(p,q,\alpha,\beta,N)$ of Hermitian matrices with spectrum in an arbitrary real interval $[p,q]$. For $(p,q)=(0,1)$, Gisonni, Grava and Ruzza expressed the large-$N$ expansion of the correlators $\langle\prod_j \mathrm{tr}\,X^{\lambda_j}\rangle$ through triple monotone Hurwitz numbers. We extend this genus expansion to arbitrary $p,q$ with $\alpha/N$ and $\beta/N$ fixed. Using the Frobenius characteristic map and the idempotent basis of the center of $\mathbb C[\mathfrak S_n]$, we also obtain an explicit formula for the Schur--Selberg type integral $\int_{(p,q)^N}\chi_\lambda(x)\,\Delta^2(x)\prod_a (q-x_a)^\beta (x_a-p)^\alpha\,\mathrm{d}^Nx$ in terms of irreducible characters of the symmetric group and content products. As consequences, we describe the zero-mean ensemble, and we recover, term by term in the genus expansion, the polygon-gluing formula for the Gaussian Unitary Ensemble in the limit $c_A=c_B\to\infty$. Structurally, passing from $[0,1]$ to $[p,q]$ leaves the hypergeometric weight of the associated 2D Toda tau function unchanged and only changes the specialization of its second set of times.
summary: 我们研究厄米特矩阵的雅可比酉系综 $\mathbf J(p,q,\alpha,\beta,N)$ 的相关器，其频谱在任意实区间 $[p,q]$ 中。对于 $(p,q)=(0,1)$，Gisonni、Grava 和 Ruzza 通过三重单调 Hurwitz 数表示相关器 $\langle\prod_j \mathrm{tr}\,X^{\lambda_j}\rangle$ 的大 $N$ 展开式。我们将此属扩展扩展到任意 $p,q$，并固定 $\alpha/N$ 和 $\beta/N$。利用Frobenius特征图和$\mathbb C[\mathfrak S_n]$中心的幂等基，我们还得到了Schur--Selberg型积分的显式公式$\int_{(p,q)^N}\chi_\lambda(x)\,\Delta^2(x)\prod_a (q-x_a)^\beta (x_a-p)^\alpha\,\mathrm{d}^Nx$ 表示对称群和内容积的不可约特征。结果，我们描述了零均值系综，并在属展开中逐项恢复了极限 $c_A=c_B\to\infty$ 下高斯酉系综的多边形粘合公式。从结构上讲，从 $[0,1]$ 传递到 $[p,q]$ 使关联的 2D Toda tau 函数的超几何权重保持不变，仅更改其第二组时间的专门化。

title: Microscopic Origin of the Equation of Motion for Open Thermodynamic Systems
abstract: In my previous work ( arXiv:2609.07810 ) \cite{Aydiner_2026}, I derived a second-order equation of motion for open thermodynamic systems from the First Law of Thermodynamics and established its dynamical equivalence with mechanical oscillators and electrical RLC circuits. In the present study, I independently recover the same mathematical structure of the equation of motion from a mesoscopic model of particle transfer between two reservoirs connected by a channel. Starting from collective momentum balance, particle conservation, and reservoir chemical-potential response, I derive the inertial--dissipative--restoring dynamics and obtain explicit expressions for its effective coefficients in terms of the physical parameters of the system. The resulting equation predicts distinct damping regimes, characteristic relaxation time scales, and resonance under periodic driving. The natural frequency and resonance conditions are explicitly determined by the physical parameters of the particle-transfer system. In the slow-transport limit, the model recovers the conventional Onsager-type linear flux--force relation. The independent emergence of the same dynamical structure from two distinct physical approaches provides theoretical support for the previously proposed thermodynamic equation of motion. By identifying the physical mechanisms underlying its effective coefficients, the present study strengthens the physical foundations of the proposed framework and supports the possibility of describing open thermodynamic systems within a common dynamical framework shared with mechanical and electrical systems.
summary:
在我之前的工作（ arXiv:2609.07810 ）\cite{Aydiner_2026} 中，我从热力学第一定律导出了开放热力学系统的二阶运动方程，并建立了其与机械振荡器和电气 RLC 电路的动力学等价。在本研究中，我独立地从通过通道连接的两个储层之间的粒子传递的介观模型中恢复了运动方程的相同数学结构。从集体动量平衡、粒子守恒和储层化学势响应出发，推导了惯性耗散恢复动力学，并根据系统的物理参数得到了其有效系数的明确表达式。由此产生的方程预测了不同的阻尼机制、特征弛豫时间尺度以及周期性驱动下的共振。固有频率和共振条件由颗粒传输系统的物理参数明确确定。在慢速传输极限下，该模型恢复了传统的 Onsager 型线性通量-力关系。

两种不同的物理方法独立出现的相同动力学结构为先前提出的热力学运动方程提供了理论支持。通过确定其有效系数背后的物理机制，本研究加强了所提出框架的物理基础，并支持在与机械和电气系统共享的通用动力学框架内描述开放热力学系统的可能性。

title: Anderson localisation in infinite and finite resonator crystals with long-range interactions
abstract: We establish Anderson localisation for random capacitance operators and quantify concentration of individual modes of finite capacitance matrices for clusters of subwavelength high-contrast resonators. The underlying geometry is fully periodic in dimensions $d=2,3$, with one resonator per cell, and the inverse material factors are independent and uniformly distributed. We retain the full capacitance interaction, whose coefficients decay exponentially with lattice separation. Under coordinate reflection symmetry, spectral and dynamical localisation hold near the upper spectral edge for every fixed positive disorder strength. At weak disorder $W$, we obtain an explicit localisation window of energy width proportional to $W$; prescribed positive intervals are localised at sufficiently large disorder. A variational boundary comparison and a material-variable eigenvalue-spacing estimate transfer localisation from truncated matrices to individual modes of the finite capacitance matrix. In a bounded sample of cell size $\varepsilon$, with probability tending to one, all except for $O(\varepsilon^{1-d}\log(1/\varepsilon))$ modes in the localisation interval concentrate within radii $O(\varepsilon\log(1/\varepsilon))$. The estimates are uniform for the contrast-dependent capacitance family at small contrast. We also prove a common limiting density of states for the truncated and finite matrices and illustrate concentration numerically.
summary:
我们为随机电容算子建立了安德森定位，并量化了亚波长高对比度谐振器簇的有限电容矩阵的各个模式的浓度。底层几何形状在维度 $d=2,3$ 上是完全周期性的，每个单元有一个谐振器，并且逆材料因子是独立且均匀分布的。我们保留了完整的电容相互作用，其系数随着晶格分离呈指数衰减。在坐标反射对称下，对于每个固定的正无序强度，光谱和动力学定位都保持在光谱上边缘附近。在弱无序$W$下，我们获得了一个能量宽度与$W$成正比的显式局部化窗口；规定的正区间位于足够大的无序处。变分边界比较和材料变量特征值间距估计将局部化从截断矩阵转移到有限电容矩阵的各个模式。

在像元大小 $\varepsilon$ 的有界样本中，概率趋于 1，除了 $O(\varepsilon^{1-d}\log(1/\varepsilon))$ 之外，定位区间中的所有模式都集中在半径 $O(\varepsilon\log(1/\varepsilon))$ 内。对于小对比度下依赖于对比度的电容系列，估计值是一致的。我们还证明了截断矩阵和有限矩阵的常见极限状态密度，并以数值方式说明了浓度。

title: Separatrix splitting in a multiferroic neuromorphic oscillator: toward Arnold diffusion
abstract: Prototype magnetic neuromorphic systems, in essence, are based either on ferromagnetic or antiferromagnetic materials as key elements for conventional neuromorphic setups. In this work, we propose a novel neuromorphic system based on a ferromagnetic disk and a ferroelectric layer coupled via the magnetoelectric effect. We study a magnetoelectrically coupled ferromagnetic--ferroelectric oscillator as a candidate element for neuromorphic devices. A local reduction of conservative Landau--Lifshitz dynamics identifies a magnetic coordinate--momentum pair, which is coupled to an inertial ferroelectric polarization mode. We derive the action--angle description of the resulting double-well--harmonic-oscillator Hamiltonian, obtain the quartic-well frequency map and Fourier coefficients in terms of elliptic functions, and establish monotone in-well twist. In the autonomous two-degree-of-freedom model, isoenergetic nondegeneracy supports KAM confinement on regular compact domains. Periodic electric forcing introduces a third effective frequency, although the harmonic magnetic sector leaves the unperturbed resonance loci parallel. An explicitly specified nonlinear magnetic extension produces transverse resonance intersections. We calculate leading resonant widths and local homoclinic splitting, and derive a damping-dependent splitting threshold for a stated scalar reduction. These results identify analytical structures relevant to transport and explain possible polarization-based electrical readout. Establishing Arnold diffusion in the coupled model requires additional connecting-orbit analysis or controlled long-time evidence; neither a diffusion law nor Nekhoroshev stability of the driven model is inferred from the present finite-time calculations.
summary:
本质上，原型磁性神经形态系统基于铁磁或反铁磁材料作为传统神经形态设置的关键元素。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种基于铁磁盘和通过磁电效应耦合的铁电层的新型神经形态系统。我们研究磁电耦合铁磁-铁电振荡器作为神经形态设备的候选元件。保守的朗道-利夫什茨动力学的局部简化确定了磁坐标动量对，该动量对与惯性铁电极化模式耦合。我们推导了所得到的双阱谐波振荡器哈密顿量的作用角度描述，获得了四次阱频率图和椭圆函数形式的傅立叶系数，并建立了单调井内扭曲。在自主二自由度模型中，等能非简并性支持规则紧域上的 KAM 限制。尽管谐波磁区使未受扰动的共振轨迹保持平行，但周期性电力强迫引入了第三个有效频率。

明确指定的非线性磁延伸产生横向共振交叉点。我们计算主导谐振宽度和局部同宿分裂，并导出用于规定标量减少的阻尼相关分裂阈值。这些结果确定了与传输相关的分析结构并解释了可能的基于偏振的电读数。在耦合模型中建立阿诺德扩散需要额外的连接轨道分析或受控的长期证据；从当前的有限时间计算中既不能推断出驱动模型的扩散定律，也不能推断出涅霍罗舍夫稳定性。

title: Supersymmetric Neuromorphic FitzHugh--Nagumo model
abstract: We develop a supersymmetric spectral description of stochastic FitzHugh--Nagumo dynamics motivated by an effective antiferromagnetic neuromorphic model. A local normal-form reduction of the adopted tangential Néel-vector dynamics relates magnetic control parameters to fast activation and slow recovery coordinates. Freezing the recovery variable yields a one-dimensional Fokker--Planck equation with a quartic potential, whose similarity-transformed generator admits an exact supersymmetric factorization. The first nonzero relaxation eigenvalue is determined by the ground state of the partner operator; in the weak-noise bistable regime, it is approximated by the sum of the two interwell Kramers rates. Projecting the similarity-transformed probability density onto the two lowest modes defines a normalized auxiliary two-state amplitude. We derive its localized-basis coherence in terms of both the time-dependent basin populations and their equilibrium weights. Its maximum corresponds to equal normalized amplitude weights, which generally differ from equal basin populations. The fixed-recovery example exhibits a pronounced coherence pulse during monotonic relaxation without a spike. Conversely, the illustrated deterministic spiking trajectory repeatedly leaves the bistable domain and passes through regions with insufficient barrier separation, restricting the validity of the localized two-state approximation. These results connect stochastic relaxation spectra to an occupation-based coherence diagnostic and delimit its application to neuromorphic spiking. The diagnostic characterizes an auxiliary amplitude representation of classical stochastic dynamics and does not by itself establish microscopic quantum coherence.
summary:
我们在有效的反铁磁神经形态模型的推动下，开发了随机 FitzHugh-Nagumo 动力学的超对称谱描述。采用的切向尼尔矢量动力学的局部正规形式简化将磁控制参数与快速激活和慢速恢复坐标相关联。冻结恢复变量会产生具有四次势的一维福克-普朗克方程，其相似变换生成器允许精确的超对称分解。第一个非零松弛特征值由伙伴算子的基态确定；在弱噪声双稳态状态下，它近似于两个井间克莱默速率之和。将相似变换的概率密度投影到两个最低模式上定义了归一化的辅助两态幅度。我们根据时间相关的流域种群及其平衡权重得出其局部基础相干性。其最大值对应于相等的归一化幅度权重，这通常不同于相等的流域群体。固定恢复示例在单调弛豫期间表现出明显的相干脉冲，没有尖峰。

相反，所示的确定性尖峰轨迹反复离开双稳态域并穿过势垒分离不足的区域，限制了局部二态近似的有效性。这些结果将随机弛豫谱与基于活动的相干性诊断联系起来，并界定了其在神经形态尖峰中的应用。该诊断表征了经典随机动力学的辅助振幅表示，并且其本身并不建立微观量子相干性。

title: Lossless propagation bounds for long-range fermionic interactions
abstract: We prove propagation estimates for extensive fermionic many-body interactions with polynomial time growth, no loss of spatial decay, and an optimal threshold for the polynomial spatial exponent. More precisely, we construct local representatives of evolved fermionic many-body interactions on metric spaces with polynomial volume growth of order $d_{\mathrm{vol}}$ and suitable cell partitions. For the even Hamiltonian interaction $\Phi_u$ and the even interaction $\Psi$ being evolved, we assume bounds, uniform in the site, on sums of term norms over finite supports $X$ containing a given site, with weights $e^{\kappa|X|}(1+\operatorname{diam}X)^a$ and $e^{\kappa|X|}(1+\operatorname{diam}X)^p$, respectively. Here $a>d_{\mathrm{vol}}$, $0\le p\le a$, $\kappa$ is sufficiently large, and the Hamiltonian bound is uniform in time. We construct local representatives whose interaction norms with weight $e^{c(1+|t-s|)^{-b}|X|}(1+\operatorname{diam}X)^p$ grow at most polynomially in $|t-s|$, for suitable $c,b>0$. In particular, $p=a$ is allowed: the Hamiltonian need not decay faster than the interaction being evolved. The threshold $a>d_{\mathrm{vol}}$ is optimal in general: uniform polynomial time bounds at $p=a$ fail for $0<a\le d_{\mathrm{vol}}$, even for smooth time-dependent two-site interactions. Polynomial time growth permits integration against filters with sufficiently many finite absolute moments, including those used in quasi-adiabatic constructions and quantum belief propagation. We derive consequences for filtered interactions and the dynamics they generate, providing dynamical estimates for perturbation theory with extensive perturbations, including gap stability, the principle that local perturbations perturb locally (LPPL), adiabatic theory, and response theory. All results also hold for quantum spin systems.
summary:
我们证明了广泛的费米子多体相互作用的传播估计，具有多项式时间增长、无空间衰减损失以及多项式空间指数的最佳阈值。更准确地说，我们在度量空间上构造进化费米子多体相互作用的局部代表，其中多项式体积增长为 $d_{\mathrm{vol}}$ 阶和合适的单元划分。对于正在演化的偶哈密顿相互作用 $\Phi_u$ 和偶相互作用 $\Psi$，我们假设在包含给定位点的有限支撑 $X$ 上的项范数之和上，在位点中均匀的边界，权重分别为 $e^{\kappa|X|}(1+\operatorname{diam}X)^a$ 和 $e^{\kappa|X|}(1+\operatorname{diam}X)^p$。这里 $a>d_{\mathrm{vol}}$, $0\le p\le a$, $\kappa$ 足够大，并且哈密顿量界在时间上是均匀的。我们构造局部代表，其权重$e^{c(1+|t-s|)^{-b}|X|}(1+\operatorname{diam}X)^p$的交互范数在$|t-s|$中最多以多项式增长，对于合适的$c，b>0$。特别是，允许​​ $p=a$：哈密顿量不需要比正在演化的相互作用更快地衰减。

阈值 $a>d_{\mathrm{vol}}$ 通常是最佳的：$p=a$ 处的均匀多项式时间界限对于 $0<a\le d_{\mathrm{vol}}$ 失败，即使对于平滑的时间相关的两个站点交互也是如此。多项式时间增长允许对具有足够多的有限绝对矩的滤波器进行积分，包括用于准绝热结构和量子置信传播的滤波器。我们推导出过滤相互作用及其产生的动力学的结果，为具有广泛扰动的扰动理论提供动态估计，包括间隙稳定性、局部扰动局部扰动原理（LPPL）、绝热理论和响应理论。所有结果也适用于量子自旋系统。

title: Koopman-von Neumann formalism meets contact Hamiltonian systems
abstract: The present work develops a Koopman--von Neumann (KvN) formulation of contact Hamiltonian dynamics on the Hilbert space defined by the contact volume. The resulting generator includes the divergence correction required for unitary evolution. We establish symmetry and, for complete contact Hamiltonian vector fields, essential self-adjointness and a strongly continuous unitary evolution; we also describe covariance under contactomorphisms. For completely integrable contact systems with complete flows, it is possible to recover an invariant direct-integral decomposition and strongly commuting KvN generators. We further relate contact KvN dynamics to the KvN formulation of its symplectization.
summary: 目前的工作在由接触体积定义的希尔伯特空间上开发了接触哈密顿动力学的库普曼-冯诺依曼 (KvN) 公式。生成的生成器包括单一进化所需的散度校正。我们建立了对称性，并且对于完全接触哈密顿向量场，基本的自共轭性和强连续酉演化；我们还描述了接触同态下的协方差。对于具有完整流的完全可积接触系统，可以恢复不变的直接积分分解和强交换 KvN 生成器。我们进一步将接触 KvN 动力学与其辛化的 KvN 公式联系起来。

title: Rényi-2 entanglement of purification of the symmetric Werner state
abstract: This paper determines exactly the Rényi-2 entanglement of purification of the normalized symmetric Werner state in every local dimension $d\ge2$ \begin{equation*} \mathrm{EoP}_2(W_{+,d})=\log_2\frac{4d(d+1)}{d^2+3d+4}. \end{equation*} We establish additivity for tensor power and, more generally, additivity for finite products of symmetric Werner states with different local dimensions. A canonical purification and its products achieve these values globally, even when arbitrary joint purifications with unrestricted finite dimensional auxiliary systems are allowed. We further examine perturbations away from the symmetric endpoint, and prove the continuity of the optimal value at this endpoint; moreover, we show a sharp square root order of variation in the optimal purity, while the canonical purification remains asymptotically optimal in the achieved entropy as this weight goes to zero.
summary: 本文精确地确定了每个局部维度 $d\ge2$ \begin{equation*} \mathrm{EoP}_2(W_{+,d})=\log_2\frac{4d(d+1)}{d^2+3d+4} 中归一化对称 Werner 态净化的 Rényi-2 纠缠。 \end{equation*} 我们建立了张量幂的可加性，更一般地说，建立了具有不同局部维度的对称维尔纳态的有限乘积的可加性。即使允许使用不受限制的有限维辅助系统进行任意联合净化，规范净化及其产品也能在全球范围内实现这些值。我们进一步检查远离对称端点的扰动，并证明该端点处最优值的连续性；此外，我们显示了最佳纯度变化的急剧平方根顺序，而当权重趋于零时，规范纯化在所实现的熵中保持渐近最佳。

title: Exhaustive Construction of Generalized Parent Hamiltonians for Matrix Product States
abstract: Characterizing local Hamiltonians that host interesting many-body states as eigenstates has been an important problem in quantum many-body physics. For matrix product states (MPS), there is a well-known construction of parent Hamiltonians that have the MPS as the frustration-free ground state. However, recent results on quantum many-body scars have shown that such a construction does not exhaust all possible Hamiltonians that have the MPS as an eigenstate. In this work, we develop an exhaustive construction of generalized parent Hamiltonians that have a given translation-invariant MPS as an eigenstate. These go beyond the conventional projector-based construction of frustration-free parent Hamiltonians, where each local Hermitian term has the MPS as an eigenstate, by allowing non-Hermitian telescoping terms that cancel out with periodic boundary conditions (PBC). We derive a local tensor equation that establishes a correspondence between inequivalent classes of generalized parent Hamiltonians, i.e., those that cannot be related using linear combinations with frustration-free Hamiltonians, and the MPS transfer matrix spectrum. We illustrate the connection to intrinsic physical properties, including non-Abelian symmetries and zero correlation length, and further extend this construction to block-injective MPS. Our framework hence provides a systematic bridge between generalized parent Hamiltonians and the local structure of quantum states.
summary:
将具有有趣的多体态的局部哈密顿量表征为本征态一直是量子多体物理学中的一个重要问题。对于矩阵积态 (MPS)，有一种众所周知的父哈密顿量构造，将 MPS 作为无挫败基态。然而，最近关于量子多体疤痕的结果表明，这种构造并没有穷尽以 MPS 作为本征态的所有可能的哈密顿量。在这项工作中，我们开发了广义父哈密顿量的详尽构造，其具有给定的平移不变 MPS 作为本征态。这些超越了传统的基于投影仪的无挫败父哈密顿量构造，其中每个局部厄米特项都将 MPS 作为本征态，通过允许非厄米特伸缩项与周期性边界条件 (PBC) 相抵消。我们推导出一个局部张量方程，该方程在广义父哈密顿量的不等价类（即那些无法使用无挫败哈密顿量的线性组合进行关联的类）与 MPS 传递矩阵谱之间建立对应关系。

我们说明了与内在物理性​​质的联系，包括非阿贝尔对称性和零相关长度，并将这种构造进一步扩展到块内射 MPS。因此，我们的框架在广义父哈密顿量和量子态的局部结构之间提供了一座系统的桥梁。

title: Distance to integrability and complexity
abstract: We consider nearest-neighbour interactions on spin-1/2 chains. We find the full set of integrable models of this form and apply a numerical algorithm to determine the "closest" integrable model for a given Hamiltonian. This allows us to define a model-independent distance to integrability. We show that standard measures of chaos interpolate between integrable and chaotic values with increasing values of this distance. However, there is a large variation across models and the distance to integrability provides additional information not directly provided by these diagnostics.
summary: 我们考虑自旋 1/2 链上的最近邻相互作用。我们找到这种形式的全套可积模型，并应用数值算法来确定给定哈密顿量的“最接近”可积模型。这使我们能够定义与模型无关的可积距离。我们表明，随着距离值的增加，混沌的标准度量在可积值和混沌值之间进行插值。然而，不同模型之间存在很大差异，并且可积分性的距离提供了这些诊断无法直接提供的附加信息。

title: Application a quantum machine learning algorithm to the applied problem of modeling the thermal regime of a servers
abstract: Quantum computing is a rapidly developed field of science. In the NISC era, quantum machine learning stands out, potentially outperforming classical machine learning. In this paper, we explore the applicability of quantum machine learning to a real-world application. We solved the problem of prediction of the temperature of GPUs in a high-performance computing cluster. We trained a quantum circuit to predict the temperature of each of the eight GPU of each cluster node based on 16 physical parameters. We demonstrated that quantum machine learning performs on this task just as well as classical machine learning. Furthermore, using model problems, we demonstrated that quantum machine learning can potentially outperform classical machine learning.
summary: 量子计算是一个快速发展的科学领域。在 NISC 时代，量子机器学习脱颖而出，有可能超越经典机器学习。在本文中，我们探讨了量子机器学习在实际应用中的适用性。我们解决了高性能计算集群中GPU温度的预测问题。我们训练了一个量子电路，根据 16 个物理参数来预测每个集群节点的 8 个 GPU 中每个 GPU 的温度。我们证明了量子机器学习在这项任务上的表现与经典机器学习一样好。此外，通过使用模型问题，我们证明了量子机器学习有可能超越经典机器学习。

title: Zero mode, Zero influence: Spatial-derivative coupling in particle detectors
abstract: It is common in particle detector models in cavity QED to often omit zero modes or assume their state, compromising causality or introducing ambiguity in their predictions. We show that spatial-derivative coupling eliminates both problems. For free massless scalar fields in static periodic or Neumann cavities of any spatial dimension, cavity-frame spatial derivatives annihilate the zero-mode operator while preserving microcausality. Detector dynamics and entanglement harvesting then depend only on the reduced detector-oscillator state, nonperturbatively and even with initial correlations with the zero mode. Time derivatives and moving-detector rest-frame spatial derivatives can retain zero-mode state dependence not compromising causality. Realized through current coupling in superconducting circuits, spatial-derivative coupling thus makes zero-mode state assumptions unnecessary.
summary: 腔 QED 中的粒子探测器模型通常会省略零模式或假设其状态，从而损害因果关系或在预测中引入模糊性。我们证明空间导数耦合消除了这两个问题。对于任何空间维度的静态周期腔或诺依曼腔中的自由无质量标量场，腔框架空间导数消除了零模算子，同时保留了微观因果关系。探测器动力学和纠缠收集仅依赖于减少的探测器振荡器状态，无扰动，甚至与零模式具有初始相关性。时间导数和移动探测器静止框架空间导数可以保留零模式状态依赖性而不损害因果关系。空间导数耦合通过超导电路中的电流耦合实现，因此无需零模式状态假设。

title: Detector Placement Relaxes Efficiency Requirements for Detecting a Weak Coherent Link
abstract: A weak coherent link can produce unusually early arrivals without changing stationary count rates. Missed jumps along routes available without the link can produce similar records, obscuring its presence. On an eight-site ring, relocating the same detector losses exposes one more crossing on the easiest background route to hide, without changing the dynamics or leading link signal. At fixed error and a common observation-time scaling, the tolerated missed fraction and time-bin width follow fourth-root rather than square-root scaling with link strength. These requirements hold for every decision using the counting record and are met using three event counts per bin, with all elapsed time included. At the same stationary collected flux, where jumps are monitored can therefore determine the time resolution needed for weak-link sensing.
summary: 较弱的相干链路可能会在不改变固定计数率的情况下产生异常提前到达的信号。沿着没有链接的可用路线错过的跳跃可能会产生类似的记录，从而掩盖其存在。在八个站点的环上，重新定位相同的探测器损耗会在最容易隐藏的背景路线上暴露出另一个交叉点，而无需改变动态或前导链路信号。在固定误差和常见的观察时间缩放下，容忍的丢失分数和时间段宽度遵循四根而不是具有链接强度的平方根缩放。这些要求适用于使用计数记录的每个决策，并且使用每个箱的三个事件计数（包括所有经过的时间）来满足这些要求。因此，在相同的固定收集通量下，监视跳跃的位置可以确定弱链路感测所需的时间分辨率。

title: Enhanced shortcuts to adiabaticity in an interacting giant-atom-atomic-waveguide system
abstract: In realistic quantum systems, isolated few-level models usually provide only an approximate description, since the controlled subsystem is generally coupled to additional degrees of freedom. As a result, a quantum control scheme designed for an isolated system may lose its original performance in a more complex coupled setting. Here, we consider a giant atom coupled to an interacting atomic waveguide and investigate enhanced shortcuts to adiabaticity (eSTA) in such a structured system. As a first step, a weak-coupling perturbative analysis identifies how changes in the initial and target states, together with dynamical transitions, contribute to the fidelity loss. Starting from a shortcut to adiabaticity control scheme for the uncoupled system, the enhanced STA correction improves the final fidelity by modifying only the giant-atom control fields. This improvement is found for both periodic and open boundary conditions of the atomic waveguide. The results demonstrate a way to design an eSTA protocol for an interacting composite system.
summary: 在现实的量子系统中，孤立的少级模型通常仅提供近似描述，因为受控子系统通常耦合到额外的自由度。因此，为孤立系统设计的量子控制方案在更复杂的耦合设置中可能会失去其原始性能。在这里，我们考虑一个与相互作用的原子波导耦合的巨型原子，并研究这种结构化系统中的增强绝热捷径（eSTA）。第一步，弱耦合扰动分析确定初始状态和目标状态的变化以及动态转换如何导致保真度损失。从非耦合系统绝热控制方案的捷径出发，增强型 STA 校正仅通过修改巨原子控制场来提高最终的保真度。对于原子波导的周期性和开放边界条件都发现了这种改进。结果展示了一种为交互复合系统设计 eSTA 协议的方法。

title: Implications of the PXP ground-state sign structure for neural-network variational Monte Carlo
abstract: Positive-definite neural-network quantum states cannot directly represent the ground state of the PXP Hamiltonian, since the ground-state wavefunction carries a nontrivial relative-sign structure. Building on the chiral symmetry of the PXP Hamiltonian, we show that this sign structure is fixed exactly by the parity of the total up-spin number: a diagonal unitary transformation that assigns a sign to each spin configuration according to this parity maps the PXP Hamiltonian to its negative, rendering the transformed Hamiltonian stoquastic on the Rydberg-blockaded Hilbert space. Since the configuration graph of allowed configurations is connected, the Perron-Frobenius theorem guarantees a unique, strictly positive ground state of the transformed Hamiltonian, yielding an exact sign rule for the ground state of the original Hamiltonian in terms of the parity of the up-spin number. Variational Monte Carlo performed directly on the transformed Hamiltonian with a positive-definite ansatz therefore requires no architecture-specific modification to represent the true ground state. We evaluate the performance of this formulation using five representative neural-network quantum state architectures, SineKAN, reflection-symmetrized SineKAN, RBM, MLP, and LSTM, for different chain lengths.
summary:
正定神经网络量子态不能直接表示 PXP 哈密顿量的基态，因为基态波函数具有非平凡的相对符号结构。基于 PXP 哈密顿量的手性对称性，我们证明了该符号结构由总上自旋数的奇偶性精确固定：根据该奇偶性为每个自旋构型分配符号的对角酉变换将 PXP 哈密顿量映射到其负值，从而在里德堡封锁希尔伯特空间上呈现变换后的哈密顿量随机性。由于允许构型的构型图是连通的，佩隆-弗罗贝尼乌斯定理保证了变换后的哈密顿量具有唯一的、严格正的基态，从而根据上自旋数的奇偶性产生原始哈密顿量的基态的精确符号规则。因此，变分蒙特卡罗直接对具有正定拟拟变换的哈密顿量执行，不需要特定于体系结构的修改来表示真实的基态。

我们使用五种代表性的神经网络量子态架构（SineKAN、反射对称 SineKAN、RBM、MLP 和 LSTM）针对不同的链长度来评估该公式的性能。

title: Photon-loss tolerance of the surface-GKP code with anti-photon-loss decoding
abstract: Photon loss somewhat limits fault-tolerant photonic quantum computing. We investigate its effect on finite-energy Gottesman--Kitaev--Preskill (GKP) states by modeling the pure-loss channel directly. We obtain photon-loss threshold estimates for the surface-GKP code using nearest-lattice-point inner GKP decoding and minimum-weight perfect matching for the outer surface code. For GKP states with $\epsilon=0.01$ and $\epsilon=0.05$, corresponding to GKP squeezing of $20$ and $13\,\mathrm{dB}$, the estimated thresholds are $\gamma^\ast=5.5\%$ ($0.24\,\mathrm{dB}$) and $\gamma^\ast=5.9\%$ ($0.26\,\mathrm{dB}$), respectively. We then introduce an anti-photon-loss inner decoder that compensates for the contraction of the measured quadrature. It increases the corresponding threshold estimates to $\gamma^\ast=9.8\%$ ($0.45\,\mathrm{dB}$) and $\gamma^\ast=6.3\%$ ($0.28\,\mathrm{dB}$). Our results highlight the importance of accounting for loss-induced lattice contraction in inner decoding and demonstrate that quadrature compensation enhances the photon-loss tolerance of surface-GKP codes for both high- and moderate-quality GKP states, providing a route toward more photon-loss-robust optical quantum computing.
summary:
光子损失在一定程度上限制了容错光子量子计算。我们通过直接模拟纯损耗通道来研究其对有限能量 Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill (GKP) 态的影响。我们使用最近格点内部 GKP 解码和外表面代码的最小权重完美匹配来获得表面 GKP 代码的光子损失阈值估计。对于 $\epsilon=0.01$ 和 $\epsilon=0.05$ 的 GKP 状态，对应于 GKP 压缩 $20$ 和 $13\,\mathrm{dB}$，估计阈值是 $\gamma^\ast=5.5\%$ ($0.24\,\mathrm{dB}$) 和 $\gamma^\ast=5.9\%$ ($0.26\,\mathrm{dB}$)，分别。然后，我们引入了一种抗光子损失内部解码器，可以补偿测量正交的收缩。它将相应的阈值估计增加到 $\gamma^\ast=9.8\%$ ($0.45\,\mathrm{dB}$) 和 $\gamma^\ast=6.3\%$ ($0.28\,\mathrm{dB}$)。

我们的结果强调了在内解码中考虑损耗引起的晶格收缩的重要性，并证明正交补偿增强了高质量和中等质量 GKP 状态的表面 GKP 代码的光子损耗容限，为实现更稳健的光子损耗光量子计算提供了一条途径。

title: Quantum algorithm for weakly correlated molecular electronic ground states with sub-quintic scaling in the system size
abstract: Weakly correlated electronic structures are predominant among molecules, and are routinely solved with heuristic classical methods such as the ``gold standard'' CCSD(T) coupled cluster model, incurring a formal time complexity $O(n^7)$ in the number of molecular orbitals and with no guarantee of energy error $\varepsilon$ at or below chemical accuracy. In this work, a quantum algorithm is presented for ground state energy estimation of weakly correlated molecules using Trotterized time evolution, with an end-to-end quantum operations cost that scales as $\tilde{O}(n^{4.8}/\varepsilon^2)$ in the limit of high-order product formulae when run as a low-depth, shot-noise limited algorithm, or $\tilde{O}(n^{4.8} + n^{3.8}/\varepsilon)$ when scaling the simulation time $T\propto 1/\varepsilon$. The algorithm combines adiabatic state preparation using a smoothed Gevrey schedule with eigenstate filtering via quantum prolate diagonalization (QPD). Both steps of the algorithm rely on a size-independent spectral gap assumption, which is validated by numerical studies on alanine chains with up to 64 monomers. We benchmark the performance of our eigenstate filtering algorithm on a set of 28 molecules to compare our approach against prior phase estimation algorithms, finding that QPD achieves state-of-the-art cost tradeoffs for $\varepsilon$-accurate results. Physical quantum resource estimates are obtained for running Trotter step circuits with up to 40 spin-orbitals, providing a clear path for scaling up quantum simulation of chemistry on early fault-tolerant hardware.
summary:
弱相关电子结构在分子中占主导地位，通常用启发式经典方法解决，例如“金标准”CCSD(T)耦合簇模型，在分子轨道数量上产生形式时间复杂度$O(n^7)$，并且不能保证能量误差$\varepsilon$等于或低于化学精度。在这项工作中，提出了一种使用 Trotterized 时间演化来估计弱相关分子基态能量的量子算法，当作为低深度、散粒噪声有限的算法运行时，端到端量子操作成本在高阶乘积公式的限制下可缩放为 $\tilde{O}(n^{4.8}/\varepsilon^2)$，或 $\tilde{O}(n^{4.8} + n^{3.8}/\varepsilon)$ 当缩放模拟时间 $T\propto 1/\varepsilon$ 时。该算法将使用平滑 Gevrey 调度的绝热态准备与通过量子扁长对角化 (QPD) 进行的本征态滤波相结合。该算法的两个步骤都依赖于与尺寸无关的光谱间隙假设，该假设通过对多达 64 个单体的丙氨酸链的数值研究得到了验证。

我们在一组 28 个分子上对本征态滤波算法的性能进行基准测试，以将我们的方法与先前的相位估计算法进行比较，发现 QPD 实现了最先进的成本权衡，获得了 $\varepsilon$ 准确的结果。获得了运行具有多达 40 个自旋轨道的 Trotter 步进电路的物理量子资源估计，为在早期容错硬件上扩展化学的量子模拟提供了清晰的路径。

title: Quantum Mpemba effect of Z2 symmetry restoration in the Dicke model
abstract: We study a symmetry-restoration quantum Mpemba effect in the dissipative Dicke model as an example of a weakly $\mathbb Z_2$-symmetric open quantum system, where the full Liouvillian is parity covariant although individual quantum jumps connect the two Hilbert-space parity sectors. Using the entanglement-asymmetry (EA) diagnostic to monitor parity restoration, we compare coherent-product and cat-product initial states. Coherent-product states show conventional relaxation, with larger initial asymmetry decaying more slowly and no Mpemba crossing observed. Cat-product states, by contrast, can reverse this hierarchy over a finite region of initial-state space. This reversal is enabled by initial-state mode filtering: the cat-product superposition suppresses the contributions of the leading slow Liouvillian modes, allowing a more asymmetric state to restore parity through faster decay channels. Our results reveal that symmetry-restoration QME can arise even when parity is preserved only as a weak Liouvillian symmetry, with quantum jumps mixing the Hilbert-space parity sectors. The anomalous relaxation is governed by initial-state-dependent filtering of the leading slow Liouvillian modes, providing a mechanism for symmetry-restoration QME beyond strongly conserved symmetry sectors.
summary:
我们研究耗散迪克模型中的对称恢复量子 Mpemba 效应，作为弱 $\mathbb Z_2$ 对称开放量子系统的例子，其中完整的刘维尔是宇称协变的，尽管单个量子跃迁连接两个希尔伯特空间宇称扇区。使用纠缠不对称（EA）诊断来监测奇偶校验恢复，我们比较了相干积和猫积的初始状态。相干积态表现出传统的弛豫，初始不对称性越大，衰减越慢，并且没有观察到 Mpemba 交叉。相比之下，猫积状态可以在初始状态空间的有限区域上反转这种层次结构。这种逆转是通过初始状态模式过滤实现的：猫乘积叠加抑制了领先的慢刘维模式的贡献，允许更不对称的状态通过更快的衰减通道恢复奇偶校验。我们的结果表明，即使奇偶校验仅保留为弱刘维尔对称性，并且量子跃迁混合了希尔伯特空间奇偶校验扇区，对称性恢复 QME 也会出现。

反常弛豫由主导慢刘维模式的初始状态相关过滤控制，为强保守对称扇区之外的对称恢复 QME 提供了一种机制。

title: On Estimating Quantum Divergences with $p$-Power Means
abstract: We study the problem of estimating the quantum divergence with $p$-power means, $\Phi_p(\rho\,\|\,\sigma)$. This quantity was investigated by Lam and Le (\textit{Linear Algebra Appl.}\ 2021). For any constant $p \in (0, 1)$, we present sample-efficient and query-efficient quantum algorithms for estimating $\Phi_p(\rho\,\|\,\sigma)$ and further show that estimating $\Phi_p(\rho\,\|\,\sigma)$ is $\mathsf{BQP}$-complete in the low-rank case.
summary: 我们研究用$p$-幂均值$\Phi_p(\rho\,\|\,\sigma)$估计量子散度的问题。 Lam 和 Le (\textit{Linear Algebra Appl.}\ 2021) 研究了这个量。对于 (0, 1)$ 中的任何常数 $p \in，我们提出了用于估计 $\Phi_p(\rho\,\|\,\sigma)$ 的样本有效和查询有效的量子算法，并进一步表明估计 $\Phi_p(\rho\,\|\,\sigma)$ 在低秩情况下是 $\mathsf{BQP}$ 完全的。

title: Pump-scheme dependence of few-emitter lasers: exact multilevel correlations and photon statistics
abstract: Few-emitter laser models usually replace the excitation cycle of the gain medium by a single Markovian pump jump of a two-level emitter. We test this replacement with the cavity and laser-transition parameters held fixed and the two-level pump rate fitted to the same mean photon number, using an exact damping-basis continued-fraction solution of the cavity--emitter master equation for $N$ identical $d$-level emitters with arbitrary independent incoherent transitions and one cavity-coupled transition, in the known reduced space of level populations and lasing coherences. First, a pump-quantum filtration shows that the inter-emitter coherence of $\Lambda$ and ladder media starts at second rather than first order in the pump; we evaluate its leading coefficient from the exact finite-system series and map the recycling rate at which its sign changes. Second, at matched photon number, rate-limited steps in the pump cycle push the long-time output-counting Fano factor of two and three emitters well below one: for two emitters it reaches 0.66 at a mean cavity occupation of 0.3 and is still 0.74 at an occupation of one, where $g^{(2)}(0)$ is within 3% of unity, because the anticorrelation sits at delays of about half a cavity lifetime rather than at zero delay. For two and three emitters the fitted two-level model gets both statistics wrong and places the output above the shot-noise level. Against independent single-emitter lasers at the same output, the common cavity erodes rather than enhances this single-emitter effect.
summary:
少发射器激光模型通常用两级发射器的单个马尔可夫泵浦跳跃来代替增益介质的激发周期。我们测试了这种替换，腔和激光跃迁参数保持固定，两级泵浦速率适合相同的平均光子数，使用腔发射器主方程的精确阻尼基连续分数解，用于具有任意独立非相干跃迁和一个腔耦合跃迁的$N$相同$d$级发射器，在已知的能级布居和激光相干性的缩减空间中。首先，泵量子过滤表明，$\Lambda$ 和阶梯介质的发射极间相干性是从泵中的二阶而不是一阶开始的；我们从精确的有限系统级数中评估其主导系数，并绘制其符号变化时的回收率。

其次，在匹配的光子数下，泵浦周期中的速率限制步骤将两个和三个发射器的长期输出计数 Fano 因子推至远低于 1：对于两个发射器，在平均腔占用为 0.3 时达到 0.66，在占用为 1 时仍为 0.74，其中 $g^{(2)}(0)$ 的误差在 3% 以内，因为反相关位于大约半个腔寿命的延迟处，而不是零延迟。对于两个和三个发射器，拟合的两级模型的统计数据都是错误的，并且输出高于散粒噪声水平。与相同输出的独立单发射器激光器相比，公共腔会削弱而不是增强这种单发射器效应。

title: Maximum purity of absolutely separable and absolutely PPT states in qutrit--qudit systems
abstract: A bipartite state is absolutely positive partial transpose (APPT) if it remains PPT under every global unitary transformation, and absolutely separable if it remains separable. For every qutrit--qudit system $\mathbb{C}^3\otimes\mathbb{C}^n$, $n\ge3$, we prove that the maximum purity is the same for absolutely separable and APPT states and equals $\max\{(3n+8)/(3n+2)^2,\,3/(8n)\}$. The maximizing ordered spectrum is unique and contains exactly two distinct eigenvalues: the larger one has multiplicity one for $3\le n\le8$ and multiplicity $n$ for $n\ge9$. We also derive, in terms of the purity, an upper bound on the minimum partial-transpose eigenvalue achievable by global unitary transformations, and characterize all states for which the bound is attained. These results confirm the inscribed-polytope purity conjecture of Ahiable, Kothakonda, and Winter for all qutrit--qudit systems. They also give a lower bound, sharp over explicit purity ranges, on the global depolarizing noise needed for absolute separability or APPT.
summary: 如果二分状态在每个全局酉变换下仍然是 PPT，则它是绝对正部分转置 (APPT)；如果它保持可分离，则它是绝对可分离的。对于每个 qutrit--qudit 系统 $\mathbb{C}^3\otimes\mathbb{C}^n$, $n\ge3$，我们证明绝对可分状态和 APPT 状态的最大纯度相同，并且等于 $\max\{(3n+8)/(3n+2)^2,\,3/(8n)\}$。最大化有序谱是唯一的，并且恰好包含两个不同的特征值：较大的特征值对于 $3\le n\le8$ 具有重数 1，对于 $n\ge9$ 具有重数 $n$。我们还根据纯度推导了通过全局酉变换可实现的最小部分转置特征值的上限，并描述了达到该界限的所有状态。这些结果证实了 Ahiable、Kothakonda 和 Winter 对所有 qutrit-qudit 系统的内接多面体纯度猜想。它们还给出了绝对可分离性或 APPT 所需的全局去极化噪声的下限，在明确的纯度范围内尖锐。

title: Logical-Class Diagnostic Layer for Stabilizer Codes and Decoders via Supercharge Structures
abstract: We develop a decoder-agnostic logical-class diagnostic layer for abelian Pauli stabilizer codes, motivated by fault-tolerant quantum computing. An ancilla fermionic register defines a nilpotent supercharge whose clean degree-zero harmonic sector is the code space. Projected-return blocks derived from graded commutators organize the recovery test of whether a decoder-selected correction preserves every encoded input for every error in a declared same-syndrome family; the passing syndromes form the certified faithful window. Demoting the supercharge to an exact binary diagnostic formulation classifies residuals modulo stabilizers, separating a check violation, a harmless stabilizer residual, and a syndrome-silent nontrivial logical action, with a two-sector form for CSS codes. Because the unknown fault cancels, the relative logical class of two record-compatible candidates is computable online. We verify the diagnostic formalisms on the Steane code and specify a static--circuit bridge audit protocol for the Gross bivariate-bicycle quantum low-density parity-check (qLDPC) code. The method supplements existing decoders without additional physical qubits for software use.
summary: 在容错量子计算的推动下，我们为阿贝尔泡利稳定器代码开发了一个与解码器无关的逻辑类诊断层。辅助费米子寄存器定义了一个幂零增压，其干净的零次谐波部分是代码空间。从分级换向器派生的投影返回块组织恢复测试，以检测解码器选择的校正是否保留声明的相同综合症系列中每个错误的每个编码输入；过去的综合症形成了经过认证的忠实窗口。将增压降级为精确的二元诊断公式，对残差模稳定器进行分类，将检查违规、无害的稳定器残差和综合症沉默的非平凡逻辑动作分开，并采用 CSS 代码的两扇区形式。因为未知的故障相互抵消，所以两个记录兼容的候选者的相对逻辑类是可以在线计算的。我们验证了 Steane 代码的诊断形式，并为 Gross 双变量自行车量子低密度奇偶校验 (qLDPC) 代码指定了静态电路桥审计协议。该方法补充了现有的解码器，无需额外的物理量子位供软件使用。

title: A GPU-Accelerated and Geometry-Aware Quantum-Classical Framework for Optimized PES Scans with CUDA-Q
abstract: Hybrid quantum-classical workloads, particularly Potential Energy Surface (PES) scans in quantum chemistry using batched VQE and QAOA, involve many structurally similar Hamiltonians differing only in coefficients. Existing warm-start and meta-optimization strategies reuse parameters between instances but still consume fixed quantum-classical resources, ignoring cross-instance structural similarities. We present OptiPESS, a GPU-accelerated runtime system for adaptive resource allocation in hybrid quantum-classical execution. OptiPESS introduces the Locality-Occupancy-Variance (LOV) metric, a lightweight, geometry-aware measure of Hamiltonian similarity, coupled with efficient alignment and Pauli-classification passes. Using LOV, OptiPESS performs distance-aware scheduling of iteration and shot budgets, predicting which instances can be skipped, quick-solved, or fully optimized. Implemented atop CUDA-Q with persistent multi-GPU execution and near-linear scaling, OptiPESS reduces classical and quantum evaluations by up to 78.3\% and wall-time by up to 74.8\% while maintaining baseline accuracy. This demonstrates how lightweight static analysis and adaptive scheduling can transform quantum-classical co-execution from fixed-budget loops into a predictive, resource-aware runtime.
summary:
混合量子经典工作负载，特别是量子化学中使用批量 VQE 和 QAOA 的势能面 (PES) 扫描，涉及许多结构相似的哈密顿量，仅系数不同。现有的热启动和元优化策略在实例之间重用参数，但仍然消耗固定的量子经典资源，忽略跨实例的结构相似性。我们推出 OptiPESS，这是一种 GPU 加速的运行时系统，用于混合量子经典执行中的自适应资源分配。 OptiPESS 引入了局部性占用方差 (LOV) 度量，这是一种轻量级、几何感知的哈密顿相似度度量，并结合了高效的对齐和泡利分类过程。 OptiPESS 使用 LOV 执行迭代和镜头预算的距离感知调度，预测可以跳过、快速解决或完全优化的实例。 OptiPESS 在 CUDA-Q 之上实施，具有持久的多 GPU 执行和近线性缩放功能，可将经典和量子评估减少高达 78.3%，将挂机时间减少高达 74.8%，同时保持基线精度。

这演示了轻量级静态分析和自适应调度如何将量子经典协同执行从固定预算循环转变为可预测的、资源感知的运行时。

title: Purity maxima, absolute separability, and spectral volumes of absolutely PPT states
abstract: For $m\otimes n$ systems with $n\ge m\ge3$, we determine the exact maximum purity of absolutely positive partial transpose (APPT) states and the unique maximizing ordered spectrum when $n\ge2m^2-4$ for even $m$ or $n\ge2m^2-m-4$ for odd $m$. Under these dimension assumptions, absolutely separable states have the same maximum purity, attained at the same unique ordered spectrum. The proof uses an outer polytope defined by two linear head--tail inequalities, each comparing a sum of the largest eigenvalues with a sum of the smallest. Under explicit multiplicity assumptions, we derive an exact matrix criterion for APPT membership of full-rank spectra with three distinct eigenvalues. For every $m\ge10$, this criterion gives explicit APPT boundary spectra at $n=4m-2$ and $n=4m$ that disprove both cases of the maximum purity conjecture of Ahiable, Kothakonda, and Winter. We also determine the exact completely absolutely separable (CAS) purity maximum and its unique maximizing ordered spectrum in every bipartite dimension. We prove that the inner APPT polytope consists entirely of absolutely separable spectra. The resulting linear sufficient condition for absolute separability strictly improves the reduction-map and eigenvalue-ratio tests. Finally, we compute the exact relative volumes of the CAS set and an outer polytope defined by a single head--tail inequality. Under the uniform measure on spectra, the CAS, absolutely separable, and APPT volumes have the same asymptotic order $\sqrt n\,e^{-\kappa_m n}$ for every fixed $m\ge2$, with explicit $\kappa_m>0$.
summary:
对于具有 $n\ge m\ge3$ 的 $m\otimes n$ 系统，我们确定绝对正部分转置 (APPT) 状态的确切最大纯度以及当 $n\ge2m^2-4$ 对于偶数 $m$ 或 $n\ge2m^2-m-4$ 对于奇数 $m$ 时的唯一最大化有序谱。在这些维度假设下，绝对可分离态具有相同的最大纯度，在相同的独特有序光谱下获得。该证明使用由两个线性头尾不等式定义的外部多面体，每个不等式将最大特征值之和与最小特征值之和进行比较。在显式多重性假设下，我们推导出具有三个不同特征值的全秩谱的 APPT 隶属度的精确矩阵标准。对于每个 $m\ge10$，该标准给出了 $n=4m-2$ 和 $n=4m$ 处的明确 APPT 边界谱，反驳了 Ahiable、Kothakonda 和 Winter 的最大纯度猜想的两种情况。我们还确定了精确的完全绝对可分离 (CAS) 纯度最大值及其在每个二分维度中独特的最大化有序谱。我们证明内部 APPT 多胞体完全由绝对可分离的光谱组成。

由此产生的绝对可分离性的线性充分条件严格改进了简化图和特征值比测试。最后，我们计算 CAS 集和由单个头尾不等式定义的外部多胞体的精确相对体积。在光谱的统一测量下，对于每个固定的 $m\ge2$，CAS、绝对可分离和 APPT 体积具有相同的渐近阶 $\sqrt n\,e^{-\kappa_m n}$，且显式 $\kappa_m>0$。

title: Decoherence suppression in quantum dense coding
abstract: By harnessing entanglement to transmit information beyond the limits of classical communication, quantum dense coding serves as a key component in various quantum technologies. However, in the noisy intermediate-scale quantum era, noise-induced decoherence poses inevitable challenges to its practical implementation. By investigating the non-Markovian decoherence dynamics of the two categories of quantum dense coding protocols realized in discrete- and continuous-variable systems, we demonstrate a physical mechanism to suppress the decoherence in quantum dense coding. It is found that the formation of a bound state in the energy spectrum of the entire system consisting of each subsystem and its local environment of the quantum channel restores the quantum advantage of dense coding in the presence of decoherence. Refreshing our understanding on the noisy effect on quantum dense coding, our finding offers a guide toward the practical realization of noise-tolerant quantum dense coding.
summary: 通过利用纠缠来传输超出经典通信限制的信息，量子密集编码成为各种量子技术的关键组成部分。然而，在嘈杂的中尺度量子时代，噪声引起的退相干对其实际实现带来了不可避免的挑战。通过研究在离散变量和连续变量系统中实现的两类量子密集编码协议的非马尔可夫退相干动力学，我们展示了一种抑制量子密集编码中退相干的物理机制。研究发现，在由每个子系统及其量子通道局部环境组成的整个系统的能谱中形成束缚态，恢复了退相干存在下密集编码的量子优势。我们的发现刷新了我们对量子密集编码的噪声影响的理解，为实际实现耐噪声量子密集编码提供了指导。

title: Quantum Lower Bounds for Collision Problems
abstract: We establish tight lower bounds on the adaptive and non-adaptive quantum query complexities of Promised $k$-to-one Finding on an exactly $k$-to-one input string $x\in\mathbb Z_q^n$, for every fixed $k\ge2$ and every feasible alphabet size $q\ge n/k$. The lower bounds are $\Omega_k(n^{1/2-1/(2(2^k-1))})$ for unrestricted adaptive algorithms and $\Omega_k(n^{1-1/k})$ for one-round non-adaptive algorithms. The former matches the adaptive quantum algorithm of Liu and Zhandry [LZ19], whereas the latter matches classical birthday sampling even when the parallel queries are arbitrarily entangled. We also establish the non-adaptive lower bound $\Omega_k(\sqrt{n/k})$ for $k$-to-one Testing when $q\ge n$, resolving an open question posed by Koiran, Landes, Portier, and Yao [KLPY10]. Our proofs generate the balanced input from a uniformly random permutation and use compressed permutation oracles to describe the information learned by the algorithm. The adaptive proof bounds the growth of partial collisions through successive queries. The one-round proof instead analyzes the state after the parallel queries directly, bounding the probability that the compressed database contains a full collision. In both proofs, a short verification step accounts for correct outputs that include unrecorded positions. For the decision problem, we also compare one-round states with independent and distinct output labels.
summary:
对于每个固定的 $k\ge2$ 和每个可行的字母大小 $q\ge n/k$，我们在精确的 $k$ 对一输入字符串 $x\in\mathbb Z_q^n$ 上对 Promised $k$ 对一查找的自适应和非自适应量子查询复杂度建立严格的下界。对于无限制自适应算法，下界为 $\Omega_k(n^{1/2-1/(2(2^k-1))})$；对于一轮非自适应算法，下界为 $\Omega_k(n^{1-1/k})$。前者匹配 Liu 和 Zhandry [LZ19] 的自适应量子算法，而后者即使在并行查询任意纠缠时也匹配经典的生日采样。我们还为 $q\gen n$ 时的 $k$ 对一测试建立了非自适应下界 $\Omega_k(\sqrt{n/k})$，解决了 Koiran、Landes、Portier 和 Yao 提出的悬而未决的问题 [KLPY10]。我们的证明从均匀随机排列生成平衡输入，并使用压缩排列预言来描述算法学到的信息。自适应证明通过连续查询限制了部分冲突的增长。

相反，一轮证明直接分析并行查询后的状态，限制压缩数据库包含完全冲突的概率。在这两个证明中，简短的验证步骤说明了包括未记录位置在内的正确输出。对于决策问题，我们还比较具有独立且不同输出标签的一轮状态。

title: Tensor Contraction with ZX Calculus, a Graph-Theoretic Approach
abstract: Tensors are higher dimensional generalisations of vectors and matrices. Tensor networks are a diagrammatic representation of complicated relations between tensors, and tensor contraction is the evaluation of a tensor network analogous to matrix multiplication. Tensor networks and tensor contraction are ubiquitous in computer science, physics, and applied mathematics. Most existing tensor contraction algorithms are focused on finding an optimal contraction order of the tensors' bonds. However, finding the optimal order is an NP-hard problem. It is equivalent to another possibly more straightforward but still NP-hard problem of finding the treewidth of the line graph of the tensor network. While in general finding the optimal bond-by-bond contraction order is hard, in many practical cases there is no need to find an optimal order. This observation leads to the core innovation of this thesis, which is a new tensor contraction paradigm that uses graph theoretic operations to produce an equivalent tensor network whose line graph has lower treewidth than the original tensor network, before applying the bond-by-bond contraction algorithm. We call these graph theoretical operations \textit{rewrite preprocessing}, and we name the algorithms that apply rewrite preprocessing before regular bond-by-bond contraction \textit{Tensor Contraction with Graph Operation}. There are many possible ways to perform rewrite preprocessing; in this thesis, we focus on the graph operations of ZX calculus, a diagrammatic language for quantum circuits. Ample numerical simulations have been performed to demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed method.
summary:
张量是向量和矩阵的高维推广。张量网络是张量之间复杂关系的图形表示，张量收缩是类似于矩阵乘法的张量网络的评估。张量网络和张量收缩在计算机科学、物理学和应用数学中无处不在。大多数现有的张量收缩算法都专注于寻找张量键的最佳收缩阶。然而，找到最优顺序是一个 NP 难题。它相当于另一个可能更直接但仍然是 NP 难题，即求张量网络线图的树宽。虽然通常很难找到最佳的逐键收缩顺序，但在许多实际情况下，不需要找到最佳顺序。这一观察结果导致了本文的核心创新，即一种新的张量收缩范式，在应用逐键收缩算法之前，使用图论运算生成等效张量网络，其线图的树宽低于原始张量网络。

我们将这些图论操作称为 \textit{重写预处理}，并将在常规键逐键收缩之前应用重写预处理的算法命名为 \textit{带图操作的张量收缩}。有许多可能的方法来执行重写预处理；在本论文中，我们重点研究 ZX 演算的图运算，ZX 演算是一种量子电路的图解语言。已经进行了大量的数值模拟来证明我们提出的方法的有效性。

title: Quantum Path Finder: Navigating Constraint Space via Non-Abelian Gauge Dynamics
abstract: Quantum algorithms are commonly designed within the circuit paradigm or through adiabatic evolution. Here we introduce \emph{Quantum Path Finder} (QPF), a distinct algorithm-design paradigm based on non-Abelian gauge dynamics in a constraint-protected degenerate manifold. Each Boolean variable is promoted to a qutrit whose additional state represents an unassigned variable. The problem Hamiltonian then defines a connected manifold of feasible partial assignments, and time-dependent local qutrit rotations generate coherent transport on this manifold. Unlike conventional adiabatic quantum computation, QPF does not require the state to follow an instantaneous eigenstate along a prescribed interpolation: adiabaticity with respect to the constraint gap protects the feasible manifold, while adiabatic following within that manifold is optional. The algorithmic task is therefore to design paths and interference in constraint space rather than only to engineer a sequence of gates or a ground-state interpolation. We illustrate the framework with three applications. For unstructured search, a two-level analysis and numerical evolution recover Grover-type scaling under explicitly stated assumptions. For complete $3$-XORSAT, the accessible gauge sector has a size-independent gap, in contrast to the exponentially closing gap of a conventional transverse-field adiabatic path. For satisfiable $3$-SAT instances, finite-size benchmarks demonstrate high satisfied-clause fractions at short classical comparison budgets, without claiming an equal-cost quantum advantage. We also outline a superconducting-qutrit implementation and discuss the conceptual relationship between QPF and nondeterministic Turing machine.
summary:
量子算法通常是在电路范式内或通过绝热演化来设计的。在这里，我们介绍\emph{量子路径查找器}（QPF），这是一种基于受约束保护的简并流形中的非阿贝尔规范动力学的独特算法设计范例。每个布尔变量都被提升为 qutrit，其附加状态表示未分配的变量。然后，问题哈密顿量定义了可行部分分配的连通流形，并且时间相关的局部四维旋转在该流形上生成相干传输。与传统的绝热量子计算不同，QPF 不需要状态沿着规定的插值遵循瞬时本征态：关于约束间隙的绝热性保护了可行流形，而该流形内的绝热跟随是可选的。因此，算法任务是设计约束空间中的路径和干扰，而不仅仅是设计一系列门或基态插值。我们用三个应用程序来说明该框架。

对于非结构化搜索，两级分析和数值演化在明确规定的假设下恢复了 Grover 型标度。对于完整的 $3$-XORSAT，可访问的规范扇区具有与尺寸无关的间隙，与传统横向场绝热路径的指数闭合间隙相反。对于可满足的 3 美元-SAT 实例，有限大小的基准测试在较短的经典比较预算下展示了较高的满足条款分数，而不声称具有等成本量子优势。我们还概述了超导-qutrit 实现，并讨论了 QPF 和非确定性图灵机之间的概念关系。

title: Rule-based hardware-configurable static analysis for quantum programs
abstract: The rapid evolution of quantum hardware necessitates an adaptable static analysis framework for validating quantum programs. In this work, we introduce SHARP, a rule-based static analysis framework designed for OpenQASM that decouples hardware-specific constraints from the validation engine. By employing a rule-based approach, SHARP allows quantum computing services to validate programs against evolving instruction set architectures (ISAs) without having to modify the core analysis engine. SHARP achieves this by ingesting ISA descriptions as standalone data, making the validation engine resilient to hardware updates. Furthermore, the framework employs an analysis-driven validation mechanism that enables multi-stage validation, simplifying rule construction and enhancing extensibility. We demonstrate how SHARP supports hardware-specific validation tasks and discuss its impact on quantum software development, including language decoupling, program-level constraint validation, and feature access control. Our findings suggest that SHARP provides a path toward a scalable and maintainable programming interface for quantum computing.
summary: 量子硬件的快速发展需要一个适应性强的静态分析框架来验证量子程序。在这项工作中，我们引入了 SHARP，这是一种为 OpenQASM 设计的基于规则的静态分析框架，可将特定于硬件的约束与验证引擎解耦。通过采用基于规则的方法，SHARP 允许量子计算服务根据不断发展的指令集架构 (ISA) 验证程序，而无需修改核心分析引擎。 SHARP 通过将 ISA 描述摄取为独立数据来实现这一目标，使验证引擎能够适应硬件更新。此外，该框架采用分析驱动的验证机制，可实现多阶段验证，简化规则构建并增强可扩展性。我们演示了 SHARP 如何支持特定于硬件的验证任务，并讨论其对量子软件开发的影响，包括语言解耦、程序级约束验证和功能访问控制。我们的研究结果表明，SHARP 为量子计算提供了一条通往可扩展且可维护的编程接口的道路。

title: Classical and Quantum Logics with Multiple Non-Equivalent and Non-Isomorphic Models
abstract: Both quantum and classical logics have several mutually non-equivalent and non-isomorphic models as has repeatedly been proved in the literature. Yet, several authors have recently come with criticisms of this result. In this paper, we show that the criticisms are either unfounded or wrong.
summary: 正如文献中反复证明的那样，量子逻辑和经典逻辑都具有几个相互非等价和非同构的模型。然而，一些作者最近对这一结果提出了批评。在本文中，我们表明这些批评要么毫无根据，要么是错误的。

title: Qubrio: High-Performance Quantum Compilation via Multi-Agent LLM Collaboration
abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) offer an adaptable alternative to traditional quantum compilation heuristics, which bottleneck progress by demanding costly manual redesigns whenever hardware evolves. However, naive single-pass LLM approaches fail under the unique challenges introduced by quantum compilation. We introduce Qubrio, a practical agentic framework that significantly reduces heuristic redesigns through a three-level decomposition. By (1) partitioning programs into sequential operation stages, (2) deploying specialized agents for placement, routing and optimization, and (3) using disaggregated feedback for precise error correction, our system reliably navigates complex physical constraints. Beyond serving as a direct compiler, our LLM framework also uncovers novel strategies that facilitate convoy-style shuttling, substantially enhancing hardware concurrency without sacrificing fidelity. We further integrate these strategies into the previous state-of-the-art (SOTA) compiler, recovering a significant fraction of the LLM's performance advantages. On realistic workloads, our compiler achieves significant improvements in hardware runtime and program fidelity over the SOTA baseline PowerMove, seamlessly adapting to new hardware capabilities. Qubrio features an open user interface for practical use, and its code is publicly available at this https URL .
summary:
大型语言模型 (LLM) 为传统的量子编译启发式方法提供了一种适应性强的替代方案，传统的量子编译启发式方法在硬件发展时要求昂贵的手动重新设计，从而阻碍了进度。然而，单纯的单通道法学硕士方法在量子编译带来的独特挑战下失败了。我们引入了 Qubrio，一个实用的代理框架，它通过三级分解显着减少启发式重新设计。通过（1）将程序划分为连续的操作阶段，（2）部署专门的代理进行布局、路由和优化，以及（3）使用分类反馈进行精确的纠错，我们的系统可靠地应对复杂的物理约束。除了充当直接编译器之外，我们的 LLM 框架还揭示了促进车队式穿梭的新颖策略，在不牺牲保真度的情况下大幅增强硬件并发性。我们进一步将这些策略集成到之前最先进的 (SOTA) 编译器中，恢复了 LLM 性能优势的很大一部分。

在实际工作负载上，我们的编译器在 SOTA 基线 PowerMove 的基础上实现了硬件运行时间和程序保真度的显着改进，无缝适应新的硬件功能。 Qubrio 具有可供实际使用的开放式用户界面，其代码可在 https URL 上公开获取。

title: Probing non-adiabaticity in a quantum Otto cycle through quantum texture and imaginarity
abstract: Finite-time driving in quantum thermodynamic cycles inevitably generates coherences in the instantaneous energy basis, leading to quantum friction and degrading the operational performance. In this work, we demonstrate that the non-adiabatic inner friction produced during unitary driving of a two-level system can be faithfully quantified by combining two distinct resource-theoretic notions: quantum texture (rugosity) and imaginarity. We show that neither rugosity nor imaginarity alone is sufficient to track the total non-adiabaticity, and we introduce a combined witness, which is strictly non-negative and vanishes if and only if the driving is quasi-static. Applying this framework to a finite-time quantum Otto refrigerator, we establish an exact closed-form relation connecting the coefficient of performance directly to the quantum texture and imaginarity, evaluated at the end of the unitary compression and expansion strokes. Furthermore, we show that local minima of the non-adiabatic witness accurately identify the operating regimes that maximize cooling performance. Our findings provide a geometric and resource-theoretic foundation for inner friction, offering practical diagnostic tools for optimizing finite-time quantum thermal machines.
summary:
量子热力学循环中的有限时间驱动不可避免地会在瞬时能量基础上产生相干性，导致量子摩擦并降低运行性能。在这项工作中，我们证明了在二能级系统的酉驱动过程中产生的非绝热内摩擦可以通过结合两个不同的资源理论概念来忠实地量化：量子纹理（粗糙度）和虚数。我们证明，仅靠粗糙度和想象都不足以追踪总的非绝热性，并且我们引入了一个组合见证，它是严格非负的，并且当且仅当驾驶是准静态时才消失。将此框架应用于有限时间量子奥托冰箱，我们建立了一种精确的封闭式关系，将性能系数直接连接到量子纹理和想象力，并在单一压缩和膨胀冲程结束时进行评估。此外，我们表明非绝热见证的局部最小值准确地识别了最大化冷却性能的操作状态。

我们的研究结果为内摩擦提供了几何和资源理论基础，为优化有限时间量子热机提供了实用的诊断工具。

title: Shallow data-loading circuits for multivariable functions
abstract: We construct shallow QROM, diagonal block-encoding, and quantum state preparation oracles for analytic functions on the $D$-dimensional hypercube $[0, 1]^D$. On $n$ qubits and with $2^{- \Omega (n/D)}$ error, these circuits have depths of $O \left( \sqrt{\frac{n \log_2 (n)}{D}} \right)$ in the Clifford + $T$ gate set, albeit using $2^{O(\sqrt{nD \log_2 (n)})}$ ancilla qubits. This is a near-quadratic depth reduction compared to known linear-depth methods.
summary: 我们为 $D$ 维超立方体 $[0, 1]^D$ 上的解析函数构建浅 QROM、对角块编码和量子态准备预言。在 $n$ 量子位上，并且存在 $2^{- \Omega (n/D)}$ 误差，这些电路在 Clifford + $T$ 门集中的深度为 $O \left( \sqrt{\frac{n \log_2 (n)}{D}} \right)$，尽管使用 $2^{O(\sqrt{nD \log_2 (n)})}$ 辅助量子位。与已知的线性深度方法相比，这是近二次方的深度减少。

title: State Synthesis with an NP oracle
abstract: In this note, I describe a quantum algorithm that prepares an arbitrary state $|\psi\rangle$ to inverse exponential precision in polynomial time by making queries to an $\mathsf{NP}$ oracle, assuming one can directly query entries of the state vector corresponding to $|\psi\rangle$. The previous best upper bound on the complexity class required by an oracle for this task was $\mathsf{PP}$. I provide evidence that $\mathsf{NP}$ is the best possible upper bound by showing that any quantum algorithm using a $\mathsf{P}$ oracle, or even a $\mathsf{P/poly}$ oracle, requires exponentially many queries. I also discuss some implications of this result for the $\mathsf{QMA}$ search-to-decision problem and unitary synthesis.
summary: 在本文中，我描述了一种量子算法，通过查询 $\mathsf{NP}$ 预言机，假设可以直接查询与 $|\psi\rangle$ 对应的状态向量条目，从而在多项式时间内准备任意状态 $|\psi\rangle$ 以实现逆指数精度。预言机执行此任务所需的复杂性等级的先前最佳上限是 $\mathsf{PP}$。我通过证明任何使用 $\mathsf{P}$ 预言机甚至 $\mathsf{P/poly}$ 预言机的量子算法都需要指数级数量的查询来证明 $\mathsf{NP}$ 是最佳可能的上限。我还讨论了这个结果对 $\mathsf{QMA}$ 搜索决策问题和酉综合的一些影响。

title: Finite attainment and efficient computation of regularized quantum channel relative entropy
abstract: Quantum channel relative entropy can be nonadditive, making its regularization essential for asymptotic analysis. We study when the regularized value is attained at finite blocklength and how efficiently it can be approximated. For the first question, we establish a sharp dichotomy: the regularized value is either attained already at the single-copy level, implying additivity at every blocklength, or is never attained at any finite blocklength. Notably, a simple two-copy additivity test distinguishes between these alternatives for qubit channels and for channel pairs in arbitrary dimensions admitting an interior optimizer. We further show that both the interiority condition and finite nonattainment are generic, holding for almost every channel pair. For the second question, we establish explicit convergence rates for approximating the regularized channel relative entropy. For fixed channel dimensions, $\widetilde O(\varepsilon^{-3/2})$ channel copies suffice to approximate the regularized value to additive accuracy $\varepsilon$. Alternatively, a semidefinite hierarchy achieves the same accuracy at level $\widetilde O(\varepsilon^{-2})$, yielding a certified polynomial-time approximation. Together, these results reveal the intriguing structure and generic behavior of regularized channel relative entropy, sharpening our understanding of both its analytical and computational aspects.
summary:
量子通道相对熵可以是非加性的，这使得其正则化对于渐近分析至关重要。我们研究何时在有限块长度下获得正则化值以及如何有效地近似它。对于第一个问题，我们建立了一个尖锐的二分法：正则化值要么已经在单副本级别获得，意味着每个块长度的可加性，要么永远不会在任何有限块长度获得。值得注意的是，简单的两副本可加性测试可以区分量子位通道和允许内部优化器的任意维度的通道对的这些替代方案。我们进一步表明，内部性条件和有限未达标都是通用的，几乎适用于每个通道对。对于第二个问题，我们建立了显式收敛率来近似正则化通道相对熵。对于固定通道维度，$\widetilde O(\varepsilon^{-3/2})$通道副本足以将正则化值逼近到附加精度$\varepsilon$。

或者，半定层次结构在 $\widetilde O(\varepsilon^{-2})$ 级别上实现相同的精度，从而产生经过认证的多项式时间近似。总之，这些结果揭示了正则化通道相对熵的有趣结构和一般行为，加深了我们对其分析和计算方面的理解。

title: Barycentric programming: Classical realization of programs for universal quantum processors
abstract:
A programmable quantum processor implements a target unitary using information stored in a classical or quantum program register. For arbitrary unitaries in $\mathrm{SU}(d)$, quantum programs attain the optimal leading-order memory cost, whereas deterministic classical rounding requires twice as much memory for the same diamond-distance error. We show that this gap disappears when classical randomization is allowed. We introduce barycentric programming, which stores the label of a unitary randomly selected from a finite set, with probabilities chosen so that first-order approximation errors cancel in the averaged unitary channel. Consequently, the diamond-distance error scales quadratically with the discretization spacing. For any $
u$-parameter family of unitaries forming a compact, smooth manifold without boundary, this method achieves error $\varepsilon$ using only $(
u/2)\log_2(1/\varepsilon)+O(1)$ classical bits. We also prove a matching lower bound for arbitrary quantum programs, determining the optimal leading-order program size for general unitary families. Thus, classical randomization achieves the optimal scaling $(
u/2+o(1))\log_2(1/\varepsilon)$ without requiring coherent quantum memory.
summary:
可编程量子处理器使用存储在经典或量子程序寄存器中的信息来实现目标酉。对于 $\mathrm{SU}(d)$ 中的任意幺正，量子程序获得最佳的前序内存成本，而确定性经典舍入对于相同的菱形距离误差需要两倍的内存。我们证明，当允许经典随机化时，这种差距就会消失。我们引入了重心编程，它存储从有限集中随机选择的酉的标签，并选择概率以便在平均酉通道中消除一阶近似误差。因此，菱形距离误差与离散化间距呈二次方关系。对于形成紧凑、光滑无边界流形的任何 $
u$ 酉参数族，此方法仅使用 $(
u/2)\log_2(1/\varepsilon)+O(1)$ 经典位即可实现误差 $\varepsilon$。我们还证明了任意量子程序的匹配下界，确定了一般酉族的最佳前序程序大小。

因此，经典随机化无需相干量子存储器即可实现最佳缩放 $(
u/2+o(1))\log_2(1/\varepsilon)$。

title: Logarithmic Bias of Zero-Noise Extrapolation under 1/f Noise
abstract: Zero-noise extrapolation estimates ideal quantum observables by amplifying noise and extrapolating the measured response. Its accuracy depends on whether the extrapolation model captures the physical effect of amplification, including correlations between repeated operations. Here we derive the response of complete multiqubit gate folding in the simultaneous presence of time-local Markovian noise and stationary finite-band 1/f noise. An ordered circuit kernel couples the observable to noise memory; exact block counting shows how folding samples correlations at increasing time separations. The resulting response contains an r^2 ln r coordinate, with a coefficient fixed by the noise spectrum and the integrated forward-inverse control response. Ordinary polynomial Richardson extrapolation leaves a calculable contribution from this coordinate; the three-node rule (1,3,5) retains 2.73 theta. We construct response-matched extrapolation, including a log-domain implementation, that cancels this contribution at the retained order. Explicit bounds separate the remaining control-shape, finite-band, higher-order, and native-offset errors. The theory applies to arbitrary finite multiqubit circuits within the stated control and noise model, and distinguishes removal of memory-induced bias from an unconditional guarantee of the ideal intercept. Single- and ten-qubit numerical examples illustrate the predicted correction and its response dependence.
summary:
零噪声外推通过放大噪声并外推测量的响应来估计理想的量子可观测量。其准确性取决于外推模型是否捕获放大的物理效应，包括重复操作之间的相关性。在这里，我们推导了在时间局部马尔可夫噪声和稳态有限带 1/f 噪声同时存在的情况下完整的多量子位门折叠的响应。有序电路内核将可观测值与噪声存储器耦合；精确的块计数显示了折叠样本在时间间隔增加时的相关性。所得响应包含 r^2 ln r 坐标，其系数由噪声频谱和积分正向-反向控制响应固定。普通多项式理查森外推法从该坐标中留下了可计算的贡献；三节点规则 (1,3,5) 保留 2.73 theta。我们构建了响应匹配的外推法，包括对数域实现，它在保留的顺序上取消了这种贡献。显式边界将剩余的控制形状误差、有限带误差、高阶误差和本机偏移误差分开。

该理论适用于所述控制和噪声模型内的任意有限多量子位电路，并将消除内存引起的偏差与无条件保证理想截距区分开来。单量子位和十量子位数值示例说明了预测的校正及其响应依赖性。

title: Quantum teleportation using photon-added two-mode squeezed Fock states: A comparison with photon-subtracted counterparts
abstract: Quantum state engineering frequently employs non-Gaussian operations, particularly photon addition and subtraction, to tailor and improve the nonclassical characteristics of quantum states. We investigate how photon addition to a two-mode squeezed Fock state (TMSFS) influences its performance in the Braunstein-Kimble quantum teleportation protocol. We obtain the Wigner characteristic function of the photon-added TMSFS (PA-TMSFS) and evaluate the corresponding teleportation fidelities for both Gaussian and non-Gaussian input states. We further compare the teleportation performance of PA-TMSFS with that of its photon-subtracted counterpart by accessing their fidelity enhancements over the parent TMSFS and considering the probabilistic nature of both the operations. Our results demonstrate that photon subtraction provides superior teleportation performance compared with photon addition, with this advantage becoming more pronounced when the success probabilities of the corresponding non-Gaussian operations are considered. In particular, the symmetric $(1,1)$ photon subtraction yields the optimal trade-off between teleportation fidelity and success probability among the configurations investigated. These findings highlight that photon subtraction retains its advantage even when the underlying entangled resource is already non-Gaussian.
summary:
量子态工程经常采用非高斯运算，特别是光子相加和相减，来定制和改进量子态的非经典特性。我们研究了双模压缩福克态 (TMSFS) 中的光子添加如何影响其在 Braunstein-Kimble 量子隐形传态协议中的性能。我们获得了光子添加 TMSFS (PA-TMSFS) 的维格纳特征函数，并评估了高斯和非高斯输入状态的相应隐形传态保真度。我们通过访问 PA-TMSFS 相对于父 TMSFS 的保真度增强并考虑这两种操作的概率性质，进一步比较 PA-TMSFS 与其光子扣除对应物的隐形传态性能。我们的结果表明，与光子相加相比，光子相减提供了优越的隐形传态性能，当考虑相应的非高斯操作的成功概率时，这种优势变得更加明显。

特别是，对称 $(1,1)$ 光子减法在所研究的配置中产生隐形传态保真度和成功概率之间的最佳权衡。这些发现强调，即使底层纠缠资源已经是非高斯的，光子减法仍然保持其优势。

title: unitaryQIP = unitaryPSPACE
abstract: Unitary synthesis complexity studies the computational cost of applying a target unitary to an unknown quantum state, extending complexity theory beyond its traditional focus on problems with classical inputs and outputs. Rosenthal and Yuen (ITCS 2022) introduced two complexity classes for unitary synthesis: $\mathsf{unitaryQIP}$ and $\mathsf{unitaryPSPACE}$ for the unitary families implementable via interactive proofs and in polynomial space, respectively. In this work, we prove the equality $\mathsf{unitaryQIP}=\mathsf{unitaryPSPACE}$ and thereby establish a unitary-complexity analogue of $\mathsf{QIP} = \mathsf{PSPACE}$ (Jain, Ji, Upadhyay, and Watrous, J. ACM 2011) and $\mathsf{stateQIP}=\mathsf{statePSPACE}$ (Rosenthal and Yuen, ITCS 2022; Metger and Yuen, FOCS 2023). To prove $\mathsf{unitaryQIP} \subseteq \mathsf{unitaryPSPACE}$, we use an acceptance rigidity lemma derived from the soundness condition to show that the polynomial-space prover constructed for a fixed input in state synthesis (Metger and Yuen, FOCS 2023) implements the target unitary on every input, leading to a polynomial-space simulation of the protocol. For the reverse inclusion, we build on OpenAI's recently announced solution to the unitary synthesis problem (Aaronson and Kuperberg, Theory Comput. 2007), and show that $\mathsf{unitaryPSPACE}$ families can be synthesized in polynomial time with a $\mathsf{PSPACE}$ oracle. We then implement the oracle queries using auxiliary states prepared via the $\mathsf{statePSPACE} \subseteq \mathsf{stateQIP}$ protocol (Rosenthal and Yuen, ITCS 2022). Beyond the equality, we show that our protocol for $\mathsf{unitaryPSPACE}$ can be parallelized to constant rounds when the verifier receives polynomially many copies of the input, and we also obtain a complexity-theoretic barrier to proving the existence of $\mathsf{EFI}$ pairs.
summary:
酉合成复杂性研究将目标酉应用于未知量子态的计算成本，将复杂性理论扩展到传统的经典输入和输出问题之外。 Rosenthal 和 Yuen (ITCS 2022) 为酉综合引入了两个复杂度类： $\mathsf{unitaryQIP}$ 和 $\mathsf{unitaryPSPACE}$ 分别用于可通过交互式证明和多项式空间实现的酉族。在这项工作中，我们证明了等式 $\mathsf{unitaryQIP}=\mathsf{unitaryPSPACE}$ ，从而建立了 $\mathsf{QIP} = \mathsf{PSPACE}$ 的酉复杂度模拟 (Jain, Ji, Upadhyay, and Watrous, J. ACM 2011) $\mathsf{stateQIP}=\mathsf{statePSPACE}$（Rosenthal 和 Yuen，ITCS 2022；Metger 和 Yuen，FOCS 2023）。为了证明 $\mathsf{unitaryQIP} \subseteq \mathsf{unitaryPSPACE}$，我们使用从健全性条件导出的接受刚性引理来表明，为状态综合中的固定输入构建的多项式空间证明器（Metger 和 Yuen，FOCS 2023）在每个输入上实现了目标酉，从而实现了协议的多项式空间模拟。

对于反向包含，我们以 OpenAI 最近宣布的酉综合问题解决方案为基础（Aaronson 和 Kuperberg，Theory Comput.2007），并表明 $\mathsf{unitaryPSPACE}$ 系列可以使用 $\mathsf{PSPACE}$ 预言机在多项式时间内综合。然后，我们使用通过 $\mathsf{statePSPACE} \subseteq \mathsf{stateQIP}$ 协议准备的辅助状态来实现预言机查询（Rosenthal 和 Yuen，ITCS 2022）。除了等式之外，我们还表明，当验证者收到输入的多项式多个副本时，我们的 $\mathsf{unitaryPSPACE}$ 协议可以并行化为常量轮次，并且我们还获得了证明 $\mathsf{EFI}$ 对存在的复杂性理论障碍。

title: Full-Rank Constructions of Explicit Lossless Expanders and Good Small-Set qLTCs
abstract: We construct explicit two-sided lossless expanders whose binary adjacency matrices have full rank, and use them to obtain explicit asymptotically good quantum LDPC codes whose specified X- and Z-check matrices have full row rank and satisfy small-set soundness, or confinement, on a linear range. Our lossless expanders are a variant of those of Hsieh, Lubotzky, Mohanty, Reiner, and Zhang, with a free action of a finite 2-group. Under such an action, injectivity and surjectivity of the adjacency matrix are detected on a fixed-size matrix indexed by vertex orbits. Adding a sparse factor to the gadget at the middle vertices of a single type then enforces full rank, with a controlled loss in expansion. To obtain the 2-group action, we observe that reducing the generators of the Lubotzky-Phillips-Sarnak Ramanujan graphs modulo powers of 2, instead of modulo an odd prime, gives Ramanujan Cayley graphs on finite 2-groups. This construction may be of independent interest. Plugging two such expanders into the balanced product of Lin and Hsieh gives the quantum codes, since full rank of the input graphs is inherited by the check matrices. Our construction supplies the code family sought by Hong, Guo, and Lucas. Applying their analysis, within their framework and under their dynamical assumptions, gives quantum memories whose free-energy density is analytic at every positive temperature and whose guaranteed lifetime is $exp(\Omega(N))$ at sufficiently low fixed positive temperature, where N is the blocklength. This improves the previously guaranteed stretched-exponential timescale.
summary:
我们构造了二元邻接矩阵具有满秩的显式双边无损扩展器，并使用它们来获得显式渐近良好的量子 LDPC 码，其指定的 X 和 Z 校验矩阵具有满行秩并满足线性范围上的小集健全性或限制。我们的无损扩展器是Hsieh、Lubotzky、Mohanty、Reiner 和Zhang 的变体，具有有限2 群的自由作用。在这种作用下，在由顶点轨道索引的固定大小矩阵上检测邻接矩阵的单射性和满射性。在单个类型的中间顶点处向小工具添加稀疏因子，然后强制执行满排名，并控制扩展损失。为了获得 2 群作用，我们观察到减少 Lubotzky-Phillips-Sarnak Ramanujan 图的生成元以 2 为模幂，而不是以奇素数为模，给出有限 2 群上的 Ramanujan Cayley 图。该构造可能具有独立的利益。将两个这样的扩展器插入 Lin 和 Hsieh 的平衡积中就可以得到量子代码，因为输入图的满秩是由校验矩阵继承的。

我们的构建提供了 Hong、Guo 和 Lucas 所寻求的代码系列。在他们的框架内和动力学假设下应用他们的分析，给出了量子存储器，其自由能密度在每个正温度下都是解析的，并且其保证寿命在足够低的固定正温度下为 $exp(\Omega(N))$，其中 N 是块长度。这改善了之前保证的拉伸指数时间尺度。

title: Inducing cooperative dynamics in an inhomogeneous many-emitter ensemble with a pulse sequence
abstract: Driving a many-particle quantum system with an appropriately tuned external field can give rise to features in its nonequilibrium dynamics that are absent in the equilibrium counterpart. Cooperative dynamics in a dense ensemble of quantum emitters manifested through superradiance, a burst in the emission intensity as a function of time, is typically suppressed by spectral disparities among emitters in the ensemble. We demonstrate the enhancement of cooperative dynamics in a spectrally inhomogeneous ensemble of quantum emitters when it is driven by a periodic pulse sequence. Using both a semi-analytical mean-field solution and a digital quantum simulation, we examine the coherence of the pulse-driven ensemble and the intensity of the emitted radiation as a function of the spectral disparity in the ensemble, as a function of time, the number of atoms in the system, and as a function of the inter-pulse delay. We identify clear signatures of the enhanced cooperative dynamics for the pulse-driven inhomogeneous ensemble when dephasing in the dynamics of the ensemble is suppressed by a sufficient number of pulses during the individual emitter lifetime. These results demonstrate a post-fabrication tuning knob based on externally applied control fields for the dynamics of the many-emitter ensemble.
summary:
用适当调谐的外场驱动多粒子量子系统可以产生其非平衡动力学特征，而这些特征在平衡对应物中是不存在的。通过超辐射（发射强度随时间变化的突发）表现出来的密集量子发射器群中的协同动力学通常被群中发射器之间的光谱差异所抑制。我们证明了当由周期性脉冲序列驱动时，光谱不均匀的量子发射器集合中的协作动力学得到增强。使用半解析平均场解和数字量子模拟，我们检查了脉冲驱动系综的相干性和发射辐射的强度，作为系综中光谱差异的函数，作为时间、系统中原子数量的函数，以及作为脉冲间延迟的函数。当在单个发射器寿命期间通过足够数量的脉冲抑制系综动力学的相移时，我们确定了脉冲驱动的非均匀系综增强的协作动力学的清晰特征。

这些结果展示了基于外部施加的控制场的制造后调谐旋钮，用于多发射器系综的动态。

title: Second-order mean force Gibbs state of fermionic open systems
abstract: Thermodynamics typically assumes that a system in contact with a thermal reservoir relaxes to the Gibbs state, or to the grand canonical Gibbs state when it also exchanges particles. However, this only holds when the coupling is very weak. Beyond this, the expected equilibrium state is the mean force Gibbs (MFG) state, obtained by tracing the reservoir out of the thermal state of the combined system. Despite its relevance, general analytic results for the MFG state have so far been obtained almost exclusively for bosonic reservoirs. Here we derive the grand canonical MFG state to second order in the coupling for a generic fermionic system coupled to a thermal reservoir at arbitrary chemical potential, using the concept of the mode reduced state in order for the fermionic MFG state to be well defined. The correction to the bare Gibbs state separates into particle and hole channels weighted by the empty and occupied reservoir states, related through the Kubo-Martin-Schwinger condition. We apply the result to the resonant level model, two modes coupled to a shared reservoir, and the single impurity Anderson model. For the two modes, the reservoir mediates coherence between modes that do not interact directly, something the bare Gibbs state cannot capture.
