We verify our results against numerically exact calculations, including real-time dynamics for the interacting model, and find agreement between the static prediction and the dynamical relaxation.
summary:
热力学通常假设与热储层接触的系统松弛到吉布斯状态，或者当它也交换粒子时松弛到大正则吉布斯状态。然而，这仅在耦合非常弱时成立。除此之外，预期的平衡状态是平均力吉布斯 (MFG) 状态，通过追踪组合系统热状态下的储层而获得。尽管具有相关性，但到目前为止，MFG 状态的一般分析结果几乎都是针对玻色子储层获得的。在这里，我们使用模式还原态的概念，将通用费米子系统耦合到任意化学势的热库的耦合中的大正则 MFG 状态导出为二阶，以便很好地定义费米子 MFG 状态。对裸吉布斯状态的校正分为由空和占据的储层状态加权的粒子和空穴通道，通过 Kubo-Martin-Schwinger 条件相关。我们将结果应用于共振能级模型、耦合到共享储层的两种模式以及单一杂质安德森模型。

对于这两种模式，储存库调解不直接相互作用的模式之间的一致性，这是裸吉布斯状态无法捕获的。我们根据数值精确计算验证我们的结果，包括交互模型的实时动态，并找到静态预测和动态松弛之间的一致性。

title: On physical origin of Berry connection of free relativistic electrons
abstract: No consensus has been reached on the appropriate operators for the spin and orbital angular momentum of free relativistic electrons. But there is a tendency to believe the existence of a spin-orbit coupling through the Berry connection. Here we show that this is not the case. Because the positive-energy solution of the Dirac equation is associated with the state of the electron, it is reasonable to postulate that only when projected onto the positive-energy subspace can observable operators on the Hilbert space of the Dirac equation represent physical quantities of the electron. On this basis, we find, after mapping the projected operators onto an irreducible representation, that the Berry connection describes the position of a quantum reference point with respect to the laboratory reference frame, relative to which the position of the electron is canonical. The orbital angular momentum of the quantum reference point about the origin of the laboratory reference frame is expressed in terms of the Berry connection. It combines with the canonical orbital angular momentum of the electron about the quantum reference point to give the orbital angular momentum of the electron about the origin of the laboratory reference frame.
summary:
对于自由相对论电子的自旋和轨道角动量的适当算子尚未达成共识。但人们倾向于相信通过贝里连接存在自旋轨道耦合。在这里我们证明事实并非如此。由于狄拉克方程的正能量解与电子的状态相关，因此可以合理地假设，只有投影到正能量子空间上，狄拉克方程的希尔伯特空间上的可观算子才能代表电子的物理量。在此基础上，我们发现，在将投影算子映射到不可约表示之后，贝里连接描述了量子参考点相对于实验室参考系的位置，相对于实验室参考系，电子的位置是规范的。量子参考点关于实验室参考系原点的轨道角动量用贝里联系表示。

它与电子关于量子参考点的正则轨道角动量相结合，给出电子关于实验室参考系原点的轨道角动量。

title: Correlated Catalysis Removes the Strong Converse for Entanglement Distillation
abstract: Entanglement distillation converts noisy shared quantum states into maximally entangled pairs using local operations and classical communication. The distillable entanglement $E_D$ determines the maximum asymptotic rate at which this process can be performed reliably. For several classes of quantum states, distillation above this rate obeys a strong converse: the fidelity with the target state vanishes asymptotically. Here we show that correlated catalysis removes the strong converse for every distillable bipartite state. Specifically, at any target rate $R>E_D$, the optimal asymptotic fidelity is given by $E_D/R$. Thus, although catalysis does not increase the maximum reliable distillation rate, it allows nonvanishing fidelity at every finite rate. Remarkably, this advantage persists even when the catalyst is returned exactly at every finite blocklength and the correlations between the output and catalyst vanish asymptotically. We further characterize the catalyst size required to sustain nonvanishing fidelity above the reliable distillation rate.
summary: 纠缠蒸馏使用局部操作和经典通信将嘈杂的共享量子态转换为最大纠缠对。可蒸馏纠缠 $E_D$ 决定了该过程可以可靠执行的最大渐近速率。对于几类量子态，高于此速率的蒸馏遵循强逆：与目标态的保真度渐近消失。在这里，我们表明相关催化消除了每个可蒸馏二分态的强逆。具体来说，在任何目标速率 $R>E_D$ 下，最佳渐近保真度由 $E_D/R$ 给出。因此，尽管催化不会增加最大可靠蒸馏速率，但它允许在每个有限速率下保持不为零的保真度。值得注意的是，即使催化剂在每个有限的块长度处精确返回并且输出和催化剂之间的相关性渐近消失，这种优势仍然存在。我们进一步描述了维持高于可靠蒸馏速率的不为零保真度所需的催化剂尺寸。

title: Spin SYK-dot chains: entanglement bound and resource estimates towards a quantum advantage
abstract: Ground states of Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK)-type models are volume-law entangled, which makes them costly both for tensor networks and for quantum hardware simulations. Thus, it remains unclear where quantum hardware could outperform classical simulation of such models. In this work, we study a spin SYK-dot chain, in which q dense SYK dots of p qubits are joined by single ZZ bonds of strength K. The entanglement across any cut is then bounded by floor(p/2) ln 2 plus the inter-dot entanglement, and the two-qubit depth of one Trotter step is set by p alone. A resource estimate shows that a quantum advantage for the ground state could appear only for dots of about 15 to 21 qubits or more. There, a single Trotter step already requires two-qubit error rates of order 10^{-6}, beyond the reach of noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) hardware. We test the assumptions of this estimate with an imaginary-time matrix product state (MPS) that applies each dot as one block. It agrees with exact diagonalisation at (p, q) = (6, 2). At (5, 2), a variational circuit with the same dot-plus-link layout comes within 3.6% of the exact energy, and noisy simulations show that its fidelity decays as assumed in the resource estimate. At (8, 5), i.e., N = 40 qubits, the energy converges at bond dimension chi = 768, far below the exact value 2^20, and the inter-dot entanglement stays small and is set mainly by K. Out-of-time-order correlators across the links decay on a time scale that shrinks rapidly with |K|. Thus, the dot size p and the inter-dot coupling K together set the entanglement of the chain, and with it where a quantum advantage could appear.
summary:
Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) 型模型的基态是体积律纠缠的，这使得它们对于张量网络和量子硬件模拟来说成本高昂。因此，目前尚不清楚量子硬件在哪些方面可以超越此类模型的经典模拟。在这项工作中，我们研究了一条自旋 SYK 点链，其中 p 个量子位的 q 个密集 SYK 点通过强度为 K 的单个 ZZ 键连接起来。然后，任何切口上的纠缠都以 Floor(p/2) ln 2 加上点间纠缠为界，并且一个 Trotter 步骤的两个量子位深度由 p 单独设置。资源估计表明，基态的量子优势只能出现在大约 15 到 21 量子位或更多的点上。在那里，单个 Trotter 步骤已经需要 10^{-6} 量级的两个量子位错误率，超出了嘈杂的中尺度量子 (NISQ) 硬件的能力范围。我们使用虚数时间矩阵乘积状态 (MPS) 来测试这一估计的假设，该虚数时间矩阵乘积状态将每个点作为一个块应用。它与 (p, q) = (6, 2) 处的精确对角化一致。

在 (5, 2) 处，具有相同点加链接布局的变分电路的精确能量误差在 3.6% 以内，并且噪声模拟表明其保真度按照资源估计中的假设衰减。在 (8, 5) 处，即 N = 40 个量子位，能量在键维 chi = 768 处收敛，远低于精确值 2^20，并且点间纠缠保持很小并且主要由 K 设置。跨链接的失序相关器在随着 |K| 快速缩小的时间尺度上衰减。因此，点尺寸 p 和点间耦合 K 共同决定了链的纠缠，并由此产生量子优势。

title: Dynamics of Fock states in traveling pulses
abstract: The quantum state of a traveling light pulse can qualitatively change the excitation dynamics of a two-level atom. We investigate this dependence for coherent and Fock input states using a virtual-cavity formulation with matched input and output temporal profiles. Analytical treatment of the master equation and numerical simulations show that coherent pulses produce damped Rabi oscillations, whereas Fock pulses can exhibit a partial recovery of the oscillation amplitude in the trailing part of the pulse. We examine how coupling to an auxiliary temporal mode and radiative loss shape this recovery. We also establish a connection with stimulated Raman adiabatic passage through an exact many-photon dark state and derive the associated adiabaticity condition. The observed recovery occurs away from ideal dark-state following. These results distinguish transient recovery in traveling-pulse scattering from conventional cavity collapse and revival, and clarify the scope of an adiabatic-transfer interpretation.
summary: 行进光脉冲的量子态可以定性地改变二能级原子的激发动力学。我们使用具有匹配输入和输出时间分布的虚拟腔公式来研究相干和 Fock 输入状态的这种依赖性。主方程的分析处理和数值模拟表明，相干脉冲产生阻尼拉比振荡，而福克脉冲可以在脉冲的尾部部分表现出振荡幅度的部分恢复。我们研究了与辅助时间模式的耦合和辐射损耗如何影响这种恢复。我们还与通过精确的多光子暗态的受激拉曼绝热通道建立了联系，并推导了相关的绝热条件。观察到的恢复发生在远离理想暗态跟随的情况。这些结果将行进脉冲散射的瞬态恢复与传统的空腔塌陷和复兴区分开来，并阐明了绝热传递解释的范围。

title: Quartet state of the neutral nitrogen-vacancy center in diamond and optimized spin readout under near-infrared two-photon excitation
abstract: Photoionization of the excited nitrogen-vacancy center (NV-) in diamond leaves the neutral defect in a metastable quartet state of unknown energy. Using two-photon optically detected magnetic resonance with a tunable femtosecond laser, we resolve its onset in the spin contrast at 1.23 +/- 0.02 eV and, with the ground-state threshold from the same setup, place the quartet 0.54 +/- 0.04 eV above the neutral ground state. The threshold sets the optimum excitation for spin readout at 1060-1075 nm, in the near-infrared tissue window, with 26-37% higher shot-noise-limited sensitivity than at 1030-1040 nm.
summary: 金刚石中激发的氮空位中心（NV-）的光电离使中性缺陷处于未知能量的亚稳态四重态。使用可调谐飞秒激光器的双光子光学检测磁共振，我们解决了其在 1.23 +/- 0.02 eV 的自旋对比度中的起始点，并使用相同设置的基态阈值，将四重态置于中性基态上方 0.54 +/- 0.04 eV 处。该阈值将自旋读出的最佳激发设置在近红外组织窗口中的 1060-1075 nm 处，散粒噪声限制灵敏度比 1030-1040 nm 处高 26-37%。

title: Efficient thermalization of one-dimensional noncommuting Hamiltonians via system-bath interactions with $Θ(n)$ ancilla qubits
abstract: We prove rapid convergence of a system-bath interaction algorithm for preparing Gibbs states of one-dimensional noncommuting Hamiltonians at every fixed positive temperature. For a chain of $n$ qudits of local dimension $2^q$ with bounded nearest-neighbor interactions, the algorithm prepares the Gibbs state from any initial state to trace-norm error $0<\varepsilon\le1/2$ in expected total Hamiltonian evolution time $\widetilde{O}(n/\varepsilon)$. This improves the previously proved $\widetilde{O}(n^6/\varepsilon)$ bound for single-ancilla system-bath Gibbs samplers, up to logarithmic factors. The proposed algorithm couples $4^q-1$ resettable bath qubits to each site in parallel and randomizes the interaction time. Our analysis bounds both the one-round approximation error and the stationarity defect of an approximate stationary state in Gibbs-weighted $L^2$ norms, with only linear dependence on the system size. It also uses the dephasing induced by randomized evolution to control the extensive Lamb shift without treating it as a small perturbation of the dissipative dynamics.
summary: 我们证明了系统-浴相互作用算法的快速收敛性，用于在每个固定正温度下准备一维非交换哈密顿量的吉布斯状态。对于具有有界最近邻相互作用的局部维度 $2^q$ 的 $n$ 量子链，该算法在预期总哈密顿演化时间 $\widetilde{O}(n/\varepsilon)$ 内准备从任何初始状态到跟踪范数误差 $0<\varepsilon\le1/2$ 的吉布斯状态。这将先前证明的单辅助系统浴吉布斯采样器的 $\widetilde{O}(n^6/\varepsilon)$ 界限提高到对数因子。所提出的算法将 $4^q-1$ 可重置浴量子位并行耦合到每个站点，并随机化交互时间。我们的分析限制了吉布斯加权 $L^2$ 范数中近似稳态的一轮近似误差和平稳性缺陷，仅线性依赖于系统大小。它还利用随机进化引起的相移来控制广泛的兰姆位移，而不将其视为耗散动力学的小扰动。

title: On the Failure Probability of Quantum Leftover Hashing with Bad Seeds
abstract: We study hashing against quantum adversaries, as used in cryptographic applications, and provide bounds on the probability of failure in practical settings where seeds might be reused and might be non-ideal. Randomness extraction and privacy amplification are key components of quantum cryptographic protocols, such as quantum randomness generation or key distribution, that allow the compression of partially secure raw data into shorter output with high security. To ensure the security of any cryptographic construction that integrates them, it is desirable to establish composable security. This can be done by using methods based on universal hashing and leveraging the general leftover hash lemma, which allows extraction of near-uniform random numbers from an imperfect entropy source by sampling from an almost two-universal family of hash functions using a seed. This approach is taken in many practical implementations, commonly using Toeplitz hashing. The lemma provides an upper bound $\varepsilon$ on the distance of the output to uniform randomness, which holds on average over the choice of seeds. It makes no claim that any particular seed yields near-uniform random numbers. This poses a problem for practical applications where a seed is sampled once and reused for many rounds (blockwise hashing). Here, we study the subset of \textit{bad} seeds yielding far-from-uniform outputs. We show that randomness extraction against quantum side information is guaranteed to produce $\delta$-close-to-uniform random numbers except with failure probability $\left(\frac{\varepsilon}{\delta}\right)^2$. This result is generalised to blockwise hashing providing a guarantee of the security of $k$ rounds except with failure probability $\big(\frac{(2k-1)\varepsilon}{\delta}\big)^2$. Moreover, we extend the general leftover hash lemma to blockwise hashing and relax the assumption of almost two-universality.
summary:
我们研究针对加密应用中使用的量子对手的散列，并提供种子可能被重复使用且可能不理想的实际环境中失败概率的界限。随机性提取和隐私放大是量子密码协议的关键组成部分，例如量子随机性生成或密钥分发，它们允许将部分安全的原始数据压缩为具有高安全性的较短输出。为了确保集成它们的任何密码结构的安全性，需要建立可组合的安全性。这可以通过使用基于通用散列的方法并利用通用的剩余散列引理来完成，该引理允许通过使用种子从几乎两个通用的散列函数族中进行采样，从不完美的熵源中提取近乎均匀的随机数。这种方法在许多实际实现中被采用，通常使用 Toeplitz 散列。引理提供了输出与均匀随机性距离的上限 $\varepsilon$，该上限在种子选择上保持平均。它没有声称任何特定的种子都会产生接近均匀的随机数。

这给实际应用带来了问题，其中种子被采样一次并重复使用多轮（块式哈希）。在这里，我们研究 \textit{bad} 种子的子集，产生非常不均匀的输出。我们证明，除了失败概率 $\left(\frac{\varepsilon}{\delta}\right)^2$ 之外，针对量子辅助信息的随机性提取保证会产生 $\delta$ 接近均匀的随机数。该结果被推广到分块哈希，提供 $k$ 轮的安全性保证，但失败概率为 $\big(\frac{(2k-1)\varepsilon}{\delta}\big)^2$。此外，我们将一般的剩余哈希引理扩展到块式哈希，并放宽了几乎两种通用性的假设。

title: Quantum tomography on Schwartz space
abstract: In this work we show that standard results in quantum tomography, which are typically proven in the context of Hilbert spaces, can analogously be established in the theory of Schwartz spaces. In particular, we will see that quantum states are equivalently characterized by their Wigner function, the characteristic of their Wigner function, and the probability distributions for a family of linear combinations of position and momentum. Physically, the latter can be understood as the evolution of its probability distribution in position over time under, for example, free or harmonic evolution. The result is obtained with techniques that are more accessible to a physicist audience, and shows that, at least for tomography results, the full structure of Hilbert spaces is not necessary.
summary: 在这项工作中，我们证明了量子层析成像的标准结果（通常在希尔伯特空间的背景下得到证明）可以类似地在施瓦茨空间的理论中建立。特别是，我们将看到量子态等效地由其维格纳函数、其维格纳函数的特征以及位置和动量的线性组合族的概率分布来表征。从物理上讲，后者可以理解为其位置概率分布随时间的演化，例如自由演化或调和演化。结果是通过物理学家观众更容易理解的技术获得的，并且表明，至少对于断层扫描结果而言，希尔伯特空间的完整结构不是必需的。

title: Unifying entanglement and nonclassicality via the Narcowich-Wigner spectrum
abstract: Entanglement and nonclassicality are two fundamental features of quantum mechanics which serve as resources in quantum information processing tasks and are tightly connected by two-mode mixing. In this work, we show that the connection between entanglement and nonclassicality extends well beyond the two-mode mixing setting by considering the case of arbitrary multimode Gaussian evolutions. Using the Narcowich-Wigner spectrum as our main technical tool to quantify single-mode phase-space nonclassicality, we derive sufficient conditions for a single-mode state to generate NPT entanglement after a multimode Gaussian unitary evolution, which both tighten and generalize existing criteria. As an application, we obtain simple single-mode protocols for quantitatively testing the entanglement structure of multimode quantum states over arbitrary bipartitions. Our results identify the Narcowich-Wigner spectrum as a powerful tool for investigating fundamental properties of bosonic quantum states.
summary: 纠缠和非经典性是量子力学的两个基本特征，它们作为量子信息处理任务的资源，并通过两种模式混合紧密相连。在这项工作中，我们通过考虑任意多模高斯演化的情况，表明纠缠和非经典性之间的联系远远超出了两种模式混合设置。使用纳科维奇-维格纳谱作为量化单模相空间非经典性的主要技术工具，我们推导出单模态在多模高斯酉演化后产生 NPT 纠缠的充分条件，这既收紧又概括了现有标准。作为一个应用，我们获得了简单的单模协议，用于定量测试任意二分上多模量子态的纠缠结构。我们的结果表明纳科维奇-维格纳谱是研究玻色子量子态基本性质的有力工具。

title: Spacetime Emergence in the Memory of a Learning Agent
abstract: We show that the causal structure of spacetime can emerge within the memory of a learning agent performing a quantum information task. We train a model-based reinforcement-learning agent to maximize the quantum mutual information between localized quantum probes interacting with a quantum field in Minkowski spacetime, without directly providing it with information regarding the spacetime metric or causal structure. In learning to accomplish this task, the reinforcement-learning agent constructs an internal predictive model whose planner develops the characteristic null structure of spacetime, allowing us to reconstruct the causal structure of the Minkowski metric with high accuracy. Within this task, spacetime geometry is obtained from an agent's successful predictions and actions, providing a first step toward showing that spacetime concepts emerge from operational quantum experience.
summary: 我们证明，时空的因果结构可以出现在执行量子信息任务的学习代理的记忆中。我们训练基于模型的强化学习代理，以最大化与闵可夫斯基时空中的量子场相互作用的局域量子探针之间的量子互信息，而不直接向其提供有关时空度量或因果结构的信息。在学习完成此任务的过程中，强化学习代理构建了一个内部预测模型，该模型的规划器开发了时空的特征零结构，使我们能够高精度地重建 Minkowski 度量的因果结构。在这项任务中，时空几何是从代理的成功预测和行动中获得的，这为表明时空概念从操作量子经验中产生提供了第一步。

title: Lee-Yang theorems for $q$-deformed oscillators and doubly-scaled SYK
abstract: We show that the vacuum partition function of the $q$-deformed oscillator \[ L_q(z):= \langle0|e^{zT_q}|0\rangle, \qquad T_q := \mathsf{a}_q + \mathsf{a}_q^* \] satisfies the Lee-Yang property, i.e., all zeros of $L_q$ lie on the imaginary line for all $q\in[-1, 1)$, proving the conjectures of Okuyama'23. Using the connection between $q$-deformed oscillators and the Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) Hamiltonian in the doubly-scaled regime, we show that the annealed SYK partition function satisfies the Lee-Yang property in the thermodynamic limit, that is, all of its Fisher zeros are on the imaginary axis. As a result, we show that the quenched SYK partition function admits a zero-free strip of constant width with high probability, rigorously complementing the large$-k$ replica calculations of Zlokapa and Kiani'26. We show the imaginary-rootedness of $L_q$ by expressing $\varphi_q(z):= L_q(\mathbf{i} z)$ as a locally uniform limit of ``$q$-deformed'' matching polynomials and then showing that those $q$-deformed polynomials are real-rooted. This establishes that $\varphi_q$ is real-rooted, and in fact belongs to the \emph{Laguerre-Pólya} class. The real-rootedness of the $q$-deformed polynomials yields novel log-concavity relations on the \emph{$q$-deformed matching moments} \[M_\ell(q):= \sum_{\pi\in\mathcal{P}_2(2\ell)}q^{\operatorname{cr}(\pi)}.\] We show the real-rootedness of the $q$-deformed polynomials by using the Touchard--Riordan formula to derive a partial differential equation relating their $q$-derivatives to their $z$-derivatives, and then analyzing the resulting motion of their roots.
summary:
我们证明 $q$ 变形振子的真空配分函数 \[ L_q(z):= \langle0|e^{zT_q}|0\rangle, \qquad T_q := \mathsf{a}_q + \mathsf{a}_q^* \] 满足 Lee-Yang 性质，即 $L_q$ 的所有零点都位于虚线上$q\in[-1, 1)$，证明了Okuyama'23的猜想。利用$q$变形振子和双尺度范围内的Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK)哈密顿量之间的联系，我们证明了退火后的SYK配分函数在热力学极限下满足Lee-Yang性质，即它的所有Fisher零点都在虚轴上。结果，我们表明淬灭的 SYK 配分函数以高概率承认恒定宽度的无零带，严格补充了 Zlokapa 和 Kiani'26 的大型 $-k$ 副本计算。我们通过将 $\varphi_q(z):= L_q(\mathbf{i} z)$ 表示为“$q$-变形”匹配多项式的局部统一极限，然后证明这些 $q$-变形多项式是实数根，来显示 $L_q$ 的虚数根性。这表明 $\varphi_q$ 是实根的，并且实际上属于 \emph{Laguerre-Pólya} 类。

$q$ 变形多项式的实根性在 \emph{$q$-变形匹配矩} \[M_\ell(q):= \sum_{\pi\in\mathcal{P}_2(2\ell)}q^{\operatorname{cr}(\pi)}.\] 上产生新颖的对数凹关系。\] 我们展示了 $q$ 变形多项式的实根性通过使用 Touchard--Riordan 公式推导将其 $q$ 导数与 $z$ 导数关联起来的偏微分方程，然后分析其根的运动结果。

title: Quantum channel tomography: optimal bounds in the near-boundary regime
abstract: Quantum channel tomography (also known as quantum process tomography) is a fundamental task in quantum information and quantum computing, aiming to learn the full description of an unknown quantum channel from black-box queries. For channels with input dimension $d_1$, output dimension $d_2$, and Kraus rank at most $r$, [CGO+26] identifies the dilation rate $\tau=rd_2/d_1\geq 1$ as a key parameter governing a Heisenberg-to-classical transition in query complexity. While the optimal bounds in the boundary regime ($\tau=1$) and the away-from-boundary regime ($\tau\geq 1+\Omega(1)$) are now known, the precise behavior in the near-boundary regime ($1<\tau<1+o(1)$) has remained unresolved. In this paper, we close this gap, thereby fully settling the query complexity of quantum channel tomography. Specifically, we show that the query complexity is - $\Omega(rd_1d_2/\varepsilon^2)$ for diamond norm error $\varepsilon$, matching the upper bound by [MB26, CGO+26], - $\Theta(d_1^2/\varepsilon+\min\{(\tau-1)d_1^2,(\tau-1)^2d_1^2d_2^2\}/\varepsilon^2)$ for Choi trace norm error $\varepsilon$. Our results reveal two qualitatively different forms of the Heisenberg-to-classical transition. For diamond norm tomography, the Heisenberg scaling disappears suddenly as soon as $\tau$ leaves the boundary regime. In contrast, Choi trace norm tomography exhibits a gradual transition from Heisenberg to classical scaling as $\tau$ moves from the boundary regime to the away-from-boundary regime.
summary:
量子通道层析成像（也称为量子过程层析成像）是量子信息和量子计算中的一项基本任务，旨在从黑盒查询中学习未知量子通道的完整描述。对于输入维度为 $d_1$、输出维度为 $d_2$ 且 Kraus 等级最高为 $r$ 的通道，[CGO+26] 将膨胀率 $\tau=rd_2/d_1\geq 1$ 识别为控制查询复杂度中海森堡到经典转换的关键参数。虽然边界区域 ($\tau=1$) 和远离边界区域 ($\tau\geq 1+\Omega(1)$) 的最佳边界现已已知，但近边界区域 ($1<\tau<1+o(1)$) 的精确行为仍未解决。在本文中，我们缩小了这一差距，从而完全解决了量子通道层析成像的查询复杂性。具体来说，我们表明，钻石范数误差 $\varepsilon$ 的查询复杂度为 - $\Omega(rd_1d_2/\varepsilon^2)$，与 [MB26, CGO+26] 的上限匹配，- $\Theta(d_1^2/\varepsilon+\min\{(\tau-1)d_1^2,(\tau-1)^2d_1^2d_2^2\}/\varepsilon^2)$ 用于 Choi 迹范数误差 $\varepsilon$。我们的结果揭示了海森堡到经典过渡的两种性质不同的形式。

对于钻石范数层析成像，一旦 $\tau$ 离开边界状态，海森堡标度就会突然消失。相比之下，随着 $\tau$ 从边界状态移动到远离边界状态，Choi 迹范数层析成像显示出从海森堡到经典缩放的逐渐过渡。
